<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="52">

      <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
      <AssemblerScript>{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

function toHex(str)
         return string.format("%X", str)
end

--tbl_data is at 0x10
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
--local attachedProc = string.sub(process,0,#process-4)
if (string.lower(process):match("pcsx2")) then
   if not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem"))+0x10008C)
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem")))
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr, 00 00 19 04 00 00 80 44 00 08 80 44 00 10 80 44 00 18 80 44)
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",getAddress("baseElfAddr")-0x10008C)
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") or (mf.ToAddress.Text == "7fffffffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "baseEEmem"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "baseEEmem+"..toHex(0x20000000)
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PCSX2"))
   return
end

{$asm}
alloc(tbl_data,$1000)
registersymbol(tbl_data)
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)
unregistersymbol(baseEEmem)
dealloc(tbl_data)
unregistersymbol(tbl_data)

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end
      end
end

local function getMemRecTypeSize(memrec)
      local size

      if (memrec.Type == vtByte) or (memrec.Type == vtBinary) then
         size = 0x1
      elseif (memrec.Type == vtWord) then
            size = 0x2
      elseif (memrec.Type == vtDword) or (memrec.Type == vtSingle) then
            size = 0x4
      elseif (memrec.Type == vtQword) or (memrec.Type == vtDouble) then
             size = 0x8
      elseif (memrec.Type == vtString) or (memrec.Type == vtUnicodeString) or (memrec.Type == vtWideString) then
             size = memrec.String.Size
      elseif (memrec.Type == vtByteArray) then
             size = memrec.Aob.Size
      else
          print("Can't determine size of memory record, memrec: \""..memrec.Description.."\", type: \""..memrec.Type.."\", parent: \""..memrec.Parent.Description.."\"")
          size = 0x0
      end

      return size
end

local function BTSK_header(address, btsk_type)
      local base = getAddress(address)
      local size = readInteger(address)
      local BTSK_base

      for i = 1, size, 1 do
          address = address + 0x4

          BTSK_base = base + readInteger(address)
          if (readInteger(address) == 0) then
             goto continue
          end

          --BTSK_parse(BTSK_base, i)

          --characters
          if (btsk_type == 0) then
             --print("BTSK base: "..toHex(BTSK_base)..", Char: "..BTSK_char_arr[i])
             BTSK_dropdown.add(string.format("%016X", BTSK_base)..":"..BTSK_char_arr[i].." data")
          --artes
          elseif (btsk_type == 1) then
                 --print("BTSK base: "..toHex(BTSK_base)..", Arte: "..Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec.DropDownDescription[i-1])
                 BTSK_dropdown.add(string.format("%016X", BTSK_base)..":"..Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec.DropDownDescription[i-1])
          --spells
          elseif (btsk_type == 2) then
                --print("BTSK base: "..toHex(BTSK_base)..", Spell: "..Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec.DropDownDescription[i-1-155])
                BTSK_dropdown.add(string.format("%016X", BTSK_base)..":"..Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec.DropDownDescription[i-1-155])
          else
              --print("BTSK base: "..toHex(BTSK_base)..", invalid btsk type")
              BTSK_dropdown.add(string.format("%016X", BTSK_base)..":Unknown")
          end
          ::continue::
      end

end

--[[
local function BTSK_parse(address, character)
      local BTSK_entry
      local counter = 0
      address = address + 0x10

      while not (readInteger(address) == 0) do
            counter = counter + 1

            BTSK_entry = address + readInteger(address)
            --print("BTSK entry ("..counter.."): "..toHex(BTSK_entry))
            BTSK_dropdown.add(string.format("%016X", BTSK_entry)..": ("..BTSK_char_arr[character]..") "..BTSK_ptr_arr[counter])

            address = address + 0x4

      end
end
]]
local function run()
         base_address = getAddress("BTSK_v2")

         local char_btsk = readInteger(base_address + 0x4 + 0x4 * 4)
         char_btsk = base_address + char_btsk
         local arte_btsk = readInteger(base_address + 0x4 + 0x4 * 5)
         arte_btsk = base_address + arte_btsk

         BTSK_edit_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93149")
         Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93254")
         BTSK_dropdown = createStringList()
         BTSK_char_arr = {"Luke","Tear","Jade","Anise","Guy","Natalia","Asch"}


         BTSK_header(char_btsk, 0) --characters
         BTSK_header(arte_btsk, 1) --artes
         --BTSK_header(base_address + 0x4BC0, 1) --artes FIX THIS LATER ------------------------------------------------
         --BTSK_header(base_spell_address, 2)--spells


         BTSK_edit_memrec.DropDownList.Text = BTSK_dropdown.Text
         BTSK_edit_memrec.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = true

         if (readQword("tbl_data+8") == 0) and (BTSK_edit_memrec.DropDownList) and (BTSK_edit_memrec.DropDownList.Count &gt; 0) then
            writeQword("tbl_data+8", tonumber(BTSK_edit_memrec.DropDownValue[0], 16))
         end

         BTSK_dropdown.Destroy()
         BTSK_dropdown = nil
end

local base_address
local Arte_effect_dropdown_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93254")
--local base_spell_address = getAddress("BTMG")
local BTSK_edit_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93149")
local BTSK_dropdown
local BTSK_char_arr

local lastValue
BTSK_edit_memrec.OnValueChanged = function(memrec, oldValue, newValue)
    if (getAddressSafe("tbl_data+8")) and
    (readInteger("tbl_data+8")) and
    not (readInteger("tbl_data+8") == 0) and
    not (lastValue == newValue) then --double run check
        lastValue = newValue
        local base = readPointer(getAddress("tbl_data+8"))
        local address = base

        local offset_0x10 = address + 0x10 --frame data
        local offset_0x14 = address + 0x14 --state machine
        local offset_0x94 = address + 0x94 --hit data
        local offset_0x98 = address + 0x98 --projectile data
        address = address + 0x8

        local entry_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93211")

        local template_frame_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93396")
        local template_hit_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93397")
        local template_state_machine_parent_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93398")
        local template_projectile_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("134479")

        local header_frame_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93308")
        local header_hit_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93490")
        local header_state_machine_parent_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("93491")
        local header_projectile_data_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("135895")

        local header_size
        local work_address

        for btsk_loop = 1, 147, 1 do
            work_address = base + readInteger(address)

            if (btsk_loop == 3) then --Frame Data
                if not (readInteger(address) == 0) then
                    header_size = ((base + readInteger(offset_0x94)) - work_address) / 0x14
                else
                    header_size = 0
                end

                --delete
                for j = header_frame_data_memrec.Count, header_size + 1, -1 do
                    local rec = header_frame_data_memrec.Child[j - 1]
                    --GIGANTIC HACK TO BYPASS CHEAT ENGINE BUG AMAZING
                    if rec then
                        local t = createTimer(nil)
                        t.Interval = 1
                        t.OnTimer = function(timer)
                            timer.Destroy()
                            rec.Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end

                --generate
                for j = header_frame_data_memrec.Count, header_size - 1, 1 do
                    local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    header.Description = "Frame " .. j + 1
                    header.IsGroupHeader = true
                    header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                    header.Address = "+14*" .. j
                    header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                    header.DontSave = true
                    header.appendToEntry(header_frame_data_memrec)

                    copyMemRecRecursive(header, template_frame_data_memrec)
                end
            elseif (btsk_loop &gt; 3) and (btsk_loop &lt; 36) then --State Machine
				if (btsk_loop == 4) then
				  --delete
				  for j = header_state_machine_parent_memrec.Count, 0 + 1, -1 do
					  local rec = header_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[j - 1]
					  if rec then
						  local t = createTimer(nil)
						  t.Interval = 1
						  t.OnTimer = function(timer)
							  timer.Destroy()
							  rec.Destroy()
						  end
					  end
                      --Sleep(1)
				  end
				end

                --print("work: "..toHex(work_address)..", addr: "..toHex(address)..", loop: "..i)

				if (readInteger(address) == 0) then
				   goto _break
				end

				local loop_counter = 0

				local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

				header.Description = "State Machine "..btsk_loop - 3
				header.IsGroupHeader = true
				header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
				header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
				header.Address = "+"..toHex(readInteger(address))
				header.DontSave = true
				header.appendToEntry(header_state_machine_parent_memrec)

                local last_offset = work_address

				--while not (readInteger(work_address) == 0) do
                repeat
					  if (loop_counter &gt; 100) then
						 break
					  end

                      local unk_0x0 = readSmallInteger(work_address)
					  local state = readSmallInteger(work_address + 0x2)

					  if (state == 0x0) and not (unk_0x0 == 0x0) or (state &gt; 0x43) then
						 print("Invalid state found at 0x"..toHex(work_address + 0x2)..", state 0x"..toHex(state)..", skipping")
						 goto _break
					  end

					  local state_template_memrec = template_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[state] --template memory record of the state

                      if (state_template_memrec.Count == 0) and not (state_template_memrec == template_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[0]) then
                         print(state_template_memrec.Description.." is unknown, address: 0x"..toHex(work_address + 0x2)..", skipping")
                         goto _break
                      end

                      local state_current_final_size = 0
                      if not (state_template_memrec == template_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[0]) then
					      state_current_final_size = getMemRecTypeSize(state_template_memrec.Child[state_template_memrec.Count - 1]) --final entry in the template memory record
                      end

					  if (state_current_final_size == 0) and not (state_template_memrec == template_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[0]) then
                         print(state_template_memrec.Child[state_template_memrec.Count - 1].Description.." has no defined members, skipping")
						 goto _break
					  end

					  local state_next_offset = 0x0
					  if not (loop_counter == 0) then
						 --print("header_parent: "..header_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[i - 4].Child[loop_counter - 1].Description..", header address: "..toHex(header_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[i - 4].Child[loop_counter - 1].CurrentAddress)..", work: "..toHex(work_address)..", memrec addr: "..toHex(state_template_memrec.Child[state_template_memrec.Count - 1].CurrentAddress)..", final size: "..toHex(state_current_final_size))
                         --no idea why this doesnt work so lets hack around it
                         --state_next_offset = work_address - header_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[i - 4].Child[loop_counter - 1].CurrentAddress
                         state_next_offset = work_address - last_offset
					  end

					  local state_header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      local name_string = state_template_memrec.Description
                      local start_pos = string.find(name_string, "(", 1, true)

                      if (start_pos) then
                         name_string = string.sub(name_string, start_pos)
                         state_header.Description = "State "..loop_counter + 1 .." "..name_string
                      else
                          state_header.Description = "State "..loop_counter + 1
                      end
					  state_header.IsGroupHeader = true
					  state_header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
					  state_header.Address = "+"..toHex(state_next_offset)
					  state_header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
					  state_header.DontSave = true
					  state_header.appendToEntry(header)

					  local state_0x0 = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()
					  state_0x0.Description = "Delay"
					  state_0x0.Address = "+0"
					  state_0x0.Type = vtWord
                      state_0x0.ShowAsSigned = true
					  state_0x0.DontSave = true
					  state_0x0.appendToEntry(state_header)

					  local state_0x2 = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()
					  state_0x2.Description = "State"
					  state_0x2.Address = "+2"
					  state_0x2.Type = vtWord
                      state_0x2.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: State Machine"
                      state_0x2.DropDownLinked = true
					  state_0x2.ShowAsHex = true
					  state_0x2.DontSave = true
					  state_0x2.appendToEntry(state_header)

                      if (state_template_memrec.Count == 0) then
                         if (state_template_memrec == template_state_machine_parent_memrec.Child[0]) then
                            goto _continue
                         end

                         print(state_template_memrec.Description.." is empty, skipping")
                         goto _break
                      else
					      copyMemRecRecursive(state_header, state_template_memrec)
                          work_address = work_address + state_template_memrec.Child[state_template_memrec.Count - 1].CurrentAddress + state_current_final_size
                      end

                      ::_continue::

					  loop_counter = loop_counter + 1
                until (unk_0x0 + state) == 0x0

			::_break::
            elseif (btsk_loop == 36) then --Hit Data
                if not (readInteger(address) == 0) then
                    header_size = ((base + readInteger(offset_0x98)) - work_address) / 0x24
                else
                    header_size = 0
                end

                --delete
                for j = header_hit_data_memrec.Count, header_size + 1, -1 do
                    local rec = header_hit_data_memrec.Child[j - 1]
                    if rec then
                        --local t = createTimer(nil)
                        --t.Interval = 1
                        --t.OnTimer = function(timer)
                            --timer.Destroy()
                            rec.Destroy()
                        --end
                    end
                end

                --generate
                for j = header_hit_data_memrec.Count, header_size - 1, 1 do
                    local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    header.Description = "Hit " .. j + 1
                    header.IsGroupHeader = true
                    header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                    header.Address = "+24*" .. j
                    header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                    header.DontSave = true
                    header.appendToEntry(header_hit_data_memrec)

                    copyMemRecRecursive(header, template_hit_data_memrec)
                end
            elseif (btsk_loop == 37) then --Projectile Data
                   --delete all children
                   for j = header_projectile_data_memrec.Count, 0 + 1, -1 do
                       local rec = header_projectile_data_memrec.Child[j - 1]
                       if rec then
                          local t = createTimer(nil)
                          t.Interval = 1
                          t.OnTimer = function(timer)
                                    timer.Destroy()
                                    rec.Destroy()
                          end
                       end
                   end

                   --"hide"
                   if (readInteger(offset_0x14) == readInteger(offset_0x98)) then
                      header_projectile_data_memrec.Color = 0xC0C0C0 --gray
                   --show
                   else
                       header_projectile_data_memrec.Color = 0xFFFFFF --natural

                       local loop_counter = 0

                       --print("addr: "..toHex(work_address)..", offset: "..toHex(readInteger(offset_0x14))..", base: "..toHex(base))
                       while (work_address &lt; base + readInteger(offset_0x14)) do
                             if (loop_counter &gt; 100) then
                                break
                             end

                             local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                             header.Description = "Projectile Data " .. loop_counter + 1
                             header.IsGroupHeader = true
                             header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                             header.Address = "+7C*" .. loop_counter
                             header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                             header.DontSave = true
                             header.appendToEntry(header_projectile_data_memrec)

                             copyMemRecRecursive(header, template_projectile_data_memrec)

                             loop_counter = loop_counter + 1
                             work_address = work_address + 0x7C
                       end
                   end
            else
                if not (readInteger(address) == 0) then
                    print("Unknown data found at loop "..btsk_loop.." at 0x"..toHex(address)..", offset: 0x"..toHex(readInteger(address)))
                end
            end

            address = address + 0x4
        end
    end
end

local success, result = autoAssemble([[
aobscanregion(BTSK_v2, baseEEmem, baseEEmem+200000000, 16 00 00 00 60 00 00 00)

registersymbol(BTSK_v2)
]])
if (success == true) then

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local AoB = AOBScan("0A 00 00 00 64 00 00 00 32 00 00 00 01 00 00 00")

if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 0) then
   if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
      print("Something went wrong")
   end
   artePropsData = tonumber(AoB[0], 16)
   artePropsData = artePropsData-0x18
   address = artePropsData
   AoB.Destroy()
   AoB = nil
else
   AoB.Destroy()
   AoB = nil
   error(print("No AoB found"))
end

local j = 1
local arteIDMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("40641")
local arteListIDMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("40642")

local list = createStringlist()

list.add("0:Nothing")

while (readQword(address+0x10) &gt; 0) and (readQword(address) &lt; 10000) do
    for i=1, arteIDMemRec.DropDownCount, 1 do
          if (readQword(address) == tonumber(arteIDMemRec.DropDownValue[i-1])) then
             list.add(readQword(address+0x10)..":"..arteIDMemRec.DropDownDescription[i-1])
             goto continue
          end

          if (i &gt;= arteIDMemRec.DropDownCount) then
             list.add(readQword(address+0x10)..":("..readQword(address)..") (UNKNOWN)")
          end
    end

    ::continue::
    if (j &gt;= 2000) then
       print("BREAK")
       break
    end
    address = address + 0xF0
    j = j + 1
end


arteListIDMemRec.DropDownList.Text = list.Text

list.Destroy()
list = nil

if syntaxcheck then return end
--Beyond the Dawn
AoB = AOBScan("01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 01 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 ? ? ? ? ? ? ? ? 01 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 FF FF FF FF")

if (AoB) and (AoB.getCount() &gt; 0) then
   if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 2) then
      print("Something went wrong")
   end
   encountPropsDataStart = tonumber(AoB[0], 16)

   if (readInteger(encountPropsDataStart+0xA8*1220) == 1408) then
       encountPropsData = encountPropsDataStart + 0xA8 * 1220
       print("Detected Beyond the Dawn DLC.")
       print("Fight Captive Nazamil at the end of the game to take advantage of this.")
   else
       encountPropsData = encountPropsDataStart + 0xA8 * 262
       print("Detected base game.")
       print("Fight the Great Astral Spirit at the end of the game to take advantage of this.")
   end
else
   error(print("No AoB found"))
end
AoB.Destroy()
AoB = nil
print("Warning! Do not back out to the title and change to Beyond the Dawn or the base game while this script is active, as it will freeze the game!")

--Run enemy list generator
getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("91074").Active = true

--Pre setup
local initialstart = 1
local encPlacementPTR = encountPropsData+0x20
local encPlacementSize = encountPropsData+0x28
local encPlacementSizes = encountPropsData+0x2C
local encPlacementValues = readPointer(encPlacementPTR)
script = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("91075")

encounterEdit = allocateMemory(1000)
registerSymbol(encounterEdit)
registerSymbol(encountPropsData)

--Copy values to allocated memory
writeQword(encounterEdit, readQword(encPlacementValues))
writeInteger(encounterEdit+0x8, readInteger(encPlacementValues+0x8))
writeInteger(encounterEdit+0xC, readInteger(encPlacementValues+0xC))
--Store old pointer for restoring
writeQword(encounterEdit+0x900, readQword(encPlacementPTR))
--Write the allocated memory to the pointer
writeQword(encPlacementPTR, encounterEdit)

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

function mainloop()
             --Continuously copy size to sizes
             if not (readInteger(encPlacementSize) == readInteger(encPlacementSizes)) or (initialstart) then
                writeInteger(encPlacementSizes, readInteger(encPlacementSize))
                --If game is closed or is in the process of switching to the DLC from base game or vice versa, don't execute and stop script
                if (readInteger(process) == nil) or not (readInteger(encountPropsDataStart) == 1) then
                    print("As the game was closed unexpectedly, the script will automatically stop.")
                    script.Active = false
                    if (script.Active == true) then
                        if (timer) then
                            timer.Enabled = false
                            timer.Destroy()
                            timer = nil
                        end
                        script.disableWithoutExecute()
                        goto stop
                    end
                end
                --Generate enemy slots based on the amount
                if not (script.Count-1 == readInteger(encPlacementSize)) then
                    --remove
                    if (script.Count-1 &gt; readInteger(encPlacementSize)) then
                        for i = (script.Count-1), readInteger(encPlacementSize)+1,-1 do
                            script.Child[i].destroy()
                        end
                    --generate
                    elseif (script.Count-1 &lt; readInteger(encPlacementSize)) then
                        for i = script.Count, readInteger(encPlacementSize),1 do
                            if (i &gt; 1000) then
                                print("BREAK")
                                break --probably infinite loop, so break
                            end
                            --Enemy entry
                            local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                            offset = 0x14 * (i - 1)

                            newrec.Type = 3
                            newrec.setAddress("encounterEdit+"..offset)
                            newrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Enemy List IDs"
                            newrec.DropDownLinked = true
                            newrec.setDescription("Enemy "..i)
                            newrec.appendToEntry(script)
                            --Location entry
                            local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                            newrec.Type = 2
                            newrec.setAddress("+8")
                            newrec.setDescription("Location")
                            newrec.appendToEntry(script.Child[i])
                            --Amount entry
                            local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                            newrec.Type = 2
                            newrec.setAddress("+C")
                            newrec.setDescription("Amount")
                            newrec.appendToEntry(script.Child[i])
                            script.Child[i].Child[1].Value = 1
                        end
                    end
                end
             end
             ::stop::
             initialstart = 0
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
{$lua}

   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end

local j = 1
local enemyIDMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("91001")
local enemyListIDMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("91002")

local list = createStringlist()

list.add("0:Nothing")

while (readQword(address+0x8) &gt; 0) and (readQword(address) &lt; 2000) do
    for i=1, enemyIDMemRec.DropDownCount, 1 do
          if (readQword(address) == tonumber(enemyIDMemRec.DropDownValue[i-1])) then
             list.add(readQword(address+0x8)..":"..enemyIDMemRec.DropDownDescription[i-1])
             goto continue
          end

          if (i &gt;= enemyIDMemRec.DropDownCount) then
             list.add(readQword(address+0x8)..":("..readQword(address)..") (UNKNOWN)")
          end
    end

    ::continue::
    if (j &gt;= 2000) then
       print("BREAK")
       break
    end
    address = address + 0x270
    j = j + 1
end

enemyListIDMemRec.DropDownList.Text = list.Text

list.Destroy()
list = nil
createTimer(1000, function() memrec.Active = false end)

local script_name = "btl_unit_data"

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name

local al = getAddressList()
local btlCharCount
local currBtlCharCount = 0
local template = al.getMemoryRecordByID("4934")

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = al.createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtSingle) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDouble) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end
      end
end

local function getChar(address)
      local loopCnt = 0
      local charCnt = 0
      local addressTable = {}
      local currAddress

      local function iterateObjects(address)
            while (address ~= 0) do
                  if (loopCnt &gt; 2000) then
                     break
                  end

                  currAddress = readPointer(address)
                  currAddress = readPointer(currAddress)

                  if (readPointer(currAddress + 0x38) == getAddress("btl_unit_func_to_check")) then
                     addressTable[charCnt] = address
                     charCnt = charCnt + 1
                  end

                  loopCnt = loopCnt + 1
                  iterateObjects(readPointer(address + 0x20))
                  address = readPointer(address + 0x30)
            end
      end

      iterateObjects(address)

      return charCnt, addressTable
end

_G[script_name] = function()
                if not (readQword("tbl_data") == 0) and not (getAddressSafe("btl_unit_func_to_check") == 0) and not (getAddressSafe("btl_unit_func_to_check") == nil) then
                   local charAddressTable = {}

                   btlCharCount, charAddressTable = getChar(readPointer(readPointer("tbl_data") + 0x10))

                   if not (btlCharCount == currBtlCharCount) then
                          --delete
                          for i = memrec.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
                              memrec.Child[i].Destroy()
                          end

                          --create
                          for i = memrec.Count + 1, btlCharCount, 1 do
                              if (i &gt; 20) then
                                 break
                              end

                              --HEADER
                              local charHeader = al.createMemoryRecord()

                              charHeader.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                              charHeader.Description = "Character "..i
                              charHeader.Address = charAddressTable[i - 1]
                              charHeader.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                              charHeader.DontSave = true
                              charHeader.appendToEntry(memrec)

                              copyMemRecRecursive(charHeader, template)
                          end

                   currBtlCharCount = btlCharCount
                   end
                end
end

	-	During OverLimit, certain actions that require mashing do not work, as they will be instantly canceled.
	-	Burst Artes activate instantly upon holding the button.
	-	Any action can be canceled, except for Mystic Artes. (this includes normal attacks, artes, Fatal Strikes, Burst Artes, activating OVL and spell casting)
	-	The Burst Arte/Fatal Strike tutorials may softlock the game. Please turn them off while doing them.
		(if you do get in this state, just set the character's HP to 0 to be able to reload a save)
	-	I have also included tools regarding Fatal Strike to help you incorporate them into combos, if you wish to.

	-	WIP Jude to Gaius character modifier by Just_Samu.
	-	Updated Muzét character modifier with more features.
	
-	Minor typo fixes in the Xillia 1 and Xillia 2 tables.
-	Added missing Bonds of Shadow item in the Equipment Editor list.

##### 2021/05/22

-	The Xillia 1 and Xillia 2 tables are now mostly region free. (Notes may not work on other versions)
	Legacy versions will be stored in case something went/goes wrong.
	
-	New feature: Xillia 1
	-	WIP Milla to Muzét character modifier by Just_Samu
	
-	New feature: Xillia 2
	-	Arte Usage by Cultevel81

##### 2021/05/13

-	New feature: Xillia 2
	-	Expanded on Chronos (Canaan) Fight Editor: You can now change the background music and the stage of the fight.
	
-	New feature: Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon X
	- You can now lock/unlock any and all costumes for Dio and Mell.

##### 2021/04/17

 - New features: Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon X
	 - Expanded on Arte List and Control Modes
	 - Added Arena Editor
	 - Fixed Party Formation Loadouts labels
	 
##### 2021/04/08

- New table: Phantasia: Narikiri Dungeon X
	- Features:
		- Party Formation Editor
		- Stats Editor
		- Equipment Editor
		- Arte List Editor
		- Control Enemies
		- Control Monsters
		- Turn off Ally/Enemy AI
		
- New features: Xillia 2
	-  Expanded Chronos (Canaan) Fight Editor
		You can now add as many enemies as you'd like, and even change if they are allied to each other.

- New feature: Vesperia
	- Ported aanpsx's character pointer table to 1.2

- New features: Destiny DC
	- Expanded Stats section
	- Change what Stage you fight on
	- Arena Editor
	- Change the size of the party (including beyond 4)

##### 2021/03/02

- New table: Legendia 
   - Features: Party Formation Editor
  
 - New feature: Phantasia
	 - Automatic Control Enabler
		This is mainly a Quality of Life script for multiplayer environments. It lets you enable/disable Control Mode/Dash Mode and Combo Command Mode for each player. Death Cam makes the game automatically change a player's Control Mode to Auto if they die, and then reverts it back to whatever it was before death. Death Cam can be turned on/off on a per-player basis. May be unstable. Spaghetti code.
		
- Bug fixes:
	 - Xillia 1 and 2's Multiplayer Linking code wasn't working properly on the Newer CPUs version. Enemy linking now works as intended.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="45">
  <CheatEntries>
    <CheatEntry>
      <ID>204</ID>

      <Options moHideChildren="1"/>
      <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
      <AssemblerScript>{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

function toHex(str)
         return string.format("%X", str)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (string.lower(process):match("pcsx2")) then
   if not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem"))+0x100000)
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem")))
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 23 00 02 3C 30 00 03 3C 80 43 42 24 00 31 63 24 00 00 40 7C 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",getAddress("baseElfAddr")-0x10007C)
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "baseEEmem"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "baseEEmem+"..toHex(0x20000000)
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PCSX2"))
   return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)
unregistersymbol(baseEEmem)
</AssemblerScript>

-- By "25094" on GitHub
function GetEmuBase()
local command = 0xB118
local emuHWND = findWindow("PPSSPPWnd")

local pointer = {}

local result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 0)
pointer[1] = tonumber(result)

result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 1)
pointer[2] = tonumber(result)

local lower = pointer[1]
local upper = pointer[2]
local combinedPointer = (upper * 0x100000000) + lower

return tonumber(combinedPointer)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if (string.lower(process):match("ppsspp")) then
   local ptr = GetEmuBase()

   if not (ptr == nil) and not (ptr == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",ptr+0x8804000)
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,E0 FF BD 27 14 00 BF AF 32 10 20 0E 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PPSSPP"))
   return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="45">
  <CheatEntries>
    <CheatEntry>
      <ID>16500</ID>

      <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (string.lower(process):match("pcsx2")) then
   if not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem"))+0x10007C)
        registerSymbol("baseEEMem", readPointer(getAddress("EEmem")))
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,11 00 00 00 11 00 00 70 13 00 00 00 13 00 00 70 00 00 19 04) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
        registerSymbol("baseEEMem", getAddress("baseElfAddr")-0x10007C)
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "baseEEmem"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "baseEEmem+"..toHex(0x20000000)
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PCSX2"))
   return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)
unregistersymbol(baseEEMem)

function fallbackScan()
   print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
   r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseRAMAddr,? ? ? ? 80 0C 5A 27 08 00 40 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
   registersymbol(baseRAMAddr)]])
   if (r==false) then
     error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
   end
   return
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if not (process == nil) then
  if (string.lower(process):match("duckstation")) then
    if not (getAddressSafe("RAM") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("RAM") == 0) then
       --For some reason, the above statement is true even if it is actually 0
       if not (readPointer("RAM") == nil) and not (readPointer("RAM") == 0) then
          registerSymbol("baseRAMAddr",readPointer(getAddress("RAM")))
          return
       else
          fallbackScan()
       end
    else
       fallbackScan()
    end
  else
      fallbackScan()
  end
else
  error(print("Not attached to anything"))
  return
end

function mainloop()
   if not (activated) then
      activated = 0
   end

   local Slot1Chara = readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+1CE758")
   if (Slot1Chara == 0) or (Slot1Chara == nil) then
      return
   else
      Slot1Chara = Slot1Chara - 1
   end
   if not (Slot1Chara == nil) then
      --Battle Mode
      if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+1FFA44") == 1) then
      --Compare P1/Slot 1 In-Battle Max HP/TP to Max HP/TP Stat
      --if (readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+1E5FD4") == readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+1CE0CE+AC*"..Slot1Chara)) and
      --   (readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+1E5FDA") == readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+1CE0D4+AC*"..Slot1Chara)) then
      --This method doesn't work in this game as the data stays in memory
         if (activated == 0) then
            --Control Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+171DC0",readByte("controlModemem+10"))
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+1") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+171DC1",readByte("controlModemem+11"))
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+2") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+171DC2",readByte("controlModemem+12"))
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+3") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+171DC3",readByte("controlModemem+13"))
            end

            --Dash Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem+4") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E617F",1)
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+5") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E617F+1D4",1)
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+6") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E617F+1D4*2",1)
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+7") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E617F+1D4*3",1)
            end

            --Combo Command Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem+8") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E6181",1)
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+9") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E6182",1)
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+0xA") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E6183",1)
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+0xB") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+1E6184",1)
            end
            activated = 1
         end
      --Field Mode
      else
         activated = 0
      end

   end
end

function toHex(str)
  return string.upper(string.format("%X", str))
end

function swapEndianWord(n)
    local b1 = n % 256
    n = (n - b1) / 256
    local b2 = n % 256
    n = (n - b2) / 256
    return b1 * 0x100 + b2
end

function swapEndian(n)
             local b1 = n % 256
             n = (n - b1) / 256
             local b2 = n % 256
             n = (n - b2) / 256
             local b3 = n % 256
             n = (n - b3) / 256
             local b4 = n % 256
             n = (n - b4) / 256
             return b1 * 0x1000000 + b2 * 0x10000 + b3 * 0x100 + b4
end

[ENABLE]

aobscanmodule(enemyProp_data,GameNative.dll,00 0F B6 4C 02 68) // should be unique
alloc(enemyProp_newmem,$1000,enemyProp_data)

label(code)
label(return)

enemyProp_newmem:
  mov [enemyProp_newmem+500],rax //base
  push ebx
  mov ebx,[enemyProp_newmem+510] //hover enabled
  test ebx,ebx
  je code
  mov [enemyProp_newmem+508],rcx //enemy id
code:
  pop ebx
  movzx ecx,byte ptr [rdx+rax+68]
  jmp return

enemyProp_data+01:
  jmp enemyProp_newmem
return:

enemyProp_newmem+510:
  dq 1

registersymbol(enemyProp_data enemyProp_newmem)

[DISABLE]

enemyProp_data+01:
  db 0F B6 4C 02 68

unregistersymbol(enemyProp_data enemyProp_newmem)
dealloc(enemyProp_newmem)

                  <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local script_name = "encounter_editor"

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name

local currEncounter
local currEnemyCount = 0
local base_enc_file
local offset_to_section2
local offset_to_enemy_data
local enemy_data_ptr
local encounterMultiplierMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("4340")

_G[script_name] = function()
   if not (getAddressSafe("encounter_file") == nil) then
      --update pointer to enemy data
      if not (readInteger("tbl_data+8") == currEncounter) then
         currEncounter = readInteger("tbl_data+8")

         base_enc_file = getAddress("encounter_file")
         offset_to_section2 = swapEndian(readInteger("encounter_file+0xC"))
         offset_to_enemy_data = swapEndianWord(readSmallInteger(getAddress("encounter_file") + 0x14 + 0x6 + (0x8 * currEncounter))) * 0x4

         enemy_data_ptr = base_enc_file + offset_to_section2 + offset_to_enemy_data
         writeQword("tbl_data+10", enemy_data_ptr)
      end

      local enemyCount = readBytes(getAddress("encounter_file+14+8*[tbl_data+8]"), 1, false)

      --generate enemy memory records
      if not (enemyCount == currEnemyCount) then
         if (encounterMultiplierMemRec.Count &gt; enemyCount) then
            for i = encounterMultiplierMemRec.Count, enemyCount + 1, -1 do
                encounterMultiplierMemRec.Child[i - 1].Destroy()
            end
         elseif (encounterMultiplierMemRec.Count &lt; enemyCount) then
                for i = encounterMultiplierMemRec.Count + 1, enemyCount, 1 do
                    if (i &gt; 100) then
                       break
                    end

                    local enemyHeaderMemRec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    enemyHeaderMemRec.Type = vtCustom
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.CustomTypeName = "2 Byte Big Endian"
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.Description = "Enemy "..i
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.Address = "tbl_data+10"
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.OffsetCount = 1
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.Offset[0] = 0x4 * (i - 1)
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.DropDownLinkedMemRec = "dropdown: Enemy List -1"
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.DropDownLinked = true
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand, moManualExpandCollapse]"
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.DontSave = true
                    enemyHeaderMemRec.appendToEntry(encounterMultiplierMemRec)

                    local enemyPosMemRec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    enemyPosMemRec.Type = vtCustom
                    enemyPosMemRec.CustomTypeName = "2 Byte Big Endian"
                    enemyPosMemRec.Description = "Position"
                    enemyPosMemRec.Address = "tbl_data+10"
                    enemyPosMemRec.OffsetCount = 1
                    enemyPosMemRec.Offset[0] = 0x4 * (i - 1) + 0x2
                    enemyPosMemRec.DontSave = true
                    enemyPosMemRec.appendToEntry(enemyHeaderMemRec)
                end
         end

         currEnemyCount = enemyCount
      end
   end
end
{$asm}
aobscanmodule(encounter_file,GameNative.dll,43 50 52 47 00 00) // should be unique

registersymbol(encounter_file)
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(encounter_file)
{$lua}

local script_name = "btl_char_data"

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name

local al = getAddressList()
local btlCharCount
local currBtlCharCount = 0
local template = al.getMemoryRecordByID("4934")

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = al.createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtSingle) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDouble) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end
      end
end

_G[script_name] = function()
                if not (readQword("tbl_data+38") == 0) then
                   btlCharCount = readByte(readQword("tbl_data+38") + 0x133828)

                   if not (btlCharCount == currBtlCharCount) then
                      if (memrec.Count &gt; btlCharCount) then
                         for i = memrec.Count, btlCharCount + 1, -1 do
                             memrec.Child[i - 1].Destroy()
                         end
                      elseif (memrec.Count &lt; btlCharCount) then
                             for i = memrec.Count + 1, btlCharCount, 1 do
                                 if (i &gt; 20) then
                                    break
                                 end

                                 --HEADER
                                 local charHeader = al.createMemoryRecord()

                                 --local currChar = readQword("tbl_data+38") + 0xDF10 * (i - 1) + 0x910
                                 --currChar = readSmallInteger(currChar + 0x72) --Char ID

                                 charHeader.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                                 charHeader.Description = "Character "..i

      <AssemblerScript>{$lua}
function fallbackScan()
   print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
   r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseRAMAddr,? ? ? ? 80 0C 5A 27 08 00 40 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
   registersymbol(baseRAMAddr)]])
   if (r==false) then
     error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
   end
   return
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if not (process == nil) then
  if (string.lower(process):match("duckstation")) then
    if not (getAddressSafe("RAM") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("RAM") == 0) then
       --For some reason, the above statement is true even if it is actually 0
       if not (readPointer("RAM") == nil) and not (readPointer("RAM") == 0) then
          registerSymbol("baseRAMAddr",readPointer(getAddress("RAM")))
          return
       else
          fallbackScan()
       end
    else
        fallbackScan()
    end
  else
     fallbackScan()
  end
else
  error(print("Not attached to anything"))
  return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseRAMAddr)

`LEGACY/Eternia_PSP.CT`:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="45">
  <CheatEntries>

      <AssemblerScript>{$lua}
-- By "25094" on GitHub
function GetEmuBase()
local command = 0xB118
local emuHWND = findWindow("PPSSPPWnd")

local pointer = {}

local result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 0)
pointer[1] = tonumber(result)

result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 1)
pointer[2] = tonumber(result)

local lower = pointer[1]
local upper = pointer[2]
local combinedPointer = (upper * 0x100000000) + lower

return tonumber(combinedPointer)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if (string.lower(process):match("ppsspp")) then
   local ptr = GetEmuBase()

   if not (ptr == nil) and not (ptr == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",ptr+0x8804000)
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,E0 FF BD 27 14 00 BF AF 32 10 20 0E 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PPSSPP"))
   return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)

          <ID>3175</ID>
          <Description>"Shard/Weapon/Armor/Gem Editor (Manual + On Hover)"</Description>
          <Options moHideChildren="1"/>
          <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
          <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

function AOBScanRegion(AOB)
    local ms = createMemScan();
    local flist = createFoundList(ms)

    ms.firstScan(soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded, AOB, "", "300000000", "400000000", "+W-X*C", fsmAligned, "", true, false, false, false)

    ms.waitTillDone()
    flist.initialize()

    return flist
end

local region = 0

local itemoffset = 0
local wpneq1offset = 0
local wpneq2offset = 0

local hoverItemPage = 0
local hoverWpnEq1Page = 0
local hoverWpnEq2Page = 0

--Region check
local AoB = AOBScanRegion("42 4C 55 53 33 30 39 30 33 00 00") --BLUS30903

if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
   region = 1
else

    AoB = AOBScanRegion("4E 50 55 42 33 31 31 33 33 00 00") --NPUB31133

    if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
       region = 1
    else

        AoB = AOBScanRegion("42 4C 4A 53 31 30 30 39 33 00 00") --BLJS10093

        if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
           region = 2
        else

            AoB = AOBScanRegion("42 4C 45 53 30 31 36 31 37 00 00") --BLES01617

            if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
               region = 3
            else

                AoB = AOBScanRegion("4E 50 45 42 30 31 32 38 38 00 00") --NPEB01288

                if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
                   region = 3
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

AoB.Destroy()
AoB = nil

if (region == 1) then --US
   itemoffset = 0x0
   wpneq1offset = 0x0
   wpneq2offset = 0x0
elseif (region == 2) then --JP
   itemoffset = -0x5EA70
   wpneq1offset = -0xDB0
   wpneq2offset = -0xDB0
elseif (region == 3) then --EU
   itemoffset = 0x9700
   wpneq1offset = 0x19140
   wpneq2offset = 0x19140
else
   writeInteger("gemEdit2+8", 0)
   print("Warning: Cannot detect whether game is US, EU or JP. Hover will not work.")
end

hoverItemPage = getAddress("rgnCheck+320F0958") + itemoffset
hoverWpnEq1Page = getAddress("rgnCheck-6F992") + wpneq1offset
hoverWpnEq2Page = getAddress("rgnCheck-6F85E") + wpneq2offset

local function mainloop()
      --Hover check
      if not (readInteger("gemEdit2+8") == 0) then
         if not (readInteger("rgnCheck") == nil) then
                 --item page hover
                 if not (readSmallInteger(hoverItemPage) == 0) then
                        itemCheck(readSmallInteger(hoverItemPage))
                 --equip page hover 1
                 elseif not (readSmallInteger(hoverWpnEq1Page) == 0) then
                        itemCheck(readSmallInteger(hoverWpnEq1Page))
                 --equip page hover 2
                 elseif not (readSmallInteger(hoverWpnEq2Page) == 0) then
                        itemCheck(readSmallInteger(hoverWpnEq2Page))
                 end
         end
      end
end

function itemCheck(item)
         if not (item == 0) and not (item == nil) then
             local itemID = SwapEndianWord(item)

             if (itemID &lt; 61697) then
                 return
             --Weapons
             elseif (itemID &lt; 61953) then
                 itemID = itemID - 61697
             --Armors
             elseif (itemID &lt; 62209) then
                 itemID = itemID - 61953
             --Gems
             elseif (itemID &lt; 62465) then
                 itemID = itemID - 62209
             --Shards
             else
                 itemID = itemID - 62465
             end

             writeInteger(getAddress("gemEdit2"), itemID)

         else
             return
         end
end

function SwapEndianWord(n)
    local b1 = n % 256
    n = (n - b1) / 256
    local b2 = n % 256
    n = (n - b2) / 256
    return b1 * 0x100 + b2
end


if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

`LEGACY/README.md`:

```md
Older versions of tables that are no longer supported, but kept here for archival reasons.
 
 ## Eternia (PS1, PSP)
For PS1, the table is based on the SLUS01355 (Disc 1), SLUS01367 (Disc 2) and SLUS01368 (Disc 3) version of the game.

For PSP, the table is based on the ULES00176 version of the game.

Emulators used:

PS1: DuckStation 0.1-5485-gc6a57273 (dev)

PSP: PPSSPP v1.11.2-366-g4d02d64fd

Features:
 - Party Formation Editor
 - Stats Editor
 - In-Battle Stats Editor
 - Equipment Editor
 - Arte List Editor
 - Gald Editor
 - Battle camera zoom Editor (useful for co-op)
 - Unlock Hardcore difficulty
 - Disable encounters
 - Change Arte Usage
 
 ## Graces F (PS3)
Based on the BLUS30903 version of the game.

Emulator used: rpcs3 0.0.12-10883-92d65ff3 Alpha

Features: 
 - Party Formation Editor
 - Stats Editor
 - In-Battle Stats Editor
 - Change field movement speed
 - Change difficulty values
 - Change battle BGM
 - Arte List Editor
 - Grade Shop options
 
 ## Xillia 1 (PS3)
Based on the NPUB31136 version of the game.

Emulator used: rpcs3 0.0.25-14515-02f3583 Alpha

Features: 
 - Party Formation Editor
 - Stats Editor
 - Equipment Editor
 - Arte List Editor
 - Gald Editor
 - Difficulty Modifier
 - Enable or Disable Overlimit
 - Enable or Disable menu functions
 - Change World Map (fast travel menu) version
 - Multiplayer Linking
 - Arte Editor
 - Change Gaius/Muzét Final Boss Encounter
 - Enable or Disable any arte/spell
 - Enable or Disable any skill
 - Turn on/off Grade Shop options at any time
 - Change field movement speed
 - Inventory Editor
 - Modify Arte Usage
 - The ability to play as bosses, or more of the same character (narikiri)
```

function get_address_from_aob(ArrayOfBytes, perm)
  local AoB
  if (perm == nil) then
     AoB = AOBScanRegion(ArrayOfBytes)
  else
      AoB = AOBScanRegion(ArrayOfBytes, perm)
  end

  if (AoB) then
     if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
        print("Warning: array of bytes not unique!")
     end

     local address = AoB[0]
     address = tonumber("0x"..address)

     AoB.Destroy()
     AoB = nil

     return address
  else
      print("No array of bytes found")
      error("No array of bytes found")
  end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function AOBScanRegion(AOB, permission)
    local ms = createMemScan();
    local flist = createFoundList(ms)

    if (permission == nil) then
       ms.firstScan(soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded, AOB, "", "300000000", "400000000", "+W-X*C", fsmAligned, "", true, false, false, false)
    else
        ms.firstScan(soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded, AOB, "", "300000000", "400000000", permission, fsmAligned, "", true, false, false, false)
    end

    ms.waitTillDone()
    flist.initialize()

    return flist
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function getOffset(address)
         if (address == nil) then
            print("getOffset received a nil value")
            error("getOffset received a nil value")
         else
             return getAddress(address) + swapEndian(readInteger(address))
         end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function calculateOffset(old_address, new_address)
         if (old_address == nil) or (new_address == nil) then
            print("calculateOffset received a nil value")
            error("calculateOffset received a nil value")
         else
             return new_address - old_address
         end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function toHex(s)
         if (s == nil) then
            print("toHex received a nil value")
            error("toHex received a nil value")
         else
             return string.upper(string.format('%x', s))
         end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function swapEndian(n)
         if (n == nil) then
            print("swapEndian received a nil value")
            error("swapEndian received a nil value")
         else
             local b1 = n % 256
             n = (n - b1) / 256
             local b2 = n % 256
             n = (n - b2) / 256
             local b3 = n % 256
             n = (n - b3) / 256
             local b4 = n % 256
             n = (n - b4) / 256

             return b1 * 0x1000000 + b2 * 0x10000 + b3 * 0x100 + b4 * 0x1
         end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function swapEndianFloat(n)
    local bytes = {string.byte(string.pack('f', n), 1, 4)}
    local swapped = string.char(bytes[4], bytes[3], bytes[2], bytes[1])
    return string.unpack('f', swapped)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function writeStringWithTerminator(address, str)
         local terminator = address + #str
         writeString(address, str)
         writeBytes(terminator, 0x0)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function remove_decimal(val)
         return math.floor(val)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function swapEndianWord(n)
    local b1 = n % 256
    n = (n - b1) / 256
    local b2 = n % 256
    n = (n - b2) / 256
    return b1 * 0x100 + b2
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function bitwise_not_16bit(x)
    return (~x) &amp; 0xFFFF
end

  add rcx,rbx
  add rcx,04
  mov rcx,[rcx]
  cmp esi,ecx
  je slot1
  //party slot 2
  mov rsi,regionCheckEquip-110
  mov rsi,[rsi]
  //link id

  add rcx,rbx
  add rcx,04
  mov rcx,[rcx]

  je slot2

  mov rsi,[rsi]
  //link id

  add rcx,rbx
  add rcx,04
  mov rcx,[rcx]
  cmp esi,ecx
  je slot3
  //party slot 4

  mov rsi,[rsi]
  //link id
  mov rcx,rax
  add rcx,rbx
  add rcx,04
  mov rcx,[rcx]
  cmp esi,ecx
  je slot4
  jmp code

slot1:

  mov rsi,[rsi]

  je code
