```CT
--required for script to work, inherits everything else from parent script
al = getAddressList()
local entries_header = al.getMemoryRecordByID("91571")
script_header = al.getMemoryRecordByID("109575")
character_stats_base = getAddress("regionCheckEquip")

current_character_data = enemy_data_base
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--delete old entries if they exist
if (script_header.Count &gt; 0) then
   if (debug == true) then
      print("Deleting "..script_header.Count.." memory records.")
   end
   while (script_header.Count &gt; 0) do
         memoryrecord_delete(script_header.Child[script_header.Count-1])
   end
end

for i = 1, player_character_size, 1 do --loop for every base character (i = entry)
--for i = 1, 1, 1 do --debug loop

    iterate_character_data()

    if (current_character &gt; 10) then --failsafe
       break
    end

    create_headers()
    local own_entry_header = entries_header.Child[current_character]

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Disable generation START")
    end

    disable_code_player_id = ""
    disable_code_animation = ""
    disable_code_model = ""
    disable_code_attachment = ""
    disable_code_preload = ""
    disable_code_mdf_btl_face = ""
    disable_code_slash_effect = ""
    disable_code_ldf = ""
    disable_code_ga = ""
    disable_code_voices = ""
    disable_code_movement = ""
    disable_code_artes = ""

    --run through the character's data entries
    for k = 0, own_entry_header.Count - 1, 1 do --loop for every data under the character (k = entry)
        local own_data_header = own_entry_header.Child[k]

        if (debug == true) then
           print("Currently processing: "..own_data_header.Description)
        end

        local code = own_data_header.DropDownValue[0]
        address = character_struct[own_data_header.Description]

        if (own_data_header.Description == "player_id") then
           local address = character_struct[own_data_header.Description]
           disable_code_player_id = "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(code)..")"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "animation") then
               disable_code_animation = disable_code_animation.."\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "model") then
               disable_code_model = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "attachment") then
               disable_code_attachment = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "preload") then
               disable_code_preload = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "mdf_btl_face") then
               disable_code_mdf_btl_face = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "slash_effect") then
               disable_code_slash_effect = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "ldf") then
               disable_code_ldf = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "ga") then
               disable_code_ga = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "voices") then
               --generate disable code
               local voice_address = getOffset(character_struct["voice_struct"])
               local current_voice = own_data_header.Child[0]

               local current_voice_entry = 0
               local current_voice_entry_size = current_voice.DropDownCount / 3
               local address = voice_address

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Processing \""..current_voice.Description.."\" with entry size of "..current_voice_entry_size)
               end

               for n = 0, current_voice_entry_size - 1, 1 do --loop for as many voices there are in the dropdown (n = voice entry)
                   local voice_string = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry]
                   local start_condition = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+1]
                   local stop_condition = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+2]
                   local voice_name = current_voice.DropDownDescription[current_voice_entry]

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Entry "..n..": Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                      ..", Start condition: "..start_condition
                      ..", Stop condition: "..stop_condition
                      ..", Voice: "..voice_string)
                   end

                   disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(array_of_bytes_to_int(start_condition))
                   ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x4)..", "..swapEndian(array_of_bytes_to_int(stop_condition))
                   ..")\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address+0x8))..", \""..voice_string.."\")"

                   current_voice_entry = current_voice_entry + 3
                   address = address + 0xC
               end

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Adding final touch of setting voice size at 0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_size"]).." to "..current_voice_entry_size)
               end

               disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices.."\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_size"])..", "..swapEndian(current_voice_entry_size)..")" --voice size
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "movement") then
               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Creating memory record with the following data:")
               end

               for l = 0, own_data_header.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option (l = dropdown entry)
                   local address = character_struct[own_data_header.DropDownDescription[l]]
                   local code = own_data_header.DropDownValue[l]

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                      ..", Value: \""..code.."\"")
                   end
                   disable_code_movement = disable_code_movement.."\r\nwriteFloat(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndianFloat(code)..")"
               end
        elseif (own_data_header.Description == "artes") then
               --current list
               local character_artelist = arte_data_base + arte_list_data_struct_size * (current_character - 1)
               local character_arte_pool = getOffset(character_artelist + 0x4)
               local character_arte_size = character_artelist + 0x8

               --list from own entry
               local own_arte_array = string_to_integer(own_data_header.DropDownValue[0])
               local own_arte_size_from_array = #own_arte_array / 5
               local address = character_arte_pool
               local arte_enable_address, arte_enable_bit

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Adding cleaning of arte list...")
               end
               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "\r\nclean_arte_list("..current_character..")"

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Processing arte list with entry size of "..own_arte_size_from_array)
               end
               for g = 1, #own_arte_array, 5 do
                   if (debug == true) and (silence_artes == false) then
                      print("Entry "..(g / 5 + 0.8)..": Arte ID: "..own_arte_array[g]..", Direction: "..own_arte_array[g + 1])
                   end

                   arte_enable_address, arte_enable_bit = get_arte_address_and_bit(own_arte_array[g], current_character)
                   if (debug == true) and (silence_artes == false) then
                      print("Adding arte enable at 0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..", bit "..arte_enable_bit)
                   end

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..", readInteger(0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..") &amp; (~(((1&lt;&lt;1)-1) &lt;&lt; "..arte_enable_bit..")) | ((1 &amp; ((1&lt;&lt;1)-1)) &lt;&lt; "..arte_enable_bit.."))"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(own_arte_array[g])..")"
                   address = address + 0x4
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(own_arte_array[g + 1])..")"
                   address = address + 0x10
               end

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Adding final touch of setting arte size at 0x"..toHex(character_arte_size).." to "..own_arte_size_from_array)
               end
               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(character_arte_size)..", "..swapEndian(own_arte_size_from_array)..")"
        else
            print("Unknown data? "..own_data_header.Description)
        end
    end

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Disable generation END")
       print("Enable generation START")
    end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--run through the entries to generate
    for j = 1, entries_header.Count - 1, 1 do --loop for every character entry (j = entry)
        local current_entry_header = entries_header.Child[j] --examples: Jude (narikiri), Milla (narikiri), Ivar, etc
        --don't generate narikiri for self
        if (current_entry_header == own_entry_header) then
           if (debug == true) then
              print("Skipped "..current_entry_header.Description)
           end
           goto restart_entry_loop
        end

        if (debug == true) then
           print(character_names[current_character].." to "..current_entry_header.Description.." START")
        end

        --create header for the character you change into
        local generated_character_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
        generated_character_memrec.IsGroupHeader = true
        generated_character_memrec.Parent = base_character_memrec
        generated_character_memrec.Description = current_entry_header.Description
        generated_character_memrec.DontSave = true
        generated_character_memrec.Options = "[moHideChildren, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Created character group memory record.")
        end
        --create full character header
        local generated_full_character_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
        generated_full_character_memrec.IsGroupHeader = true
        generated_full_character_memrec.Parent = generated_character_memrec
        generated_full_character_memrec.Description = "Full character"
        generated_full_character_memrec.DontSave = true
        generated_full_character_memrec.Options = "[moActivateChildrenAsWell, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
        generated_full_character_memrec.Color = 0xA020F0 --purple
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Created full character memory record.")
        end

        --run through the character's data entries
        for k = 0, current_entry_header.Count - 1, 1 do --loop for every data under the character (k = entry)
            current_data_header = current_entry_header.Child[k] --example: player_id, model, animation, etc

            if (debug == true) then
               print("Currently processing: "..current_data_header.Description)
            end

            memory_record = al.createMemoryRecord()
            memory_record.Type = vtAutoAssembler
            memory_record.Parent = generated_full_character_memrec
            memory_record.DontSave = true
            memory_record.Options = "[moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"

            local enable_code = ""
            address = character_struct[current_data_header.Description]
            local code = current_data_header.DropDownValue[0]

            if (current_data_header.Description == "player_id") then
               enable_code = "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(code)..")"

               memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_player_id)
               memory_record.Description = "Player ID"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "animation") then
                   enable_code = "\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_animation)
                   memory_record.Description = "Animation"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "model") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_model)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_model)
                   memory_record.Description = "Model"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "attachment") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_attachment)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_attachment)
                   memory_record.Description = "Attachment"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "preload") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_preload)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_preload)
                   memory_record.Description = "Preload"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "mdf_btl_face") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_mdf_btl_face)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_mdf_btl_face)
                   memory_record.Description = "MDF BTL FACE"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "slash_effect") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_slash_effect)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_slash_effect)
                   memory_record.Description = "Slash effect"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "ldf") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_ldf)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_ldf)
                   memory_record.Description = "LDF"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "ga") then
                   enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_ga)
                   generic_string_handler(disable_code_ga)
                   memory_record.Description = "GA"
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "voices") then
                   local voice_address = getOffset(character_struct["voice_struct"])

                   for m = 0, current_data_header.Count - 1, 1 do --loop for as many voice headers there are (m = voice header entry)
                       local address = voice_address
                       local current_voice = current_data_header.Child[m]
                       local current_voice_entry = 0
                       local current_voice_entry_size = current_voice.DropDownCount / 3
                       local voice_name
                       local enable_code = ""

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("Processing \""..current_voice.Description.."\" with entry size of "..current_voice_entry_size)
                       end

                       for n = 0, current_voice_entry_size - 1, 1 do --loop for as many voices there are in the dropdown (n = dropdown entry)
                           local voice_string = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry]
                           local start_condition = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+1]
                           local stop_condition = current_voice.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+2]
                           voice_name = current_voice.DropDownDescription[current_voice_entry]

                           if (debug == true) then
                              print("Entry "..n..": Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                              ..", Start condition: "..start_condition
                              ..", Stop condition: "..stop_condition
                              ..", Voice: "..voice_string)
                           end

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(array_of_bytes_to_int(start_condition))
                           ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x4)..", "..swapEndian(array_of_bytes_to_int(stop_condition))
                           ..")\r\nwriteStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address+0x8))..", \""..voice_string.."\")"

                           current_voice_entry = current_voice_entry + 3
                           address = address + 0xC
                       end

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("Adding final touch of setting voice size at 0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_size"]).." to "..current_voice_entry_size)
                       end

                       enable_code = enable_code.."\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_size"])..", "..swapEndian(current_voice_entry_size)..")"

                       if (m == 0) then --add initial script to the first voice, otherwise generate memory records under it
                          memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_voices)
                       else
                           local sub_record = al.createMemoryRecord()
                           sub_record.Type = vtAutoAssembler
                           sub_record.Parent = memory_record
                           sub_record.DontSave = true
                           sub_record.Description = voice_name
                           sub_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_voices)
                       end
                end
                memory_record.Description = "Voice"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "movement") then
                   for l = 0, current_data_header.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option (l = dropdown entry)
                       local address = character_struct[current_data_header.DropDownDescription[l]]
                       local code = current_data_header.DropDownValue[l]

                       enable_code = enable_code.."\r\nwriteFloat(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndianFloat(code)..")"

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                          ..", Value: \""..code.."\"")
                       end
                   end

                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_movement)
                   memory_record.Description = "Movement"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (current_data_header.Description == "artes") then
                   --current list
                   local character_artelist = arte_data_base + arte_list_data_struct_size * (current_character - 1)
                   local character_arte_pool = getOffset(character_artelist + 0x4)
                   local character_arte_size = character_artelist + 0x8

                   --list for current entry
                   local arte_array = string_to_integer(current_data_header.DropDownValue[0])
                   local arte_size_from_array = #arte_array / 5
                   local address = character_arte_pool

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Adding cleaning of arte list...")
                   end
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nclean_arte_list("..current_character..")"

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Processing arte list with entry size of "..arte_size_from_array)
                   end
                   for g = 1, #arte_array, 5 do
                       if (debug == true) and (silence_artes == false) then
                          print("Entry "..(g / 5 + 0.8)..": Arte ID: "..arte_array[g]..", Direction: "..arte_array[g + 1])
                       end

                       arte_enable_address, arte_enable_bit = get_arte_address_and_bit(arte_array[g], current_character)
                       if (debug == true) and (silence_artes == false) then
                          print("Adding arte enable at 0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..", bit "..arte_enable_bit)
                       end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..", readInteger(0x"..toHex(arte_enable_address)..") &amp; (~(((1&lt;&lt;1)-1) &lt;&lt; "..arte_enable_bit..")) | ((1 &amp; ((1&lt;&lt;1)-1)) &lt;&lt; "..arte_enable_bit.."))"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(arte_array[g])..")"
                       address = address + 0x4
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..swapEndian(arte_array[g + 1])..")"
                       address = address + 0x10
                   end

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Adding final touch of setting arte size at 0x"..toHex(character_arte_size).." to "..arte_size_from_array)
                   end
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(character_arte_size)..", "..swapEndian(arte_size_from_array)..")"
                   memory_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_artes)
                   memory_record.Description = "Artes"
            else
                print("Unknown data? "..current_data_header.Description)
            end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        end

        if (debug == true) then
           print(character_names[current_character].." to "..current_entry_header.Description.." END")
        end
        ::restart_entry_loop::
    end


    if (debug == true) then
       print(character_names[current_character].." END")
    end
end

if (auto_disable == true) then
   createTimer(1000, function() memrec.Active = false end)
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE END")
end

                          <DropDownList>00 00 01 C6 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 2E 5C 00 00 00 17 00 00 01 C7 00 00 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 2E 48 00 00 00 17 00 00 01 C8 00 00 00 04 00 00 00 00 00 00 2E 34 00 00 00 17 00 00 01 C9 00 00 00 08 00 00 00 00 00 00 2E 20 00 00 00 17:Default
</DropDownList>

                        </CheatEntry>

                  </CheatEntries>
                </CheatEntry>
                <CheatEntry>
                  <ID>92245</ID>
                  <Description>"Arte list helper"</Description>
                  <Options moHideChildren="1"/>
                  <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
                  <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local debug = false
local auto_disable = false
local clear_console = false
local load_character = 0x1 --based on arte list data

if (clear_console == true) then
   --clear lua engine window
   GetLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()
   if (debug == true) then
      print(os.date ("%c"))
      print("Cleared Lua Engine.")
   end
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE START")
end

local al = getAddressList()
local char_script_memrec = al.getMemoryRecordByID("109575")

if (arte_data_base == nil) then
   if (debug == true) then
      print("Character script is disabled, enabling...")
   end
   char_script_memrec.Active = true
end

local address = getOffset(arte_data_base + 0x4 + arte_list_data_struct_size * (load_character - 1))
local header = memrec.Child[1]

if (header.Count &gt; 0) then
   if (debug == true) then
      print("Deleting "..header.Count.." memory records.")
   end
   while (header.Count &gt; 0) do
         memoryrecord_delete(header.Child[header.Count-1])
   end
end

for i = 0, (arte_size_to_generate - 1), 1 do
    if (i &gt; 100) then
       break
    end

    local arte_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
    arte_memrec.Parent = header
    arte_memrec.Description = "Arte "..i+1
    arte_memrec.DontSave = true
    arte_memrec.Address = address
    arte_memrec.Type = vtCustom
    arte_memrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
    arte_memrec.DropDownLinkedMemRec = "Arte List"
    arte_memrec.DropDownLinked = true
    arte_memrec.Options = "[moManualExpandCollapse, moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand]"

    --generate bitflags
    for j=0,3,1 do
        local direction_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
        direction_memrec.Parent = arte_memrec
        direction_memrec.DontSave = true
        direction_memrec.Address = address + 0x7
        direction_memrec.Type = vtBinary
        direction_memrec.DropDownLinkedMemRec = "dropdown: Disabled/Enabled"
        direction_memrec.DropDownLinked = true
        direction_memrec.Binary.Size = 1
        direction_memrec.Binary.Startbit = j

        if (j == 0) then
           direction_memrec.Description = "Direction: Neutral"
        elseif (j == 1) then
               direction_memrec.Description = "Direction: Up"
        elseif (j == 2) then
               direction_memrec.Description = "Direction: Side (Left/Right)"
        elseif (j == 3) then
               direction_memrec.Description = "Direction: Down"
        else
            direction_memrec.Description = "Unknown"
        end
    end

    address = address + 0x14
end

if (debug == false) then
   showMessage("By default, this will show Jude's arte list.\r\nSet the arte after the final one to 0 (nothing) to end the list.\r\nClick \"Activate\" once you're done making the list, then copy the result into the value part of the artes memory record.")
end

if (auto_disable == true) then
   createTimer(1000, function() memrec.Active = false end)
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE END")
end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
</AssemblerScript>
                  <CheatEntries>
                    <CheatEntry>
                      <ID>92246</ID>
                      <Description>"Generate arte list"</Description>
                      <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
                      <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local debug = false
local auto_disable = true
local clear_console = false

if (clear_console == true) then
   --clear lua engine window
   GetLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()
   if (debug == true) then
      print(os.date ("%c"))
      print("Cleared Lua Engine.")
   end
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE START")
end

local header = memrec.Parent.Child[1]
local address = tonumber("0x"..header.Child[0].Address)
local i = 1
local arte_table = {}
local arte_table_string = ""
local arte_table_counter = 1

while not (readInteger(address) == 0) do
      if (i &gt; arte_size_to_generate) then
         break
      end

      local bytes = readBytes(address, 0x14, true)
      --table.insert(arte_table, i, bytes)
      for j,v in pairs(bytes) do
          table.insert(arte_table, arte_table_counter, v)
          arte_table_counter = arte_table_counter + 1
      end

      if (debug == true) then
         print("Added arte ID "..swapEndian(readInteger(address)).." to table")
      end

      i = i + 1
      address = address + 0x14
end

for j,v in pairs(arte_table) do
    if (v &lt; 0x10) then
       arte_table_string = arte_table_string.."0"..toHex(v).." "
    else
        arte_table_string = arte_table_string..toHex(v).." "
    end
end

--remove whitespace at the end
arte_table_string = arte_table_string:sub(1, -2)

print("-----------------------------------------------------------------------")
print(os.date ("%c"))
print("Copy this to the artes memory record:")
print(arte_table_string)
writeToClipboard(arte_table_string)
print("(this was also copied to clipboard)")
print("A total of "..(i-1).." artes were recognized.")
print("-----------------------------------------------------------------------")

if (auto_disable == true) then
   createTimer(1000, function() memrec.Active = false end)
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE END")
end
```

```CT
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (string.lower(process):match("pcsx2")) then
   if not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem"))+0x10008E)
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr, 19 04 00 00 80 44 00 08 80 44 00 10 80 44 00 18 80 44)
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PCSX2"))
   return
end
{$asm}
```

```CT
function fallbackScan()
   print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
   r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseRAMAddr,? ? ? ? 80 0C 5A 27 08 00 40 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 FF 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
   registersymbol(baseRAMAddr)]])
   if (r==false) then
     error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
   end
   return
end

if syntaxcheck then return end

          fallbackScan()

       fallbackScan()
    end

      fallbackScan()
  end
else

function mainloop()
   if not (activated) then
      activated = 0
   end

   local Slot1Chara = readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+0873F8")
   if (Slot1Chara == 0) or (Slot1Chara == nil) then
      return
   else
      Slot1Chara = Slot1Chara - 1
   end
   if not (Slot1Chara == nil) then
      --Battle Mode
      --if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+13613D") == 1) then
      --Compare P1/Slot 1 In-Battle Max HP/TP to Max HP/TP Stat
      if (readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+138E24") == readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+086F0E+A0*"..Slot1Chara)) and
         (readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+138E30") == readSmallInteger("baseRAMAddr+086F14+A0*"..Slot1Chara)) then
         if (activated == 0) then
            --Control Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26",readByte("controlModemem+10"))
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+1") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238",readByte("controlModemem+11"))
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+2") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*2",readByte("controlModemem+12"))
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+3") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*3",readByte("controlModemem+13"))
            end

            --Dash Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem+4") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1B",1)
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+5") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1B+238",1)
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+6") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1B+238*2",1)
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+7") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1B+238*3",1)
            end

            --Combo Command Modes
            --Slot 1
            if (readByte("controlModemem+8") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1D",1)
            end
            --Slot 2
            if (readByte("controlModemem+9") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1D+238",1)
            end
            --Slot 3
            if (readByte("controlModemem+0xA") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1D+238*2",1)
            end
            --Slot 4
            if (readByte("controlModemem+0xB") == 1) then
               writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F1D+238*3",1)
            end
            activated = 1
         end
         --Auto Death Cam
         if not (autoCam1active) then
            autoCam1active = 0
            autoCam2active = 0
            autoCam3active = 0
            autoCam4active = 0
         end

         --If Auto Death Cam is enabled, check if character is dead
         --If dead, check if it has been ran, if not, store current control to
         --memory then set to Auto
         --Else, restore control mode from memory

         --Slot 1
         if (readByte("controlModemem+C") == 1) then
            if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F16") == 1) then --Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
               if (autoCam1active == 0) then
                  writeByte("controlModemem+0x10",readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26")) --Store Control Mode to temp memory
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26",0)
                  autoCam1active = 1
               end
            else
               if (autoCam1active == 1) then
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26",readByte("controlModemem+0x10"))
                  autoCam1active = 0
               end
            end
         end
         --Slot 2
         if (readByte("controlModemem+D") == 1) then
            if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F16+238") == 1) then --Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
               if (autoCam2active == 0) then
                  writeByte("controlModemem+0x11",readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238")) --Store Control Mode to temp memory
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238",0)
                  autoCam2active = 1
               end
            else
               if (autoCam2active == 1) then
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238",readByte("controlModemem+0x11"))
                  autoCam2active = 0
               end
            end
         end
         --Slot 3
         if (readByte("controlModemem+E") == 1) then
            if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F16+238*2") == 1) then --Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
               if (autoCam3active == 0) then
                  writeByte("controlModemem+0x12",readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*2")) --Store Control Mode to temp memory
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*2",0)
                  autoCam3active = 1
               end
            else
               if (autoCam3active == 1) then
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*2",readByte("controlModemem+0x12"))
                  autoCam3active = 0
               end
            end
         end
         --Slot 4
         if (readByte("controlModemem+F") == 1) then
            if (readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F16+238*3") == 1) then --Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
               if (autoCam4active == 0) then
                  writeByte("controlModemem+0x13",readByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*3")) --Store Control Mode to temp memory
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*3",0)
                  autoCam4active = 1
               end
            else
               if (autoCam4active == 1) then
                  writeByte("baseRAMAddr+138F26+238*3",readByte("controlModemem+0x13"))
                  autoCam4active = 0
               end
            end
         end
      --Field Mode
      else
         activated = 0
      end

   end
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
alloc(controlModemem,1000)

controlModemem:
  db 01 00 00 00 01 01 01 01

controlModemem+C:
  db 01 01 01 01 02 02 02 02

registersymbol(controlModemem)

   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

[DISABLE]

   if (timer) then
      object_destroy(timer)
   end
   timer = nil
   activated = nil
   autoCam1Active = nil
   autoCam2Active = nil
   autoCam3Active = nil
   autoCam4Active = nil

                  <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
                  <AssemblerScript>/*
You may experience crashes and/or unintended behaviour when using
this script. You have been warned.

This is mainly for quality of life purposes in multiplayer settings.

These scripts let you enable Dash/Combo Command Modes and configure your
Control Modes while in a battle.

You will not be able to use the Control/Dash Modes and Combo Command Modes
part of the table after activating one of the scripts.
However, you can edit them directly under the script.

Use the Toggles to control what gets enabled.

Auto Death Cam automatically changes Control Modes to Auto on death,
then returns to original Control Mode after getting brought back to life.
Can be configured on a per-player basis.
Don't be on Auto if you're not dead, otherwise it will break.
In case you did not heed this warning, if using Automatic Control Modes,
you can set the current Control Method in the "Active" section
under "Control Modes" (or you can just press Select),
otherwise set it under the "Automatic Control Enabler" section.
*/
[ENABLE]
[DISABLE]
</AssemblerScript>
                </CheatEntry>
                <CheatEntry>
                  <ID>63106</ID>
                  <Description>"Automatic Control Enabler"</Description>
                  <Options moHideChildren="1" moDeactivateChildrenAsWell="1"/>
                  <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
                  <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]

aobscanmodule(autoManual,mednafen_psx_hw_libretro.dll,41 88 10 0F B6 D2) // should be unique
alloc(newmem,$1000,"mednafen_psx_hw_libretro.dll"+10D74)

label(code)
label(partyCress)
label(partyMint)
label(partyArche)
label(partyClaus)
label(partyChester)
label(partySuzu)

label(comboEnabled)

label(controlSlot2)

label(dashActivate)

newmem:

//Check who is in the first slot is, and then,
//moves to their respective party blocks.
code:
  push eax
  cmp word [400873F8],1
  je partyCress
  cmp word [400873F8],2
  je partyMint
  cmp word [400873F8],3
  je partyArche
  cmp word [400873F8],4
  je partyClaus
  cmp word [400873F8],5
  je partyChester
  cmp word [400873F8],6
  je partySuzu
  jmp backtoGame

//Compare Character Max HP/TP to Slot 1 Max HP/TP, if same, go to activate
//Basically, just a way to check if you are in battle,
//as setting it all the time would break the game.
//An ugly hack, but it works nonetheless.
partyCress:
  movzx eax, word [40086F0E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086F14] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyMint:
  movzx eax, word [40086FAE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086FB4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyArche:
  movzx eax, word [4008704E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087054] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyClaus:
  movzx eax, word [400870EE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [400870F4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyChester:
  movzx eax, word [4008718E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087194] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partySuzu:
  movzx eax, word [4008722E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087234] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

activate:
  cmp byte [controlEnabled],1
  je controlActivate
  cmp byte [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp byte [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

//This is where you control what values get set in battles.
controlActivate:
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [40138F26],ah //Slot 1 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot2]
  mov byte [4013915E],ah //Slot 2 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot3]
  mov byte [40139396],ah //Slot 3 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot4]
  mov byte [401395CE],ah //Slot 4 Control Mode
  cmp [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

dashActivate:
  mov ax, [dashSlot1]
  mov word [40138F1B],ax //Slot 1 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot2]
  mov word [40139153],ax //Slot 2 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot3]
  mov word [4013938B],ax //Slot 3 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot4]
  mov word [401395C3],ax //Slot 4 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot1]
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

comboActivate:
  mov word [40138F1D],ax //Slot 1 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot2]
  mov word [40139155],ax //Slot 2 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot3]
  mov word [4013938D],ax //Slot 3 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot4]
  mov word [401395C5],ax //Slot 4 Combo Command Mode
  jmp backtoGame

backtoGame:
  pop eax
  mov [r8],dl
  movzx edx,dl
  jmp return

controlEnabled:
 dd 1

dashEnabled:
 dd 1

comboEnabled:
 dd 1

controlSlot1:
 dd 2

controlSlot2:
 dd 0

controlSlot3:
 dd 0

controlSlot4:
 dd 0

dashSlot1:
 dd 1

dashSlot2:
 dd 1

dashSlot3:
 dd 1

dashSlot4:
 dd 1

comboSlot1:
 dd 0

comboSlot2:
 dd 0

comboSlot3:
 dd 0

comboSlot4:
 dd 0

autoManual:
  jmp newmem
  nop

return:

  movzx eax, word [40086F14] //Character Max TP

  movzx eax, word [40087234] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame2

activate:
  cmp r8,40138F16 //Slot 1 Death State
  je deathCamActivateSlot1
  cmp r8,4013914E //Slot 2 Death State
  je deathCamActivateSlot2
  cmp r8,40139386 //Slot 3 Death State
  je deathCamActivateSlot3
  cmp r8,401395BE //Slot 4 Death State
  je deathCamActivateSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamActivateSlot1:
  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot1
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot1
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamActivateSlot2:
  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot2
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot2
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamActivateSlot3:
  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot3
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot3
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamActivateSlot4:
  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot4
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

//Automatic Control Mode turned off
deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot1:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled1], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot1
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot2:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot2
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot3:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOffSlot4:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffSlot1:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40138F16],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate1
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [40138F26], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate1:
  mov ah, [40138F26]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],ah
  mov byte [40138F26],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffSlot2:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [4013914E],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate2
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp2]
  mov byte [4013915E], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate2:
  mov ah, [4013915E]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp2],ah
  mov byte [4013915E],0
  jmp backtoGame2

  deathCamAutoOffSlot3:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40139386],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate3
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode

  je deathCamAutoOffActivate4
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode

  mov byte [401395CE],0
  jmp backtoGame2

//Automatic Control Mode turned on
deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot1:

  je deathCamAutoOnSlot1
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot2:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot2
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot3:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoCheckOnSlot4:

  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot1:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto

  je deathCamAutoOnActivate1
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [controlSlot1], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate1:
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],ah
  mov byte [controlSlot1],0
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot2:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [4013914E],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOnActivate2
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode

  mov byte [controlSlot2], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate2:

  mov byte [controlSlot2],0
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot3:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto

deathCamAutoOnSlot4:

dd 0

dd 0

newmem:

//Check who is in the first slot is, and then,
//moves to their respective party blocks.
code:
  push eax
  cmp word [400873F8],1
  je partyCress
  cmp word [400873F8],2
  je partyMint
  cmp word [400873F8],3
  je partyArche
  cmp word [400873F8],4
  je partyClaus
  cmp word [400873F8],5
  je partyChester
  cmp word [400873F8],6
  je partySuzu
  jmp backtoGame

//Compare Character Max HP/TP to Slot 1 Max HP/TP, if same, go to activate
//Basically, just a way to check if you are in battle,
//as setting it all the time would break the game.
//An ugly hack, but it works nonetheless.
partyCress:
  movzx eax, word [40086F0E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086F14] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyMint:
  movzx eax, word [40086FAE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086FB4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyArche:
  movzx eax, word [4008704E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087054] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyClaus:
  movzx eax, word [400870EE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [400870F4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyChester:
  movzx eax, word [4008718E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087194] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partySuzu:
  movzx eax, word [4008722E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087234] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

//This is where you control what values get set in battles.
activate:
  mov byte [40138F26],2 //Slot 1 Control Mode
//  mov byte [4013915E],2 //Slot 2 Control Mode
//  mov byte [40139396],2 //Slot 3 Control Mode
//  mov byte [401395CE],2 //Slot 4 Control Mode
  mov word [40138F1B],1 //Slot 1 Dash Mode
  mov word [40139153],1 //Slot 2 Dash Mode
  mov word [4013938B],1 //Slot 3 Dash Mode
  mov word [401395C3],1 //Slot 4 Dash Mode
  mov word [40138F1D],0 //Slot 1 Combo Command Mode
  mov word [40139155],0 //Slot 2 Combo Command Mode
  mov word [4013938D],0 //Slot 3 Combo Command Mode
  mov word [401395C5],0 //Slot 4 Combo Command Mode
  jmp backtoGame

backtoGame:
  pop eax
  mov [r8],dl
  movzx edx,dl
  jmp return

autoManual:
  jmp newmem
  nop

return:

  movzx eax, word [40087234] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

activate:
  cmp byte [controlEnabled],1
  je controlActivate
  cmp byte [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp byte [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

//This is where you control what values get set in battles.
controlActivate:
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [40138F26],ah //Slot 1 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot2]
  mov byte [4013915E],ah //Slot 2 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot3]
  mov byte [40139396],ah //Slot 3 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot4]
  mov byte [401395CE],ah //Slot 4 Control Mode
  cmp [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

dashActivate:
  mov ax, [dashSlot1]
  mov word [40138F1B],ax //Slot 1 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot2]
  mov word [40139153],ax //Slot 2 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot3]
  mov word [4013938B],ax //Slot 3 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot4]
  mov word [401395C3],ax //Slot 4 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot1]
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  jmp backtoGame

comboActivate:
  mov word [40138F1D],ax //Slot 1 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot2]
  mov word [40139155],ax //Slot 2 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot3]
  mov word [4013938D],ax //Slot 3 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot4]
  mov word [401395C5],ax //Slot 4 Combo Command Mode
  jmp backtoGame

backtoGame:
  pop eax
  mov [r8],dl
  movzx edx,dl
  jmp return

controlEnabled:
 dd 1

dashEnabled:
 dd 1

comboEnabled:
 dd 1

controlSlot1:
 dd 2

controlSlot2:
 dd 0

controlSlot3:
 dd 0

controlSlot4:
 dd 0

dashSlot1:
 dd 1

dashSlot2:
 dd 1

dashSlot3:
 dd 1

dashSlot4:
 dd 1

comboSlot1:
 dd 0

comboSlot2:
 dd 0

comboSlot3:
 dd 0

comboSlot4:
 dd 0

  jmp newmem
  nop

label(deathCamTemp2)
label(deathCamTemp3)
label(deathCamTemp4)

newmem:

//Check who is in the first slot is, and then,
//moves to their respective party blocks.
code:
  push eax
  cmp word [400873F8],1
  je partyCress
  cmp word [400873F8],2
  je partyMint
  cmp word [400873F8],3
  je partyArche
  cmp word [400873F8],4
  je partyClaus
  cmp word [400873F8],5
  je partyChester
  cmp word [400873F8],6
  je partySuzu
  jmp backtoGame

//Compare Character Max HP/TP to Slot 1 Max HP/TP, if same, go to activate
//Basically, just a way to check if you are in battle,
//as setting it all the time would break the game.
//An ugly hack, but it works nonetheless.
partyCress:
  movzx eax, word [40086F0E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086F14] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyMint:
  movzx eax, word [40086FAE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40086FB4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyArche:
  movzx eax, word [4008704E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087054] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyClaus:
  movzx eax, word [400870EE] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [400870F4] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partyChester:
  movzx eax, word [4008718E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087194] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

partySuzu:
  movzx eax, word [4008722E] //Character Max HP
  cmp eax,[40138E24] //Slot 1 Max HP
  je activate
  movzx eax, word [40087234] //Character Max TP
  cmp eax,[40138E30] //Slot 1 Max TP
  je activate
  jmp backtoGame

activate:
  cmp byte [controlEnabled],1
  je controlActivate
  cmp byte [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp byte [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  cmp byte [deathCamEnabled],1
  je deathCamActivate
  jmp backtoGame

//This is where you control what values get set in battles.
controlActivate:
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [40138F26],ah //Slot 1 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot2]
  mov byte [4013915E],ah //Slot 2 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot3]
  mov byte [40139396],ah //Slot 3 Control Mode
  mov ah, [controlSlot4]
  mov byte [401395CE],ah //Slot 4 Control Mode
  cmp [dashEnabled],1
  je dashActivate
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  cmp byte [deathCamEnabled],1
  je deathCamActivate
  jmp backtoGame

dashActivate:
  mov ax, [dashSlot1]
  mov word [40138F1B],ax //Slot 1 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot2]
  mov word [40139153],ax //Slot 2 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot3]
  mov word [4013938B],ax //Slot 3 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [dashSlot4]
  mov word [401395C3],ax //Slot 4 Dash Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot1]
  cmp [comboEnabled],1
  je comboActivate
  cmp byte [deathCamEnabled],1
  je deathCamActivate
  jmp backtoGame

comboActivate:
  mov word [40138F1D],ax //Slot 1 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot2]
  mov word [40139155],ax //Slot 2 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot3]
  mov word [4013938D],ax //Slot 3 Combo Command Mode
  mov ax, [comboSlot4]
  mov word [401395C5],ax //Slot 4 Combo Command Mode
  cmp byte [deathCamEnabled],1
  je deathCamActivate
  jmp backtoGame

deathCamActivate:
  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAuto2
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAuto
  jmp backtoGame

//If dead, move to Auto Control Mode
//If alive, move current control method to deathCamTemp1
//Automatic Control Mode turned off
deathCamAuto:
  cmp byte [40138F16],1
  je deathCamAutoActivate
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],40138F26
  mov byte [40138F26],0
  jmp backtoGame

deathCamAutoActivate:
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [40138F26],ah
  jmp backtoGame

//Automatic Control Mode turned on
deathCamAuto2:
  cmp byte [40138F16],1
  je deathCamAutoActivate2
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [controlSlot1], ah
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],ah
  jmp backtoGame

deathCamAutoActivate2:
  mov byte [controlSlot1],0
  jmp backtoGame

backtoGame:
  pop eax
  mov [r8],dl
  movzx edx,dl
  jmp return

controlEnabled:
 dd 1

dashEnabled:
 dd 1

comboEnabled:
 dd 1

deathCamEnabled:
 dd 1

controlSlot1:
 dd 2

controlSlot2:
 dd 0

controlSlot3:
 dd 0

controlSlot4:
 dd 0

dashSlot1:
 dd 1

dashSlot2:
 dd 1

dashSlot3:
 dd 1

dashSlot4:
 dd 1

comboSlot1:
 dd 0

comboSlot2:
 dd 0

comboSlot3:
 dd 0

comboSlot4:
 dd 0

deathCamTemp1:
deathCamTemp2:
deathCamTemp3:
deathCamTemp4:

autoManual:
  jmp newmem
  nop

return:

  je deathCamActivate

  cmp r8,401392FC //Slot 3 status effect
  je deathCamActivate
  cmp r8,40139534 //Slot 4 status effect

  cmp [controlEnabled], 1
  je deathCamAuto2
  cmp [controlEnabled], 0
  je deathCamAuto
  jmp backtoGame2

//Automatic Control Mode turned off
deathCamAuto:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled1], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot1
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffSlot1:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40138F16],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate1
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [40138F26], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate1:
  mov ah, [40138F26]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],ah
  mov byte [40138F26],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffSlot2:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [4013914E],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate2
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp2]
  mov byte [4013915E], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate2:
  mov ah, [4013915E]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp2],ah
  mov byte [4013915E],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

  deathCamAutoOffSlot3:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40139386],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate3
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp3]
  mov byte [40139396], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate3:
  mov ah, [40139396]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp3],ah
  mov byte [40139396],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOffSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffSlot4:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [401395BE],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOffActivate4
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp4]
  mov byte [401395CE], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOffActivate4:
  mov ah, [401395CE]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp4],ah
  mov byte [401395CE],0
  jmp backtoGame2

//Automatic Control Mode turned on
deathCamAuto2:
  cmp [deathCamEnabled1], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot1
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot1:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40138F16],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOnActivate1
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp1]
  mov byte [controlSlot1], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate1:
  mov ah, [controlSlot1]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp1],ah
  mov byte [controlSlot1],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled2], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot2
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot2:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [4013914E],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOnActivate2
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp2]
  mov byte [controlSlot2], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate2:
  mov ah, [controlSlot2]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp2],ah
  mov byte [controlSlot2],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled3], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot3
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot3:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [40139386],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOnActivate3
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp3]
  mov byte [controlSlot3], ah
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate3:
  mov ah, [controlSlot3]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp3],ah
  mov byte [controlSlot3],0
  cmp [deathCamEnabled4], 1
  je deathCamAutoOnSlot4
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnSlot4:
//On Death, move Control Mode to Temp, then set it to Auto
  cmp byte [401395BE],0 //Character State (0 = Alive, 1 = Dead)
  je deathCamAutoOnActivate4
//Else, move Temp to Control Mode
  mov ah, [deathCamTemp4]
  mov byte [controlSlot4], ah
  jmp backtoGame2

deathCamAutoOnActivate4:
  mov ah, [controlSlot4]
  mov byte [deathCamTemp4],ah
  mov byte [controlSlot4],0
  jmp backtoGame2

backtoGame2:
  pop eax
  mov [r8],dx
  movzx edx,dx
  jmp return

deathCamTemp1:
dd 0

deathCamTemp2:
dd 0

deathCamTemp3:
dd 0

deathCamTemp4:
dd 0

deathCamEnabled1:
dd 1

deathCamEnabled2:
dd 1

deathCamEnabled3:
dd 1

deathCamEnabled4:
dd 1

statusInject:
  jmp newmem
  nop
  nop

return:
```

```CT
-- By "25094" on GitHub
function GetEmuBase()
local command = 0xB118
local emuHWND = findWindow("PPSSPPWnd")

local pointer = {}

local result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 0)
pointer[1] = tonumber(result)

result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 1)
pointer[2] = tonumber(result)

local lower = pointer[1]
local upper = pointer[2]
local combinedPointer = (upper * 0x100000000) + lower

return tonumber(combinedPointer)
end

function toHex(str)
         return string.format("%X", str)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local function mainloop()
               if (getOpenedProcessID() ~= 0) and not (readInteger(process) == nil) and
               (getAddressSafe("CWCheat_base") ~= nil) and (readInteger("CWCheat_base") ~= nil) then
                  --execute scripts
                  for i in pairs(script_tbl) do
                      _G[script_tbl[i]]()
                  end
               else
                   script_tbl = {}
                   timer.Enabled = false
                   timer.Destroy()
                   timer = nil
               end
end

if process and readInteger(process) and (string.lower(process):match("ppsspp")) then
   local ptr = GetEmuBase()

   if not (ptr == nil) and not (ptr == 0) then
      registerSymbol("DataStart",ptr+0x8804000)
      registerSymbol("PSP_base",ptr)
      registerSymbol("CWCheat_base",ptr+0x8800000)
   else
      print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
      r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(DataStart,? ? ? 68 98 08 04 3C)
      registersymbol(DataStart)
      define(PSP_base, DataStart-0x8804000)
      define(CWCheat_base, DataStart-0x4000)
      registersymbol(PSP_base)
      registersymbol(CWCheat_base)]])

      if (r==false) then
         local errormsg = "Make sure the game is running!"

         showMessage(errormsg)
         error(errormsg)
      end
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") or (mf.ToAddress.Text == "7fffffffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "PSP_base"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "PSP_base+"..toHex(0x03FFFFFF)
   end
else
    local errormsg = "Not attached to PPSSPP"

    showMessage(errormsg)
    error(errormsg)
    return
end

if (script_tbl == nil) then
    script_tbl = {}
end

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end

local script_name = "btl_char_struct_data"

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.beginEdit()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtSingle) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDouble) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end

          memoryrecord.endEdit()
      end
end

local template = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("85416")

_G[script_name] = function()
                   local base = getAddress("PSP_base")
                   base = base + 0x8AF1F30

                   btlCharCount = 0
                   local num_of_allies = readBytes(base + 0x5F4, 1, false)
                   local num_of_enemies = readBytes(base + 0x5F5, 1, false)
                   btlCharCount = num_of_allies + num_of_enemies

                   if (currBtlCharCount == nil) then
                      currBtlCharCount = -1
                   end

                   if not (btlCharCount == currBtlCharCount) and (btlCharCount ~= nil) then
                      if (memrec.Count &gt; btlCharCount) then
                         for i = memrec.Count, btlCharCount + 1, -1 do
                             memoryrecord_delete(memrec.Child[i - 1])
                         end
                      elseif (memrec.Count &lt; btlCharCount) then
                             for i = memrec.Count + 1, btlCharCount, 1 do
                                 if (i &gt; 20) then
                                    break
                                 end

                                 --HEADER
                                 local charHeader = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                 charHeader.beginEdit()
                                 charHeader.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                                 charHeader.Description = "Character "..i
                                 charHeader.Address = "PSP_base + (DWORD)[PSP_base + 0x8AF1F30 + 0xFC0 + " .. toHex((i - 1) * 0x4) .. "]"
                                 charHeader.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                                 charHeader.DontSave = true
                                 charHeader.appendToEntry(memrec)

                                 copyMemRecRecursive(charHeader, template)
                                 charHeader.endEdit()
                             end
                      end

                   currBtlCharCount = btlCharCount
                   end
end

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name
```

```CT
-- By "25094" on GitHub
function GetEmuBase()
local command = 0xB118
local emuHWND = findWindow("PPSSPPWnd")

local pointer = {}

local result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 0)
pointer[1] = tonumber(result)

result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 1)
pointer[2] = tonumber(result)

local lower = pointer[1]
local upper = pointer[2]
local combinedPointer = (upper * 0x100000000) + lower

return tonumber(combinedPointer)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if process and readInteger(process) and (string.lower(process):match("ppsspp")) then
   local ptr = GetEmuBase()

   if not (ptr == nil) and not (ptr == 0) then
      registerSymbol("PSP_base",ptr)
      registerSymbol("CWCheat_base",ptr+0x8800000)
   else
      showMessage("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")

      local r, aaError = autoAssemble(
      [[aobscan(DataStart,? ? ? 27 21 68 A0 00)
      define(PSP_base, DataStart-0x8804000)
      define(CWCheat_base, DataStart-0x4000)
      registersymbol(PSP_base)
      registersymbol(CWCheat_base)]])

      if (r==false) then
         local errormsg = "Make sure the game is running!"

         showMessage(errormsg)
         error(errormsg)
      end
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") or (mf.ToAddress.Text == "7fffffffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "PSP_base"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "PSP_base+"..toHex(0x03FFFFFF)
   end
else
    local errormsg = "Not attached to PPSSPP"

    showMessage(errormsg)
    error(errormsg)
    return
end
```

`README.md`:

```md
 # Tales of Cheat Engine tables

These tables were originally meant to be for myself, but I am releasing all of them here. 
Note that unless you use the exact version of the game and emulator, certain things might not work.
This does **NOT** mean you need the emulators or version listed. Please test the latest first.

Having trouble? See the [troubleshooting](https://github.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/blob/master/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) page.

[Click here to see the changelog.](https://github.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

Below is a listing of features for each table and patch.

 # Cheat Tables
 
 ## Abyss (PS2)
Based on the SLUS21386 version of the game.
 
Emulator used: PCSX2 v.1.7.0-dev-1612-g1180de51f

 - Change the loaded map
 - Change Luke's hair to short or long
 - Stats Editor
 - Equipment Editor
 - Arte List Editor

 ## Innocence R
Available for PCSG00009.

Features:
```
