```md
   - Each player gets to control a character in battle, with every mechanic fully functional
   - Player 2-4 can also open and control the battle menu, while locking out other players
   - Player 1 can press Triangle + START while another player opened the battle menu to take back control
   - The arte menu now has the ability to change control mode
   - Character cycling in battle takes into consideration whether a character is auto or not
   - Camera takes focus of every non auto character (and stops focusing if they are dead)
   - Audio is now played from every non auto character
   - Each player gets their own target indicator
   - Stage edge is displayed for every non auto character
   
 
 ### Installation guide for the VitaCheat database files:
    Edit the file according to your needs. The file shows which lines and what to edit.

  **Vita and Vita TV**:
    
	  Install and setup VitaCheat (https://github.com/r0ah/vitacheat/wiki/Quick-Start)
      Place the files into ux0:vitacheat/db/
      Enable it on the overlay (or edit _V0 to _V1)
  
  **Vita3K**:
    
	  Place the files into Vita3K/cheats/
      Enable it in Manage -> Cheats (or edit _V0 to _V1)

 ### Installation guide for the multiplayer patch:
  **Vita, Vita TV and Vita3K**:
  
    Place the files into ux0:tai/
  
  **Vita**:
  
    Install and setup MiniVitaTV (https://github.com/TheOfficialFloW/MiniVitaTV) and pair your controllers.
	
  **Vita3K**:
  
    Enable PS TV mode.
  
  **Vita and Vita TV**:
  
    Edit the config.txt in ux0:tai/ with the following: (create it if it doesn't exist)
    ux0:tai/toir_hr_ctrl.skrpx goes below *KERNEL
	
	*This is required because otherwise controller 2 won't work.
  
  **Vita, Vita TV and Vita3K**:
  
    Edit the config.txt in ux0:tai/ with the following: (create it if it doesn't exist)
    ux0:tai/toir_coop.suprx goes below *PCSG00009. (if it's not in the config, add it)
	
  **Vita, Vita TV**:
    
	Reboot the system.
	
Once in-game, player 2-4 can either change their control mode from the field arte menu, or in battle with select.
  
 #### Troubleshooting:
   If all controllers control slot 1, MiniVitaTV hasn't been setup properly or PS TV mode hasn't been enabled.
   
   If the button hint doesn't appear in the arte menu, the patch isn't loaded. Check if you put the patch in the correct place, and if you setup your config.txt properly.

Thanks to Kevan for testing the multiplayer patch on a real PS Vita.

 ## Hearts R
Available for PCSE00429.

Features:
 - Difficulty value modifiers
 - Guard counter volume modifier (intended for co-op, but can be used without, co-op also does not require using this)
 
 ### Installation guide for the VitaCheat database files:
    Edit the file according to your needs. The file shows which lines and what to edit.

  **Vita and Vita TV**:
    
	  Install and setup VitaCheat (https://github.com/r0ah/vitacheat/wiki/Quick-Start)
      Place the files into ux0:vitacheat/db/
      Enable it on the overlay (or edit _V0 to _V1)
  
  **Vita3K**:
    
	  Place the files into Vita3K/cheats/
      Enable it in Manage -> Cheats (or edit _V0 to _V1)
```

`Rebirth_PS2.CT`:

```CT
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="45">
  <CheatEntries>
    <CheatEntry>
      <ID>1450</ID>
      <Description>"Enable"</Description>
      <Options moHideChildren="1"/>
      <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
      <AssemblerScript>{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

function toHex(str)
         return string.format("%X", str)
end

--tbl_data is at 0x0
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (string.lower(process):match("pcsx2")) then
   if not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("EEmem") == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem"))+0x10007C)
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",readPointer(getAddress("EEmem")))
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,11 00 00 00 11 00 00 70 13 00 00 00 13 00 00 70 00 00 19 04) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
        registerSymbol("baseEEmem",getAddress("baseElfAddr")-0x10007C)
   end

   local mf = getMainForm()
   if (mf.FromAddress.Text == "0000000000000000") and (mf.ToAddress.Text == "00007fffffffffff") then
      mf.FromAddress.Text = "baseEEmem"
      mf.ToAddress.Text = "baseEEmem+"..toHex(0x20000000)
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PCSX2"))
   return
end
{$asm}
alloc(tbl_data,$1000)
registersymbol(tbl_data)
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)
unregistersymbol(baseEEmem)
dealloc(tbl_data)
unregistersymbol(tbl_data)
</AssemblerScript>

          <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local function mainloop()

      local equipPageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+1DE3D4")
      local itemPageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+1DF464")
      local enhancePageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+1E0264")

      --Hover check
      if not (readInteger("gemNum+8") == 0) then
           if not (readInteger("baseElfAddr") == nil) then
                 --print(equipPageHover..", "..itemPageHover..", "..enhancePageHover)
                 --equip page hover
                 if (equipPageHover &gt; 511) and (equipPageHover &lt; 3005) then
                        itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+1DE3D5")
                        --print(1)
                        itemCheck(equipPageHover)
                 --item page hover
                 elseif (itemPageHover &gt; 511) and (itemPageHover &lt; 3005) then
                        itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+1DF465")
                        --print(2)
                        itemCheck(itemPageHover)
                 --enhance page hover
                 elseif (enhancePageHover &gt; 511) and (enhancePageHover &lt; 3005) then
                        itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+1E0265")
                        --print(3)
                        itemCheck(enhancePageHover)
                 end
           end
      end
end

function itemCheck(item)
         if not (item == 0) and not (item == nil) then

            if (item &lt; 512) or (item &gt; 1084) then
               return
            else
                if (itemType == 2) then
                   item = item - 512
                elseif (itemType == 3) then
                   item = item - 768
                elseif (itemType == 4) then
                   item = item - 1024
                end
            end

            writeInteger(getAddress("gemNum"), item)
            else
               return
            end
end

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end
{$asm}
globalalloc(gemNum,1000)

gemNum+8:
  dq 1

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if (timer) then
   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end
```

```CT
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<CheatTable CheatEngineTableVersion="45">

-- By "25094" on GitHub
function GetEmuBase()
local command = 0xB118
local emuHWND = findWindow("PPSSPPWnd")

local pointer = {}

local result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 0)
pointer[1] = tonumber(result)

result = sendMessage(emuHWND, command, 0, 1)
pointer[2] = tonumber(result)

local lower = pointer[1]
local upper = pointer[2]
local combinedPointer = (upper * 0x100000000) + lower

return tonumber(combinedPointer)
end
{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if (string.lower(process):match("ppsspp")) then
   local ptr = GetEmuBase()

   if not (ptr == nil) and not (ptr == 0) then
        registerSymbol("baseElfAddr",ptr+0x8804000+0x18)
   else
        print("Using fallback... this may take a few seconds")
        r,error=autoAssemble([[aobscan(baseElfAddr,E0 FF BD 27 14 00 BF AF 31 10 20 0E) // should be unique
registersymbol(baseElfAddr)]])
        if (r==false) then
           error(print(error .. "\nMake sure the game is running!"))
        end
   end
else
   error(print("Not attached to PPSSPP"))
   return
end
{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(baseElfAddr)

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local function mainloop()

      local equipPageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+3B9138")
      --local itemPageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+3BC1F8")
      local enhancePageHover = readSmallInteger("baseElfAddr+3BC1F8")

      --Hover check
      if not (readInteger("gemNum+8") == 0) then
           if not (readInteger("baseElfAddr") == nil) then
                 --equip page hover
                 if (equipPageHover &gt; 511) and (equipPageHover &lt; 3005) then
                        itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+3B9139")
                        --print(1)
                        itemCheck(equipPageHover)

                 --doesn't stay in memory so ignore
                 --item page hover
                 --elseif (itemPageHover &gt; 511) and (itemPageHover &lt; 3005) then
                 --       itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+3BC1F9")
                 --       --print(2)
                 --       itemCheck(itemPageHover)

                 --enhance page hover
                 elseif (enhancePageHover &gt; 511) and (enhancePageHover &lt; 3005) then
                        itemType = readByte("baseElfAddr+3BC1F9")
                        --print(3)
                        itemCheck(enhancePageHover)
                 end
           end
      end
end

function itemCheck(item)
         if not (item == 0) and not (item == nil) then

            if (item &lt; 512) or (item &gt; 1084) then
               return
            else
                if (itemType == 2) then
                   item = item - 512
                elseif (itemType == 3) then
                   item = item - 768
                elseif (itemType == 4) then
                   item = item - 1024
                end
            end

            writeInteger(getAddress("gemNum"), item)
            else
               return
            end
end

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end
{$asm}
globalalloc(gemNum,8)

gemNum+8:
  dq 1

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

if (timer) then
   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end
```

```CT
[ENABLE]

aobscanmodule(arteProp,TOS.exe,8B 8F BC 84 8D 00) // should be unique
alloc(newmem,$1000)
globalalloc(artePropPTR,8)
//fullaccess(arteProp,6)
label(code)
label(return)

newmem:
  mov ecx,edi
  add ecx,8D84BC
  mov [artePropPTR],ecx

local script_name = "btl_char_data"

local al = getAddressList()
local btlCharCount
local playerCharCount
local enemyCharCount
local currPlayerCharCount = 0
local currEnemyCharCount = 0
local template = al.getMemoryRecordByID("1976")

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = al.createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtSingle) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDouble) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end
      end
end

_G[script_name] = function()
                if not (readInteger("tbl_data") == 0) then
                   playerCharCount = readByte(readInteger("tbl_data") + 0x934C)--0x936C) --players
                   enemyCharCount = readByte(readInteger("tbl_data") + 0x934D)--0x936D) --enemy
                   btlCharCount = playerCharCount + enemyCharCount

                   --print(playerCharCount..", "..enemyCharCount)
                   --print("Curr: "..currPlayerCharCount..", "..currEnemyCharCount)

                   if not (playerCharCount == currPlayerCharCount) or
                   not (enemyCharCount == currEnemyCharCount) then
                         for i = memrec.Count, 1, -1 do
                             memrec.Child[i - 1].Destroy()
                         end

                         local currChar = 0
                         for i = memrec.Count + 1, btlCharCount, 1 do
                             if (i &gt; 20) then
                                break
                             end

                             --HEADER
                             local charHeader = al.createMemoryRecord()

                             charHeader.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                             charHeader.Description = "Character "..i
                             charHeader.Address = "tbl_data"
                             charHeader.OffsetCount = 1
                             if (i &gt; playerCharCount) then
                                if not (currChar &gt;= 4) then
                                   currChar = 4
                                end
                             end
                             charHeader.Offset[0] = (0x13BE0 * currChar) + 0x132A0
                             --charHeader.Offset[0] = 0x20 + (0x13BE0 * currChar) + 0x132A0-- + 0x8
                             charHeader.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                             charHeader.DontSave = true
                             charHeader.appendToEntry(memrec)

                             copyMemRecRecursive(charHeader, template)

                             currChar = currChar + 1
                         end

                         currPlayerCharCount = playerCharCount
                         currEnemyCharCount = enemyCharCount
                   end
                end
end

  jmp newmem
  nop

local dropdownList = createStringlist()

local partyFormation = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("1028")
local address = nil

--normals
for charID = 0, 9, 1 do
    address = (charID * 12) + 0x8E9770-- + getAddress(process)
    address = readInteger(address)

    if (charID ~= 0) then
       dropdownList.add(string.format("%08X", address)..":"..partyFormation.DropDownDescription[charID].." normals")
    else
        dropdownList.add(string.format("%08X", address)..":Unknown")
    end

--artes
local base = readInteger(0xAD2EDC)

if (base == 0) then
   showMessage("Enter a fight first!")
   error("Base address is 0.")
end

local tech_list = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("1307")
local edit_list = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("3374")
address = nil

local function calc_arte_atk_tbl_address(arteID)
    local attackID = arteID * 0x4
    local address = (attackID * 0x8) - attackID
    address = readInteger(base + 0x9A58) + address * 0x4
    address = readInteger(address + 0xC) --some pointers to other data? should investigate later
    return address
end

for arteID = 0, 254, 1 do
    address = calc_arte_atk_tbl_address(arteID)
    if (address ~= 0) then
       for arteEntry = 0, 3, 1 do
           dropdownList.add(string.format("%08X", address)..":"..tech_list.DropDownDescription[arteID + 2])
           --print("0x"..string.format("%X", address).." arte: \""..tech_list.DropDownDescription[arteID + 2].."\" ("..arteID.."), entry "..arteEntry)
           address = address + 0x1C
       end
    end
end

edit_list.DropDownList.Text = dropdownList.Text
edit_list.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = true

dropdownList.destroy()
dropdownList = nil
```

`TROUBLESHOOTING.md`:

```md
# Troubleshooting

### How do I download a specific table?
1. Click on the table on the GitHub.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/DownloadSpecificTable1.png)

2. Right click on the "Raw" button.
3. Click "Save link as..."

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/DownloadSpecificTable2.png)

### How do I download all tables?
1. Click the green "Code" button 
2. Click "Download ZIP".

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/DownloadAllTables.png)

All the tables should be included in it.
 
### The first script doesn't enable!
Make sure you have the MEM_MAPPED setting enabled.
1. Click Edit.
2. Click Settings.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/EditSettings.png)

3. Click Scan Settings.
4. Tick MEM_MAPPED box.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/MEM_MAPPED.png)


### Values don't show up!
Make sure you have every Big Endian types enabled.
1. Click Edit.
2. Click Settings.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/EditSettings.png)

3. Click Extra Custom Types.
4. Tick all 3 boxes.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/master/images/ExtraCustomTypes.png)

### Some scripts won't enable!
Some scripts will require the listed emulator (and maybe even the game version, but this is not guaranteed) version, there isn't much I can do about this, unfortunately.

#### Still can't solve your problem? [Open an issue ticket.](https://github.com/Sora3100/Tales_of_Cheat_Tables/issues/new)

```

```CT
function toHex(str)
  return string.upper(string.format("%X", str))
end

{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}

if (script_tbl == nil) then
    script_tbl = {}
end

local function mainloop()
               if (getOpenedProcessID() ~= 0) and not (readInteger(process) == nil) then
                  --execute scripts
                  for i in pairs(script_tbl) do
                      _G[script_tbl[i]]()
                  end
               else
                   script_tbl = {}
                   timer.Enabled = false
                   timer.Destroy()
                   timer = nil
               end
end


if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

local script_name = "arte_prop_editor"

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name

--RecID is the ID of the Memory Record that is going to have its DropDown changed (aka Parameter)
--offset is the offset of the Condition # address
function arteConditionChange(RecID,offset)
         local currRecord = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(RecID)
               if (readInteger("[artePropPTR]+"..offset) == 2) then
                  currRecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "Arte List"
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = true
                  currRecord.Options = ""
         --Skills unlocks
               elseif (readInteger("[artePropPTR]+"..offset) == 3) then
                  currRecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Skills"
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = true
                  currRecord.Options = "moAlwaysHideChildren"
                  currRecord.Child[0].Active = false
               else
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = false
                  currRecord.Options = "moAlwaysHideChildren"
                  currRecord.Child[0].Active = false
               end
         currRecord = nil
end

--RecID is the ID of the Memory Record that is going to have its DropDown changed (aka Parameter)
--offset is the offset of the Condition # address
function evolveConditionChange(RecID,offset)
         local currRecord = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(RecID)
               if (readInteger("[artePropPTR]+"..offset) == 2) then
                  currRecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "Arte List"
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = true
               elseif (readInteger("[artePropPTR]+"..offset) == 3) then
                  currRecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Skills"
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = true
               else
                  currRecord.DropDownLinked = false
               end
         currRecord = nil
end

function CharArteUseCheck()
         local header = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("83301")
         local NumofCharChildren = header.Count-1
         local AmountofChars = tonumber(header.Child[0].Value)

         if not (NumofCharChildren == AmountofChars) then

            local offset = nil

            if (NumofCharChildren &gt; AmountofChars) then
               for i = NumofCharChildren, AmountofChars+1,-1 do
                   header.Child[i].destroy()
               end
            end

            if (NumofCharChildren &lt; AmountofChars) then
               for i = NumofCharChildren+1, AmountofChars do
                   if (i &gt; 524) then
                      break --Too many to do, there are only 524 enemies
                   end
               local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

               offset = 0x188 + 4 * (i - 1)

               newrec.Type = 2
               newrec.setAddress("artePropPTR")
               newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
               newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
               newrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Enemy List"
               newrec.DropDownLinked = true
               newrec.setDescription("Character "..i)
               newrec.DontSave = true
               newrec.appendToEntry(header)
               end
            end
         end
end

_G[script_name] = function()
            if not (readPointer("artePropPTR") == 0) and not (readPointer("artePropPTR") == nil) then
               --Arte unlock conditions
               if (getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("84822").Active == true) then
                  arteConditionChange("79081","60") -- #1
                  arteConditionChange("79082","64") -- #2
                  arteConditionChange("84809","68") -- #3
                  arteConditionChange("84811","6C") -- #4
                  arteConditionChange("84813","70") -- #5
                  arteConditionChange("84815","74") -- #6
               end

               --Evolve conditions
               if (getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("83300").Active == true) then
                  evolveConditionChange("79152","120") -- #1
                  evolveConditionChange("79153","124") -- #2
                  evolveConditionChange("79154","128") -- #3
                  evolveConditionChange("79155","12C") -- #4
               end

               --Character use check
               if (getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("83301").Active == true) then
                  CharArteUseCheck()
               end
            end
end

  cmp [currAreaPTR+8],2
  jb @f
  jg code
  mov [currAreaPTR],r8
@@:
  add [currAreaPTR+8],1
code:
  cmp byte ptr [r8],00
  mov rax,r8
  jmp return

  jmp newmem
  nop
  nop
return:

newmem2:
  mov [currAreaPTR+10],rax
code2:
  movss xmm1,[rax+04]
  jmp return2

currCoords:
  jmp newmem2
return2:
registersymbol(currArea currAreaPTR currCoords)

local script_name = "btl_unit_data"

script_tbl[memrec.ID] = script_name

local al = getAddressList()
local btlCharCount
local currBtlCharCount = 0
local template = al.getMemoryRecordByID("89713")

local function copyMemRecRecursive(header, currTemplate)
      for i = 0, currTemplate.Count - 1, 1 do
          local memoryrecord = al.createMemoryRecord()

          memoryrecord.Description = currTemplate.Child[i].Description

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
             memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
          elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].IsAddressGroupHeader == true) and (currTemplate.Child[i].IsGroupHeader == true) then
               memoryrecord.IsGroupHeader = true
               memoryrecord.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
          else
              memoryrecord.Type = currTemplate.Child[i].Type

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByte) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtWord) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtQword) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtSingle) or
              (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtDouble) then
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                 memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtString) then
                     memoryrecord.String.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Size
                     memoryrecord.String.Unicode = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Unicode
                     memoryrecord.String.Codepage = currTemplate.Child[i].String.Codepage
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtByteArray) then
                     memoryrecord.Aob.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Aob.Size
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtBinary) then
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Startbit = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Startbit
                     memoryrecord.Binary.Size = currTemplate.Child[i].Binary.Size
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtAutoAssembler) then
                     memoryrecord.Script = currTemplate.Child[i].Script
              elseif (currTemplate.Child[i].Type == vtCustom) then
                     memoryrecord.CustomTypeName = currTemplate.Child[i].CustomTypeName
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsHex = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsHex
                     memoryrecord.ShowAsSigned = currTemplate.Child[i].ShowAsSigned
              end

              if (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinked == false) and (currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec == "") then
                  memoryrecord.DropDownList.Text = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownList.Text
                  memoryrecord.DisplayAsDropDownListItem = currTemplate.Child[i].DisplayAsDropDownListItem
              else
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinkedMemrec = currTemplate.Child[i].DropDownLinkedMemrec
                  memoryrecord.DropDownLinked = true
              end
          end

          memoryrecord.Address = currTemplate.Child[i].Address

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount &gt; 0) then
             memoryrecord.OffsetCount = currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount

             for j = 0, currTemplate.Child[i].OffsetCount - 1, 1 do
                 memoryrecord.Offset[j] = currTemplate.Child[i].Offset[j]
             end
          end

          memoryrecord.Options = currTemplate.Child[i].Options
          memoryrecord.Color = currTemplate.Child[i].Color
          memoryrecord.DontSave = true
          memoryrecord.appendToEntry(header)

          if (currTemplate.Child[i].Count &gt; 0) then
             copyMemRecRecursive(memoryrecord, currTemplate.Child[i])
          end
      end
end

_G[script_name] = function()
                if not (readQword("tbl_data") == 0) then
                   local base = readQword("tbl_data")
                   local finalAddr = readQword(base + 0xBD0)
                   btlCharCount = 0
                   local addr = readQword(base + 0xBC8)

                   --get amount of chars
                   while (addr &lt; finalAddr) do
                         if (btlCharCount &gt; 200) then
                            break
                         end

                         btlCharCount = btlCharCount + 1
                         addr = addr + 0x8
                   end

                   if not (btlCharCount == currBtlCharCount) then
                      if (memrec.Count &gt; btlCharCount) then
                         for i = memrec.Count, btlCharCount + 1, -1 do
                             memrec.Child[i - 1].Destroy()
                         end
                      elseif (memrec.Count &lt; btlCharCount) then
                             for i = memrec.Count + 1, btlCharCount, 1 do
                                 if (i &gt; 20) then
                                    break
                                 end

                                 --HEADER
                                 local charHeader = al.createMemoryRecord()

                                 charHeader.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                                 charHeader.Description = "Character "..i
                                 charHeader.Address = "tbl_data"
                                 charHeader.OffsetCount = 3
                                 charHeader.Offset[2] = 0xBC8
                                 charHeader.Offset[1] = 0x8 * (i - 1)
                                 charHeader.Offset[0] = 0x790
                                 charHeader.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                                 charHeader.DontSave = true
                                 charHeader.appendToEntry(memrec)

                                 copyMemRecRecursive(charHeader, template)
                             end
                      end

                   currBtlCharCount = btlCharCount
                   end
                end
end
{$asm}

aobscanmodule(btl_unit_data,TOV_DE.exe,49 8B 85 60 0C 00 00) // should be unique
alloc(newmem,$1000,btl_unit_data)

label(code)
label(return)

newmem:
  mov rax,tbl_data
  mov [rax],r13
code:
  mov rax,[r13+00000C60]
  jmp return

btl_unit_data:
  jmp newmem
  nop 2
return:
registersymbol(btl_unit_data)
```

```CT
if syntaxcheck then return end

function toHex(str)
  if str and (str ~= "") then
     return string.format("%X", str)
  end
  return ""
end

function get_mono_method(image_name, namespace, class_name, method_name)
  if (namespace == nil) or (class_name == nil) or (method_name == "") or (method_name == nil) then
     print("An argument was not specified for get_mono_method()")
     return 0
  end
  if (image_name == "") or (image_name == nil) then
     image_name = "Assembly-CSharp.dll"
  end

  local assems = mono_enumAssemblies()
  local class = nil
  local method = nil
  local count = 0
  local instance = nil

  for i, addr in ipairs(assems) do
      local image = mono_getImageFromAssembly(addr)
      local img_name = mono_image_get_name(image)

      if (img_name == image_name) then
         --print("Got Assembly-CSharp")
         local classes = mono_image_enumClasses(image)
         for j, cls_addr in ipairs(classes) do
            if (classes[j].namespace == namespace) then
               --print("Found namespace")
               if (classes[j].classname == class_name) then
                  --print("Found class")
                  class = classes[j].class
                  local methods = mono_class_enumMethods(class)

                  for k, name_of_method in ipairs(methods) do
                      if (methods[k].name == method_name) then
                         method = methods[k].method
                         instances = mono_class_findInstancesOfClassListOnly(nil, class)

                         for n, value in ipairs(instances) do
                             --print(n..": "..toHex(value))
                             count = count + 1
                         end

                         --print(toHex(instances[count]))
                         return method, instances[count]
                      end
                  end
               end
            end
         end
      end
  end

  return 0, 0
end

                           writeQword("tbl_data+38", result)
end

   writeQword("tbl_data+28", 1)
end

label(return)

  xor eax,eax
  movups [rsp+40],xmm0
  mov [rsp+50],rax
  jmp return

MonsterDetailList.SetViewMonsterData+11F:
  jmp newmem
  nop

return:

function encounter_createMember(val1, val2)
    local obj = mono_object_new(encounter_member_class)
    if obj == 0 or obj == nil then error("Could not allocate BTL.ENCOUNTER_GROUP_MEMBER object") end
    writeInteger(obj + 0x10, val1)
    writeInteger(obj + 0x14, val2)
    return obj
end

function enemies_header_update()
         local enemy_header_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118774")

         local enemy_count = readQword("tbl_data+80")
         enemy_count = readQword(enemy_count + 0x38)
         enemy_count = readInteger(enemy_count + 0x18)

         --print(enemy_count)
         --print(enemy_header_memrec.Count)

         if (enemy_header_memrec.Count &lt; enemy_count) then --add
            --print("add")
            for i = enemy_header_memrec.Count + 1, enemy_count, 1 do
                if (i &gt; 100) then break end
                --print("Creating record "..i)
                local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                header.beginEdit()
                header.Description = "Enemy " .. i
                header.Address = "+0"
                header.OffsetCount = 3
                header.Offset[0] = 0x10
                header.Offset[1] = 0x20 + (i - 1) * 0x8
                header.Offset[2] = 0x10
                header.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Enemy List"
                header.DropDownLinked = true
                header.DontSave = true
                header.appendToEntry(enemy_header_memrec)

                local group = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                group.beginEdit()
                group.Description = "Group"
                group.Address = "+4"
                group.DontSave = true
                group.appendToEntry(header)

                group.endEdit()
                header.endEdit()
            end
         elseif (enemy_header_memrec.Count &gt; enemy_count) then --delete
                --print("del")
                for i = enemy_header_memrec.Count, enemy_count + 1, -1 do
                    --print("Destroying "..enemy_header_memrec.Child[i - 1].Description)
                    enemy_header_memrec.Child[i - 1].Destroy()
                end
         end
end

                  local value = tonumber(edit.Text)
                  if not value then
                      showMessage("The input was empty or invalid!")
                      return
                  end

                  --showMessage("The input was: "..value or "")

                  if (value &gt; 10) or (value == 0) then
                     local result = messageDialog("Are you sure you want to fight "..value.." enemies?", mtConfirmation, mbYes, mbNo)

                     if (result == mrNo) then
                        return
                     end
                  end

                  if (value == enemy_count) then return end

                  if (value &gt; enemy_count) then
                     for i = enemy_count, value - 1, 1 do
                         mono_invoke_method(nil, encounter_member_addMethod, listObj, {encounter_createMember(42, 0)})
                     end
                  elseif (value &lt; enemy_count) then
                         for i = enemy_count, value + 1, -1 do
                             mono_invoke_method(nil, encounter_member_removeAtMethod, listObj, {(i - 1)})
                         end
                  end

                  enemies_header_update()
                  form.close()
end

             memrec.Active = false
             getMainForm().setFocus()
end

else

        for current_category, data in pairs(categories) do
            --[[
            if data.value ~= "" and data.value ~= nil and data.object ~= "" and data.object ~= nil then
               print("Character: "..current_character..", category: "..current_category..", value: "..data.value..", object: 0x"..toHex(data.object))
            else
                print("Character: "..current_character..", category: "..current_category)
            end
            ]]
            local class_ptr = readPointer(data.object)
            local class_address, class_name = mono_object_getClass(data.object)
            --[[
            print(readInteger(data.object))
            print(class_ptr)
            print(class_address)
            print(class_name)
            ]]
            if (readInteger(data.object) == nil) or class_ptr == nil or class_ptr == 0 or class_address == nil or class_name == nil or class_name == "" then
               --print("Removing category from gc_handles table: " .. current_category)
               --mono_invoke_method(nil, GCHandleFree, gc_handles[current_character][current_category]["object"], {}) --free it as it's not in use anymore

               gc_handles[current_character][current_category] = nil
               --gc_handles[current_character][current_category]["value"] = nil
               --gc_handles[current_character][current_category]["object"] = nil
            end
        end
    end
end

--required game functions for script to work

local function getMonoStaticField_API(namespace, className, fieldName)
    local class = mono_findClass(namespace, className)
    if not class or class == 0 then return nil, "Class not found" end

    local fields = mono_class_enumFields(class, true)
    local target = nil
    for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
        if f.name == fieldName and f.isStatic then
            target = f
            break
        end
    end
    if not target then return nil, "Static field not found" end

    -- Get value via Mono Data Collector
    local vtable = mono_class_getVTable(0, class)
    local rawValue = mono_getStaticFieldValue(vtable, target.field)

    -- Type interpretation helper
    if target.monotype == 0x0E or target.typename == "System.String" then
        return mono_string_readString(rawValue) -- String
    elseif target.monotype &gt;= 0x04 and target.monotype &lt;= 0x0B then
        return rawValue -- Integers/Bytes
    elseif target.monotype == 0x02 then
        return rawValue ~= 0 -- Boolean
    else
        return rawValue -- Pointer or unknown type
    end
end

local function create_script(enable_code, disable_code)
         local script = "[ENABLE]\r\n{$lua}\r\nif syntaxcheck then return end\r\n"..enable_code.."\r\n{$asm}\r\n[DISABLE]\r\n{$lua}\r\nif syntaxcheck then return end\r\n"..disable_code.."\r\n{$asm}"
         return script
end

local function multiple_string_handler(source_memrec, parent_memrec, disable_code, pin_type, current_character)
         --handle multiple dropdown values
         for current_string = 1, source_memrec.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option (l = dropdown entry)
             local sub_record = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()
             sub_record.beginEdit()
             sub_record.Type = vtAutoAssembler
             sub_record.DontSave = true
             sub_record.Description = source_memrec.DropDownDescription[current_string]
             sub_record.appendToEntry(parent_memrec)

             local code = source_memrec.DropDownValue[current_string]
             enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
             enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"".. pin_type .."\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"

             sub_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code)
             sub_record.endEdit()
         end
end

local function contains_arte(arte_id, template_data)
      local arte_size = template_data.DropDownCount / unit_ability_size

      for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
          local current_arte_entry = current_arte * unit_ability_size

          if (arte_id == tonumber(template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry])) then
             return true
          end
      end

      return false
end

function arte_list_cleanup(character_to_clean, template_data)
         local template_data = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID(template_data)

         for current_character = 1, #character_names, 1 do
             local current_character_instance = mono_invoke_method(nil, pc_status_get, pc_status_instance, {current_character})

             if (current_character == character_to_clean) then
                --regular slots
                for current_page = 0, 1, 1 do
                    for current_slot = 0, 3, 1 do
                        local arte_id = mono_invoke_method(nil, slot_magic_arts_get, current_character_instance, {{type=vtDword, value=current_page},{type=vtDword, value=current_slot}})

                        if not contains_arte(arte_id, template_data) then
                           mono_invoke_method(nil, slot_magic_arts_set, current_character_instance, {{type=vtDword, value=current_page},{type=vtDword, value=current_slot},{type=vtDword, value=0}})
                        end
                    end
                end
             end

             --shortcuts
             --only clean if the user points to the selected character
             for current_page = 0, 1, 1 do
                 for current_slot = 0, 3, 1 do
                     local user_id = mono_invoke_method(nil, shortcut_slot_user_get, current_character_instance, {{type=vtDword, value=current_page},{type=vtDword, value=current_slot}})

                     if (user_id == character_to_clean) and (user_id ~= 0) then
                        local arte_id = mono_invoke_method(nil, shortcut_slot_magic_arts_get, current_character_instance, {{type=vtDword, value=current_page},{type=vtDword, value=current_slot}})

                        if not contains_arte(arte_id, template_data) then
                           mono_invoke_method(nil, shortcut_slot_magic_arts_set, current_character_instance, {{type=vtDword, value=current_page},{type=vtDword, value=current_slot},{type=vtDword, value=0},{type=vtDword, value=0}})
                        end
                     end
                 end
             end
         end
end

--category: ga/slash effect/model etc
--value: MDF_JUR_000 etc
--object: address of the object itself

function process_gc_handle(current_character, category, value, object)
         if gc_handles[current_character] then
            if gc_handles[current_character][category] then
               if gc_handles[current_character][category]["value"] and gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"] then
                  --only free if its the only one in the table
                  --print("Freeing object " .. gc_handles[current_character][category]["value"] .. " (category " .. category .. ") at 0x" .. toHex(gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"]))
                  mono_invoke_method(nil, GCHandleFree, gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"], {})

                  --print("Removing from table")
                  --gc_handles[current_character][category] = nil

                  --this technically should never run
                  if value == "" then
                     --print("Value is empty, freeing object " .. gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"] .. " (category " .. category .. ")")
                     mono_invoke_method(nil, GCHandleFree, gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"], {})

                     gc_handles[current_character][category] = nil
                  end
               else
                   --print("Skipping freeing of object (category " .. category .. ")")
               end

               if (value == "") then
                  --print("Skipping pinning of object (category " .. category .. ")")
                  gc_handles[current_character][category] = nil
                  goto _skip_alloc
               end

               --print("Pinning object " .. value .. " (category " .. category .. ") at 0x" .. toHex(object))

               --alloc
               mono_invoke_method(nil, GCHandleAlloc, nil, {{type=vtPointer, value=object}})

               gc_handles[current_character][category]["value"] = value
               gc_handles[current_character][category]["object"] = object
               ::_skip_alloc::
            else --category
                 --add category if it doesn't exist
                 gc_handles[current_character][category] = {}

                 process_gc_handle(current_character, category, value, object)
            end
         else
             --add character if it doesn't exist
             gc_handles[current_character] = {}

             process_gc_handle(current_character, category, value, object)
         end --current_character
end

--new voiceDataName setup
--try fixing, but will most likely crash
local GetVoiceName_bytes = {0x48, 0x8B, 0x54, 0xC2, 0x20, 0x48, 0x8B, 0xCB}
if (table.concat(GetVoiceName_bytes) ~= table.concat(readBytes("BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252", #GetVoiceName_bytes, true))) then
   print("Unexpected BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName bytes, attempting to fix, game might possibly crash")
   writeBytes("BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252", GetVoiceName_bytes)
end

local success = autoAssemble([[
{$STRICT}
assert(BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252, 48 8B 54 C2 20 48 8B CB)
alloc(voiceDataName_mem,$1000)
alloc(voiceDataName_cave,$1000,BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName)
alloc(voiceDataName_ptrs,$1000)

label(original_code)
label(return)

voiceDataName_cave:
  jmp far voiceDataName_mem

//rcx can be freely used as it gets overwritten immediately afterward
voiceDataName_mem:
  mov rcx,voiceDataName_ptrs
  mov rcx,[rcx+rax*8]
  test rcx,rcx //if not filled out, use the game code
  je original_code
  mov rdx,rcx
  jmp return
original_code:
  mov rdx,[rdx+rax*8+20] //original game code
  jmp return

BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252:
  jmp long voiceDataName_cave

return:

registersymbol(voiceDataName_mem)
registersymbol(voiceDataName_cave)
registersymbol(voiceDataName_ptrs)
]])

if not success then
  error("voiceDataName auto assembler failed")
end

--delete old entries if they exist
if (memrec.Count &gt; memrec_count_to_keep) then
   if (debug == true) then
      print("Deleting "..(memrec.Count - memrec_count_to_keep).." memory records.")
   end
   while (memrec.Count &gt; memrec_count_to_keep) do
         memoryrecord_delete(memrec.Child[memrec.Count - 1])
   end
```
