if (debug == true) then
   print("Script START")
end

for current_character = 1, #character_names, 1 do --loop for every character
--for current_character = 1, 1, 1 do --debug
    --iterate_character_data(current_character)
    if (current_character &gt; 10) then --failsafe
       break
    end

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Character: "..character_names[current_character]..", ID: "..current_character)
    end

    local current_character_data = mono_invoke_method(nil, unit_status_get, nil, {current_character})
    local current_character_instance = mono_invoke_method(nil, pc_status_get, pc_status_instance, {current_character}) --1: Jude, 2: Milla etc
    --local current_character_stats = readPointer(current_character_stats + 0x30) --m_Status (CPCStatus.STATUS)

    character_struct = {
    player_id = current_character_data + 0x14, --4 bytes

    --pointers to mono string object
    model = current_character_data + 0x20, --character definition
    attachment = current_character_data + 0x28, --attachment definition
    preload = current_character_data + 0x30, --pre definition
    animation = current_character_data + 0x38, --battle motion definition
    mdf_btl_face = current_character_data + 0x48, --face motion definition
    slash_effect = current_character_data + 0x50, --slash definition
    ldf = current_character_data + 0x58, --look at definition
    ga = current_character_data + 0x60, --ga script

    --floats
    run_speed = current_character_data + 0xB4,
    back_walk_speed = current_character_data + 0xB8,
    turn_speed = current_character_data + 0xBC,
    jump_height = current_character_data + 0xC0,
    brake = current_character_data + 0xC4, --brake
    gravity = current_character_data + 0xC8, --gravity
    damage_brake = current_character_data + 0xCC, --damage brake
    forward_step_distance = current_character_data + 0xD0, --forward step distance
    forward_step_length = current_character_data + 0xD4, --forward step length
    back_step_distance = current_character_data + 0xD8, --backward step distance
    back_step_flight_frame = current_character_data + 0xDC, --backward step flight frame
    back_step_iframes = current_character_data + 0xE0, --backward step invincibility frames

    voice_info = readPointer(current_character_data + 0x1F0) --pointer
    }

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --generate header
    local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()
    header.beginEdit()
    header.IsGroupHeader = true
    header.Description = (character_names[current_character].." -&gt; &lt;char&gt;")
    header.DontSave = true
    --header.Options = "[moHideChildren, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell, moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand, moManualExpandCollapse]"
    header.Options = "[moHideChildren, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
    header.appendToEntry(memrec)
    header.OnActivate = function(memoryrecord, before)
                      if before == true then return true end
                      memoryrecord.Options = memoryrecord.Options:gsub("%]", ", moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand, moManualExpandCollapse]")
    end
    header.OnDeactivate = function(memoryrecord, before)
                        if before == true then return true end
                        memoryrecord.Options = memoryrecord.Options:gsub(",?%s*moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand", ""):gsub(",?%s*moManualExpandCollapse", "")
    end
    header.endEdit()

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Created new header")
    end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    local current_character_template = template_header.Child[current_character]

    --disable code generation
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Disable generation START")
    end

    local current_unit_ability = mono_invoke_method(nil, unit_ability_get, nil, {current_character})
    current_unit_ability = readPointer(current_unit_ability + 0x18)

    local disable_code_player_id = ""
    local disable_code_animation = ""
    local disable_code_model = ""
    local disable_code_attachment = ""
    local disable_code_preload = ""
    local disable_code_mdf_btl_face = ""
    local disable_code_slash_effect = ""
    local disable_code_ldf = ""
    local disable_code_ga = ""
    local disable_code_voices = ""
    local disable_code_movement = ""
    local disable_code_artes = ""
    local enable_code_disable_artes = ""

    for template_entry = 0, current_character_template.Count - 1, 1 do --template_data is the memrecs holding the data, e.g. player_id/model/etc
        local template_data = current_character_template.Child[template_entry]

        if (debug == true) then
           print("Currently processing: "..template_data.Description)
        end

        local code = template_data.DropDownValue[0]
        local address = character_struct[template_data.Description]

        if (template_data.Description == "player_id") then
           disable_code_player_id = "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..code..")"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (template_data.Description == "animation") then
               disable_code_animation = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_animation = disable_code_animation .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"animation\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "model") then
               disable_code_model = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_model = disable_code_model .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"model\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "attachment") then
               disable_code_attachment = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_attachment = disable_code_attachment .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"attachment\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "preload") then
               disable_code_preload = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_preload = disable_code_preload .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"preload\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "mdf_btl_face") then
               disable_code_mdf_btl_face = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_mdf_btl_face = disable_code_mdf_btl_face .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"mdf_btl_face\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "slash_effect") then
               disable_code_slash_effect = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_slash_effect = disable_code_slash_effect .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"slash_effect\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "ldf") then
               disable_code_ldf = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_ldf = disable_code_ldf .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"ldf\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "ga") then
               disable_code_ga = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_ga = disable_code_ga .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"ga\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        elseif (template_data.Description == "voices") then
               address = character_struct["voice_info"]
               local voice_base_address = readPointer(address + 0x10)

               local current_voice_data_template = template_data.Child[0]
               local current_voice_size = (current_voice_data_template.DropDownCount - 1) / 3

               if (debug == true) then
                  print("Processing \""..current_voice_data_template.Description.."\" with a size of "..current_voice_size)
               end

               disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "local str_address\r\n"

               --make the other voices inactive
               for current_voice = 7, current_voice_size, -1 do
                   address = readPointer(voice_base_address + 0x20 + 0x8 * current_voice)

                   disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address + 0x10)..", 0"
                   ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x14)..", 0"
                   ..")\r\nstr_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""
                   .."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address + 0x18)..", str_address)\r\n"

                   disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voice" .. current_voice .. "\", \"\", str_address)\r\n"
               end --current_voice remove loop

               --generate the new voices
               for current_voice = 0, current_voice_size - 1, 1 do --loop through every voice in the template's dropdown
                   local current_voice_entry = current_voice * 3 + 1
                   local voice_string = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry]
                   local start_condition = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+1]
                   local stop_condition = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+2]
                   local voice_name = current_voice_data_template.DropDownDescription[current_voice_entry]
                   address = readPointer(voice_base_address + 0x20 + 0x8 * current_voice)

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Entry "..current_voice..": Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                      ..", Start condition: "..start_condition
                      ..", Stop condition: "..stop_condition
                      ..", Voice: "..voice_string)
                   end

                   disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address + 0x10)..", "..start_condition
                   ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x14)..", "..stop_condition
                   ..")\r\nstr_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..voice_string
                   .."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address + 0x18)..", str_address)\r\n"

                   disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voice" .. current_voice .. "\", \"" .. voice_string .. "\", str_address)\r\n"
               end --current_voice add loop

               --PC exclusive
               address = getAddress("voiceDataName_ptrs") + 0x8 * current_character

               local voiceDataName = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[0]
               if (debug == true) then
                  print("voiceDataName: "..voiceDataName..", Address: 0x"..toHex(address))
               end

               disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "str_address = mono_new_string(\""..voiceDataName.."\")\r\n"
               disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voiceDataName\", \"" .. voiceDataName .. "\", str_address)\r\n"
               disable_code_voices = disable_code_voices .. "writePointer(0x" .. toHex(address) .. ", str_address)"
        elseif (template_data.Description == "movement") then
               for current_movement_entry = 0, template_data.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option
                   local address = character_struct[template_data.DropDownDescription[current_movement_entry]]
                   local code = template_data.DropDownValue[current_movement_entry]

                   if (debug == true) then
                      print("Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                      ..", Value: \""..code.."\"")
                   end
                   disable_code_movement = disable_code_movement.."writeFloat(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..code..")\r\n"
               end --current_movement_entry loop
        elseif (template_data.Description == "artes") then
               local arte_size = 0

               if (template_data.DropDownCount ~= 0) then
                  arte_size = template_data.DropDownCount / unit_ability_size

                  if (arte_size % 1 ~= 0) then print("WARNING: Artes template is most likely wrong (" .. template_data.Parent.Description .. ")") end --check if number is whole
               else
                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("Arte size is 0, skipping") end
                   goto _skip_artes
               end

               if (debug_artes == true) then print("Arte size: " .. arte_size) end
               if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_ABILITY START") end

               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "local ma_table_obj\r\n"
               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "local frequency_list\r\n"

               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x".. toHex(ma_table_clear) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_unit_ability) .. ", {})\r\n"

               for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
                   local current_arte_entry = current_arte * unit_ability_size
                   local arte_id_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry]
                   local direction_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry + 1]
                   local difficulty_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry + 2]

                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("Processing entry: " .. current_arte .. ", arte ID: " .. arte_id_value .. ", direction: " .. direction_value .. ", difficulty: " .. difficulty_value) end

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "ma_table_obj = mono_object_new(0x" .. toHex(ma_table_class) .. ")\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_object_init(ma_table_obj)\r\n"

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x10, " .. arte_id_value .. ")\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x14, " .. direction_value .. ")\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x18, " .. difficulty_value .. ")\r\n"

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "frequency_list = mono_object_new(0x" .. toHex(int32_class) .. ")\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_object_init(frequency_list)\r\n"

                   for current_frequency = 0, 22, 1 do
                       local frequency_value = template_data.DropDownValue[(current_arte_entry + 3) + (current_frequency - 1)]
                       if (debug_artes == true) then print("Adding frequency: " .. frequency_value .. " (entry " .. current_frequency .. ")") end

                       disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(int32_add) .. ", frequency_list, {{type=vtDword, value=" .. frequency_value .. "}})\r\n"
                   end

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "writePointer(ma_table_obj + 0x20, frequency_list)\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(ma_table_add) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_unit_ability) .. ", {{type=vtPointer, value=ma_table_obj}})\r\n"
               end

               if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_ABILITY END") end
               if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_STATUS ENABLE/LEARN START") end

               --now enable the new artes
               for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
                   local current_arte_entry = current_arte * unit_ability_size
                   local arte_id_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry]

                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("Enabling arte: " .. arte_id_value) end

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_enable) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=1}})\r\n"
                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_learn) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=1}})\r\n"

                   --for enable script to disable old artes
                   enable_code_disable_artes = enable_code_disable_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_enable) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=0}})\r\n"
                   enable_code_disable_artes = enable_code_disable_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_learn) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=0}})\r\n"
               end

               disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "arte_list_cleanup(" .. current_character .. ", " .. template_data.ID .. ")\r\n"

               if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_STATUS ENABLE/LEARN END") end
               ::_skip_artes::
        else
            print("Unknown data? "..template_data.Description)
        end --elseif
    end --template_data loop

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Disable generation END")
       print("Enable generation START")
    end

    for current_template = 1, template_header.Count - 1, 1 do
        local character_template_header = template_header.Child[current_template]
        --skip self
        if (character_template_header == template_header.Child[current_character]) then
           if (debug == true) then
              print("Skipped "..character_template_header.Description)
           end
           goto restart_template_loop
        end

        if (debug == true) then
           print(character_names[current_character].." to "..character_template_header.Description.." START")
        end

        --create header for the character you change into
        local generated_character_header = al.createMemoryRecord()
        generated_character_header.beginEdit()
        generated_character_header.IsGroupHeader = true
        generated_character_header.Description = character_template_header.Description
        generated_character_header.DontSave = true
        generated_character_header.Options = "[moHideChildren, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
        generated_character_header.appendToEntry(header)
        generated_character_header.endEdit()
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Created character group memory record.")
        end
        --create full character header
        local generated_full_character_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
        generated_full_character_memrec.beginEdit()
        generated_full_character_memrec.IsGroupHeader = true
        generated_full_character_memrec.Description = "Full character"
        generated_full_character_memrec.DontSave = true
        generated_full_character_memrec.Options = "[moActivateChildrenAsWell, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
        generated_full_character_memrec.Color = 0xA020F0 --purple
        generated_full_character_memrec.appendToEntry(generated_character_header)
        generated_full_character_memrec.endEdit()
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Created full character memory record.")
        end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        for current_template_data = 0, character_template_header.Count - 1, 1 do
            local template_data = character_template_header.Child[current_template_data]

            if (debug == true) then
               print("Currently processing: "..template_data.Description)
            end

            local data_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
            data_memrec.beginEdit()
            data_memrec.Type = vtAutoAssembler
            data_memrec.DontSave = true
            data_memrec.Options = "[moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"
            data_memrec.appendToEntry(generated_full_character_memrec)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            --enable code
            local enable_code = ""
            address = character_struct[template_data.Description]
            local code = template_data.DropDownValue[0]

            local pin_type = ""

            if (template_data.Description == "player_id") then
               enable_code = "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..code..")"
               data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_player_id)
               data_memrec.Description = "Player ID"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (template_data.Description == "animation") then
                   pin_type = "animation"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_animation)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Animation"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_animation, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "model") then
                   pin_type = "model"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_model)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Model"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_model, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "attachment") then
                   pin_type = "attachment"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_attachment)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Attachment"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_attachment, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "preload") then
                   pin_type = "preload"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_preload)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Preload"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_preload, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "mdf_btl_face") then
                   pin_type = "mdf_btl_face"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_mdf_btl_face)
                   data_memrec.Description = "MDF BTL FACE"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_mdf_btl_face, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "slash_effect") then
                   pin_type = "slash_effect"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_slash_effect)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Slash effect"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_slash_effect, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "ldf") then
                   pin_type = "ldf"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_ldf)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Look at definition"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_ldf, pin_type, current_character)
            elseif (template_data.Description == "ga") then
                   pin_type = "ga"
                   enable_code = "local str_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..code.."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address)..", str_address)\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"" .. pin_type .. "\", \"" .. code .. "\", str_address)"
                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_ga)
                   data_memrec.Description = "GA"
                   multiple_string_handler(template_data, data_memrec, disable_code_ga, pin_type, current_character)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            elseif (template_data.Description == "voices") then
                   address = character_struct["voice_info"]
                   local voice_base_address = readPointer(address + 0x10)

                   for current_sub_voice = 0, template_data.Count - 1, 1 do --loop for as many voices there are in the dropdown
                       local current_voice_data_template = template_data.Child[current_sub_voice]
                       local current_voice_size = 0

                       if (current_voice_data_template.DropDownCount == 0) then
                          current_voice_size = 0
                       else
                           current_voice_size = (current_voice_data_template.DropDownCount - 1) / 3
                       end

                       local enable_code = ""
                       local voice_name = ""

                       if (current_voice_size &gt; 8) then
                          current_voice_size = 8
                          print("WARNING: Voice size is limited to 8, everything above 8 will be ignored")
                       end

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("Processing \""..current_voice_data_template.Description.."\" with a size of "..current_voice_size)
                       end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "local str_address\r\n"

                       --make the other voices inactive
                       for current_voice = 7, current_voice_size, -1 do
                           address = readPointer(voice_base_address + 0x20 + 0x8 * current_voice)

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address + 0x10)..", 0"
                           ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x14)..", 0"
                           ..")\r\nstr_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""
                           .."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address + 0x18)..", str_address)\r\n"

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voice" .. current_voice .. "\", \"\", str_address)\r\n"
                       end --current_voice remove loop

                       --generate the new voices
                       for current_voice = 0, current_voice_size - 1, 1 do --loop through every voice in the template's dropdown
                           local current_voice_entry = current_voice * 3 + 1
                           local voice_string = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry]
                           local start_condition = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+1]
                           local stop_condition = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[current_voice_entry+2]
                           voice_name = current_voice_data_template.DropDownDescription[current_voice_entry]
                           address = readPointer(voice_base_address + 0x20 + 0x8 * current_voice)

                           if (debug == true) then
                              print("Entry "..current_voice..": Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                              ..", Start condition: "..start_condition
                              ..", Stop condition: "..stop_condition
                              ..", Voice: "..voice_string)
                           end

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "writeInteger(0x"..toHex(address + 0x10)..", "..start_condition
                           ..")\r\nwriteInteger(0x"..toHex(address+0x14)..", "..stop_condition
                           ..")\r\nstr_address = mono_new_string(nil, \""..voice_string
                           .."\")\r\nwritePointer(0x"..toHex(address + 0x18)..", str_address)\r\n"

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voice" .. current_voice .. "\", \"" .. voice_string .. "\", str_address)\r\n"
                       end --current_voice add loop

                       --PC exclusive
                       address = getAddress("voiceDataName_ptrs") + 0x8 * current_character

                       local voiceDataName = "NON"

                       if (current_voice_size &gt; 0) then
                          voiceDataName = current_voice_data_template.DropDownValue[0]
                       else
                           if (debug == true) then
                              print("Voice list is empty, defaulting to NON voiceDataName")
                           end
                       end

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("voiceDataName: "..voiceDataName..", Address: 0x"..toHex(address))
                       end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "str_address = mono_new_string(\""..voiceDataName.."\")\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "process_gc_handle(" .. current_character .. ", \"voiceDataName\", \"" .. voiceDataName .. "\", str_address)\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "writePointer(0x" .. toHex(address) .. ", str_address)"

                       if (current_sub_voice == 0) then --add initial script to the first voice, otherwise generate memory records under it
                          data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_voices)
                       else
                           local sub_record = al.createMemoryRecord()
                           sub_record.beginEdit()
                           sub_record.Type = vtAutoAssembler
                           sub_record.DontSave = true
                           sub_record.Description = voice_name
                           sub_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_voices)
                           sub_record.appendToEntry(data_memrec)
                           sub_record.endEdit()
                       end
                   end --current_sub_voice loop

                   data_memrec.Description = "Voice"
            elseif (template_data.Description == "movement") then
                   for current_movement_entry = 0, template_data.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option
                       local address = character_struct[template_data.DropDownDescription[current_movement_entry]]
                       local code = template_data.DropDownValue[current_movement_entry]

                       if (debug == true) then
                          print("Address: 0x"..toHex(address)
                          ..", Value: \""..code.."\"")
                       end

                   enable_code = enable_code.."writeFloat(0x"..toHex(address)..", "..code..")\r\n"
                   end --current_movement_entry loop

                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_movement)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Movement"
            elseif (template_data.Description == "artes") then
                   local disable_code_artes_base = disable_code_artes --for adding enable artes to disable and restoring it later

                   local arte_size = 0

                   if (template_data.DropDownCount ~= 0) then
                      arte_size = template_data.DropDownCount / unit_ability_size

                      if (arte_size % 1 ~= 0) then print("WARNING: Artes template is most likely wrong (" .. template_data.Parent.Description .. ")") end --check if number is whole
                   else
                       if (debug_artes == true) then print("Arte size is 0, skipping") end
                       goto _skip_artes
                   end

                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("Arte size: " .. arte_size) end
                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_ABILITY START") end

                   enable_code = enable_code .. "local ma_table_obj\r\n"
                   enable_code = enable_code .. "local frequency_list\r\n"

                   enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x".. toHex(ma_table_clear) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_unit_ability) .. ", {})\r\n"

                   for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
                       local current_arte_entry = current_arte * unit_ability_size
                       local arte_id_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry]
                       local direction_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry + 1]
                       local difficulty_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry + 2]

                       if (debug_artes == true) then print("Processing entry: " .. current_arte .. ", arte ID: " .. arte_id_value .. ", direction: " .. direction_value .. ", difficulty: " .. difficulty_value) end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "ma_table_obj = mono_object_new(0x" .. toHex(ma_table_class) .. ")\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_object_init(ma_table_obj)\r\n"

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x10, " .. arte_id_value .. ")\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x14, " .. direction_value .. ")\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "writeInteger(ma_table_obj + 0x18, " .. difficulty_value .. ")\r\n"

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "frequency_list = mono_object_new(0x" .. toHex(int32_class) .. ")\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_object_init(frequency_list)\r\n"

                       for current_frequency = 0, 22, 1 do
                           local frequency_value = template_data.DropDownValue[(current_arte_entry + 3) + (current_frequency - 1)]
                           if (debug_artes == true) then print("Adding frequency: " .. frequency_value .. " (entry " .. current_frequency .. ")") end

                           enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(int32_add) .. ", frequency_list, {{type=vtDword, value=" .. frequency_value .. "}})\r\n"
                       end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "writePointer(ma_table_obj + 0x20, frequency_list)\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(ma_table_add) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_unit_ability) .. ", {{type=vtPointer, value=ma_table_obj}})\r\n"
                   end

                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_ABILITY END") end
                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_STATUS ENABLE/LEARN START") end

                   --now enable the new artes
                   for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
                       local current_arte_entry = current_arte * unit_ability_size
                       local arte_id_value = template_data.DropDownValue[current_arte_entry]

                       if (debug_artes == true) then print("Enabling arte: " .. arte_id_value) end

                       enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_enable) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=1}})\r\n"
                       enable_code = enable_code .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_learn) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=1}})\r\n"

                       --for disable to disable enabled artes
                       disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_enable) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=0}})\r\n"
                       disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes .. "mono_invoke_method(nil, 0x" .. toHex(magic_arts_learn) .. ", 0x" .. toHex(current_character_instance) .. ",  {{type=vtDword, value=" .. arte_id_value .. "},{type=vtByte, value=0}})\r\n"
                   end

                   enable_code = enable_code .. enable_code_disable_artes

                   enable_code = enable_code .. "arte_list_cleanup(" .. current_character .. ", " .. template_data.ID .. ")\r\n"

                   if (debug_artes == true) then print("UNIT_STATUS ENABLE/LEARN END") end
                   ::_skip_artes::

                   data_memrec.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_code_artes)
                   data_memrec.Description = "Artes"

                   disable_code_artes = disable_code_artes_base --restore pre fixed code
            else
                print("Unknown data? "..template_data.Description)
            end

            data_memrec.endEdit()
        end

        if (debug == true) then
           print(character_names[current_character].." to "..character_template_header.Description.." END")
        end
        ::restart_template_loop::
    end

    if (debug == true) then
       print(character_names[current_character].." END")
    end
end --current_character loop

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (debug == true) then
   print("Script END")
end

if (measure_performance == true) then
   print("Took "..(os.clock() - perf_start_time).." seconds.")
end

////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//int to ascii converter
alloc(conv_mem, 0x500)
alloc(itos_buffer, 0x20)
label(IntToAscii)
label(positive)
label(loop)
label(sign)
label(bracket)
label(done)
registersymbol(IntToAscii)

conv_mem:

IntToAscii:
  push rbx
  push rdi
  push rdx
  mov rax, rcx
  lea rdi, [itos_buffer+1F]
  mov byte ptr [rdi], 0
  dec rdi
  mov byte ptr [rdi], 0x29
  mov rbx, #10
  xor r8d, r8d
  test rax, rax
  jns positive
  neg rax
  mov r8d, 1
positive:
  test rax, rax
  jnz loop
  dec rdi
  mov byte ptr [rdi], 0x30
  jmp sign
loop:
  xor rdx, rdx
  div rbx
  add dl, 0x30
  dec rdi
  mov byte ptr [rdi], dl
  test rax, rax
  jnz loop
sign:
  test r8d, r8d
  jz bracket
  dec rdi
  mov byte ptr [rdi], 0x2D
bracket:
  dec rdi
  mov byte ptr [rdi], 0x28
done:
  mov rax, rdi
  pop rdx
  pop rdi
  pop rbx
  ret

if syntaxcheck then return end
--local method, instance = get_mono_method("Assembly-CSharp.dll", "BTL", "TO11BtlDatabase", "GetEncounterGroupByIndex")
local method = mono_findMethod("BTL","TO11BtlDatabase","GetEncounterGroupByIndex")
local edit_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118185")
local old_member_size = 0

--print("Method: "..toHex(method)..", instance: "..toHex(instance))

local args = {}
args[1] = {}
args[1].type = vtDword

local member_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118196")

edit_memrec.OnValueChanged = function(memrec, oldValue, newValue)
                           args[1].value = tonumber(newValue)
                           local result = mono_invoke_method(nil, method, nil, args)

                           if (result == nil) then goto _stop end
                           --print("Result: "..toHex(result))
                           writeQword("tbl_data+68", result)

                           local new_member_size = readInteger(readPointer(result + 0x38) + 0x18)
                           --print("New member size: "..new_member_size)

                           if (new_member_size &gt; 100) then goto _break end

                           --[[print("Old size: "..old_member_size..", new size: "..new_member_size..", memrec count: "..member_memrec.Count)
                           print("memrec count floored: "..math.floor(member_memrec.Count / 2))
                           if (old_member_size &gt; new_member_size) then
                              print("should delete "..old_member_size - new_member_size.." times")
                           elseif (old_member_size &lt; new_member_size) then
                                  print("should create "..new_member_size - old_member_size.." times")
                           end]]

                           if (old_member_size &gt; new_member_size) then
                              --delete
                              --print("New: "..new_member_size..", old: "..old_member_size)

                              for i = member_memrec.Count - 1, new_member_size * 2, -2 do
                                  --print(member_memrec.Child[i].Description.." destroyed")
                                  --no idea why this causes access violation still
                                  --print("i "..member_memrec.Child[i].Description)
                                  --print("i-1 "..member_memrec.Child[i - 1].Description)
                                  --member_memrec.Child[i].destroy() --group
                                  --member_memrec.Child[i - 1].destroy() --member

                                  local rec = member_memrec.Child[i] --group

                                  if rec then
                                     local t = createTimer(nil)
                                     t.Interval = 1
                                     t.OnTimer = function(timer)
                                               timer.Destroy()
                                               rec.Destroy()
                                     end
                                  end

                                  local rec = member_memrec.Child[i - 1] --member

                                  if rec then
                                     local t = createTimer(nil)
                                     t.Interval = 1
                                     t.OnTimer = function(timer)
                                               timer.Destroy()
                                               rec.Destroy()
                                     end
                                  end
                              end
                           elseif (old_member_size &lt; new_member_size) then
                                  --create
                                  for i = math.floor(member_memrec.Count / 2), new_member_size - 1, 1 do
                                      --print("Creating memrec "..(i + 1))
                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Member "..(i + 1)
                                      memrec.Address = "+0"
                                      memrec.OffsetCount = 3
                                      memrec.Offset[0] = 0x10
                                      memrec.Offset[1] = 0x20 + 0x8 * i
                                      memrec.Offset[2] = 0x10
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Enemy List"
                                      memrec.DropDownLinked = true
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(member_memrec)
                                      memrec.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Member "..(i + 1).." group"
                                      memrec.Address = "+0"
                                      memrec.OffsetCount = 3
                                      memrec.Offset[0] = 0x14
                                      memrec.Offset[1] = 0x20 + 0x8 * i
                                      memrec.Offset[2] = 0x10
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(member_memrec)
                                      memrec.endEdit()
                                  end
                           end

                           ::_break::
                           old_member_size = new_member_size

                           ::_stop::
end
{$asm}

if (method ~= 0) and (instance ~= 0) then
  local args = {}
  args[1] = {}
  args[1].type = vtDword

  edit_memrec.OnValueChanged = function(memrec, oldValue, newValue)
                           args[1].value = tonumber(newValue)
                           local result = mono_invoke_method(nil, method, instance, args)
                           writeQword("tbl_data+60", result)
  end
end
{$asm}
{$STRICT}
define(bytes, 48 89 5C 24 08 48 89 74 24 10 57 48 83 EC 20)
[ENABLE]
assert(SkillDatabase.GetSP, bytes)
alloc(newmem,$1000)

label(code)
label(return)

newmem:
  push rax
  mov rax,tbl_data
  cmp [rax+50],0 //hover check
  je @f
  mov [rax+58],rdx //write to edit
@@:
  pop rax
code:
  db bytes
  jmp return

SkillDatabase.GetSP:
  jmp newmem
  nop
return:

tbl_data+50: //enable hover
  dq 1

tbl_data+58: //set to skill 1 for s mall qol
  dq 1

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
local edit_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118168")
edit_memrec = nil
{$asm}
SkillDatabase.GetSP:
  db bytes

dealloc(newmem)

if syntaxcheck then return end
local method, instance = get_mono_method("Assembly-CSharp.dll", "BTL", "TO11BtlDatabase", "GetUnitAbility")
local edit_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118205")
local old_arte_size = 0
local old_skill_size = 0

local arte_frequency_names = {"Neutral use (0%-100% HP)","Counter (0%-25% HP)","Counter (25%-50% HP)","Counter (50%-100% HP)","Counter while guarding (0%-25% HP)","Counter while guarding (25%-50% HP)","Counter while guarding (50%-100% HP)","After knockdown","During link (as partner) while target is behind leader","HP Recovery (0%-75% HP)","On target knockdown","On target stagger","On target stun","On target passing by/above character","On target guarding","Over Limit neutral use (0%-25% HP)","Over Limit neutral use (25%-50% HP)","Over Limit neutral use (50%-100% HP)","During link (as leader)","During link (as partner) while leader is being attacked","During link (as partner) while target is behind leader OR leader is being attacked","Neutral use (0%-25% HP)","Neutral use (25%-50% HP)"}

--print("Method: "..toHex(method)..", instance: "..toHex(instance))

local args = {}
args[1] = {}
args[1].type = vtDword

local arte_table_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118207")
local skill_table_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("118208")

edit_memrec.OnValueChanged = function(memrec, oldValue, newValue)
                           args[1].value = tonumber(newValue)
                           local result = mono_invoke_method(nil, method, nil, args)

                           if (result == nil) then goto _stop end
                           --print("Result: "..toHex(result))
                           writeQword("tbl_data+78", result)

                           if (result == 0) then goto _stop end

                           -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                           local new_arte_size = readInteger(readPointer(result + 0x18) + 0x18)
                           --print("New skill size: "..new_skill_size)

                           if (new_arte_size &gt; 100) then goto _artebreak end

                           if (old_arte_size &gt; new_arte_size) then
                              --delete
                              for i = arte_table_memrec.Count - 1, new_arte_size, -1 do
                                  arte_table_memrec.Child[i].Destroy()
                              end
                           elseif (old_arte_size &lt; new_arte_size) then
                                  --create
                                  for i = arte_table_memrec.Count, new_arte_size - 1, 1 do
                                      local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      header.beginEdit()
                                      header.Description = "Arte "..(i + 1)
                                      header.Address = "+0"
                                      header.OffsetCount = 3
                                      header.Offset[0] = 0x0
                                      header.Offset[1] = 0x20 + 0x8 * i
                                      header.Offset[2] = 0x10
                                      header.IsGroupHeader = true
                                      header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                                      header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                                      header.DontSave = true
                                      header.appendToEntry(arte_table_memrec)
                                      header.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Arte"
                                      memrec.Address = "+10"
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Artes"
                                      memrec.DropDownLinked = true
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(header)
                                      memrec.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Direction"
                                      memrec.Address = "+14"
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(header)
                                      memrec.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Difficulty"
                                      memrec.Address = "+18"
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Difficulties"
                                      memrec.DropDownLinked = true
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(header)
                                      memrec.endEdit()

                                      local freq_header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      freq_header.beginEdit()
                                      freq_header.Description = "Frequency pointer"
                                      freq_header.Address = "+20"
                                      freq_header.Type = vtQword
                                      freq_header.ShowAsHex = true
                                      freq_header.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand, moManualExpandCollapse]"
                                      freq_header.DontSave = true
                                      freq_header.appendToEntry(header)
                                      freq_header.endEdit()

                                      local freq_size = readPointer(result + 0x18)
                                      freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x10)
                                      freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x20 + 0x8 * i)
                                      freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x20)
                                      freq_size = readInteger(freq_size + 0x18)

                                      if (freq_size &lt; 23) then print("Less than 23") end
                                      if (freq_size &gt; 23) then goto _artebreak end

                                      for j = 0, freq_size - 1, 1 do
                                          local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                          memrec.beginEdit()
                                          if ((j + 1) &gt; #arte_frequency_names) or ((j + 1) == 0) then
                                             memrec.Description = "Unknown"
                                          else
                                              memrec.Description = arte_frequency_names[j + 1]
                                          end
                                          memrec.Address = "+0"
                                          memrec.OffsetCount = 2
                                          memrec.Offset[0] = 0x20 + 0x4 * j
                                          memrec.Offset[1] = 0x10
                                          memrec.Type = vtDword
                                          memrec.DontSave = true
                                          memrec.appendToEntry(freq_header)
                                          memrec.endEdit()
                                      end
                                  end
                           end

                           ::_artebreak::
                           old_arte_size = new_arte_size
                           -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
                           local new_skill_size = readInteger(readPointer(result + 0x20) + 0x18)
                           --print("New skill size: "..new_skill_size)

                           if (new_skill_size &gt; 100) then goto _skillbreak end

                           if (old_skill_size &gt; new_skill_size) then
                              --delete
                              for i = skill_table_memrec.Count - 1, new_skill_size, -1 do
                                  skill_table_memrec.Child[i].Destroy()
                              end
                           elseif (old_skill_size &lt; new_skill_size) then
                                  --create
                                  for i = skill_table_memrec.Count, new_skill_size - 1, 1 do
                                      local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      header.beginEdit()
                                      header.Description = "Skill "..(i + 1)
                                      header.Address = "+0"
                                      header.OffsetCount = 3
                                      header.Offset[0] = 0x0
                                      header.Offset[1] = 0x20 + 0x8 * i
                                      header.Offset[2] = 0x10
                                      header.IsGroupHeader = true
                                      header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                                      header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                                      header.DontSave = true
                                      header.appendToEntry(skill_table_memrec)
                                      header.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()
                                      memrec.Description = "Skill"
                                      memrec.Address = "+10"
                                      memrec.Type = vtDword
                                      memrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Skills"
                                      memrec.DropDownLinked = true
                                      memrec.DontSave = true
                                      memrec.appendToEntry(header)
                                      memrec.endEdit()

                                      local memrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                                      memrec.beginEdit()

function arte_list_update(arte_size)
         local arte_list_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("122191")
         local arte_frequency_names = {"Neutral use (0%-100% HP)","Counter (0%-25% HP)","Counter (25%-50% HP)","Counter (50%-100% HP)","Counter while guarding (0%-25% HP)","Counter while guarding (25%-50% HP)","Counter while guarding (50%-100% HP)","After knockdown","During link (as partner) while target is behind leader","HP Recovery (0%-75% HP)","On target knockdown","On target stagger","On target stun","On target passing by/above character","On target guarding","Over Limit neutral use (0%-25% HP)","Over Limit neutral use (25%-50% HP)","Over Limit neutral use (50%-100% HP)","During link (as leader)","During link (as partner) while leader is being attacked","During link (as partner) while target is behind leader OR leader is being attacked","Neutral use (0%-25% HP)","Neutral use (25%-50% HP)"}
         local old_arte_size = arte_list_memrec.Count

         if (old_arte_size &gt; arte_size) then
            --delete
            for current_arte = old_arte_size - 1, arte_size, -1 do
                memoryrecord_delete(arte_list_memrec.Child[current_arte])
            end
         elseif (old_arte_size &lt; arte_size) then
                --create
                for current_arte = arte_list_memrec.Count, arte_size - 1, 1 do
                    local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    header.beginEdit()
                    header.Description = "Arte "..(current_arte + 1)
                    header.Address = "+0"
                    header.OffsetCount = 3
                    header.Offset[0] = 0x0
                    header.Offset[1] = 0x20 + 0x8 * current_arte
                    header.Offset[2] = 0x10
                    header.IsGroupHeader = true
                    header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                    header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                    header.DontSave = true
                    header.appendToEntry(arte_list_memrec)
                    header.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Arte"
                    rec.Address = "+10"
                    rec.Type = vtDword
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Artes"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local direction_header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    direction_header.beginEdit()
                    direction_header.Description = "Direction"
                    direction_header.Address = "+14"
                    direction_header.IsGroupHeader = true
                    direction_header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                    direction_header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                    direction_header.DontSave = true
                    direction_header.appendToEntry(header)
                    direction_header.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Neutral"
                    rec.Address = "+0"
                    rec.Type = vtBinary
                    rec.Binary.Startbit = 0
                    rec.Binary.Size = 1
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Disabled/Enabled"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(direction_header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Up"
                    rec.Address = "+0"
                    rec.Type = vtBinary
                    rec.Binary.Startbit = 1
                    rec.Binary.Size = 1
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Disabled/Enabled"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(direction_header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Left/Right"
                    rec.Address = "+0"
                    rec.Type = vtBinary
                    rec.Binary.Startbit = 2
                    rec.Binary.Size = 1
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Disabled/Enabled"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(direction_header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Down"
                    rec.Address = "+0"
                    rec.Type = vtBinary
                    rec.Binary.Startbit = 3
                    rec.Binary.Size = 1
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Disabled/Enabled"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(direction_header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    rec.beginEdit()
                    rec.Description = "Difficulty"
                    rec.Address = "+18"
                    rec.Type = vtDword
                    rec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Difficulties"
                    rec.DropDownLinked = true
                    rec.DontSave = true
                    rec.appendToEntry(header)
                    rec.endEdit()

                    local freq_header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                    freq_header.beginEdit()
                    freq_header.Description = "Frequencies"
                    freq_header.Address = "+20"
                    freq_header.IsGroupHeader = true
                    freq_header.IsAddressGroupHeader = true
                    freq_header.Options = "[moHideChildren]"
                    freq_header.DontSave = true
                    freq_header.appendToEntry(header)
                    freq_header.endEdit()

                    local freq_size = readPointer(current_unit_ability + 0x18)
                    freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x10)
                    freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x20 + 0x8 * current_arte)
                    freq_size = readPointer(freq_size + 0x20)
                    freq_size = readInteger(freq_size + 0x18)

                    if (freq_size &lt; #arte_frequency_names) then print("Less than " .. #arte_frequency_names) end
                    if (freq_size &gt; #arte_frequency_names) then goto _artebreak end

                    for current_frequency = 0, freq_size - 1, 1 do
                        local rec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                        rec.beginEdit()
                        if ((current_frequency + 1) &gt; #arte_frequency_names) or ((current_frequency + 1) == 0) then
                           rec.Description = "Unknown"
                        else
                            rec.Description = arte_frequency_names[current_frequency + 1]
                        end
                        rec.Address = "+0"
                        rec.OffsetCount = 2
                        rec.Offset[0] = 0x20 + 0x4 * current_frequency
                        rec.Offset[1] = 0x10
                        rec.Type = vtDword
                        rec.DontSave = true
                        rec.appendToEntry(freq_header)
                        rec.endEdit()
                    end
                end
                ::_artebreak::
         end
end

local arte_list_memrec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("122191")
local arte_size = arte_list_memrec.Count
local frequency_size = 0
local address = 0
local code = ""

for current_arte = 0, arte_size - 1, 1 do
--for current_arte = 0, 1, 1 do --debug
    address = arte_list_memrec.Child[current_arte].getCurrentAddress()

    code = code .. readInteger(address + 0x10) .. ":Arte_" .. current_arte .. "\r\n"
    code = code .. readInteger(address + 0x14) .. ":Direction\r\n"
    code = code .. readInteger(address + 0x18) .. ":Difficulty\r\n"

    frequency_size = arte_list_memrec.Child[current_arte].Child[arte_list_memrec.Child[current_arte].Count - 1].Count --should always be 23
    if (frequency_size ~= 23) then print("Unexpected frequency size of " .. frequency_size .." at 0x" .. toHex(address) ..", arte entry: " .. current_arte) end

    address = readPointer(address + 0x20)
    address = readPointer(address + 0x10)
    address = address + 0x20

    for current_frequency = 0, frequency_size - 1, 1 do
        code = code .. readInteger(address) .. ":Frequency_" .. current_frequency .. "\r\n"
        address = address + 0x4
    end
end

local ma_table_add = mono_findMethod("","System.Collections.Generic.List`1[BTL.MA_TABLE]","Add","4")
if not ma_table_add or ma_table_add == 0 then print("Could not find BTL.MA_TABLE.Add()") end

if not ma_table_clear or ma_table_clear == 0 then print("Could not find BTL.MA_TABLE.Clear()") end

form.OnKeyDown = function(sender, key)
  if key == VK_ESCAPE then
    form.close()
  end

  if key == VK_RETURN then
    ok.OnClick(ok)
  end
end

ok.OnClick = function(sender)
                  local value = tonumber(edit.Text)
                  if not value then
                      showMessage("The input was empty or invalid!")
                      return
                  end

                  if (value &gt; 50) or (value == 0) then
                     local result = messageDialog("Are you sure you want to create "..value.." artes?", mtConfirmation, mbYes, mbNo)

                     if (result == mrNo) then
                        return
                     end
                  end

                  if (value == arte_size) then return end

                  mono_invoke_method(nil, ma_table_clear, unit_ability_ptr, {})

                  for current_arte = 1, value, 1 do
                      local ma_table_obj = mono_object_new(ma_table_class)
                      mono_object_init(ma_table_obj)

                      local frequency_list = mono_object_new(int32_class)
                      mono_object_init(frequency_list)

                      for current_frequency = 1, 23, 1 do
                          mono_invoke_method(nil, int32_add, frequency_list, {{type=vtDword, value=0}})
                      end

                      writePointer(ma_table_obj + 0x20, frequency_list)

                      mono_invoke_method(nil, ma_table_add, unit_ability_ptr, {{type=vtPointer, value=ma_table_obj}})
                  end

                  arte_list_update(value)
                  form.close()
end

form.OnDestroy = function(sender, action)
             memrec.Active = false
             getMainForm().setFocus()
end

define(voiceDataName_aob_bytes, 48 8B 54 C2 20 48 8B CB)
[ENABLE]
assert(BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252, voiceDataName_aob_bytes)
alloc(voiceDataName_mem,$1000)
alloc(voiceDataName_cave,$1000,BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName)
alloc(voiceDataName_ptrs,$1000)

label(original_code)
label(return)

voiceDataName_cave:
  jmp far voiceDataName_mem

//rcx can be freely used as it gets overwritten immediately afterward
voiceDataName_mem:
  mov rcx,voiceDataName_ptrs
  mov rcx,[rcx+rax*8]
  test rcx,rcx //if not filled out, use the game code
  je original_code
  mov rdx,[rcx]
  jmp return
original_code:
  mov rdx,[rdx+rax*8+20] //original game code
  jmp return

BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252:
  jmp long voiceDataName_cave

return:

registersymbol(voiceDataName_mem)
registersymbol(voiceDataName_cave)
registersymbol(voiceDataName_ptrs)
[DISABLE]

BTL.CUnit.GetVoiceName+252:
  db voiceDataName_aob_bytes

unregistersymbol(voiceDataName_mem)
unregistersymbol(voiceDataName_cave)
unregistersymbol(voiceDataName_ptrs)
dealloc(voiceDataName_mem)
dealloc(voiceDataName_cave)
dealloc(voiceDataName_ptrs)

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

local function getMonoStaticField_API(namespace, className, fieldName)
    local class = mono_findClass(namespace, className)
    if not class or class == 0 then return nil, "Class not found" end

    local fields = mono_class_enumFields(class, true)
    local target = nil
    for _, f in ipairs(fields) do
        if f.name == fieldName and f.isStatic then
            target = f
            break
        end
    end
    if not target then return nil, "Static field not found" end

    -- Get value via Mono Data Collector
    local vtable = mono_class_getVTable(0, class)
    local rawValue = mono_getStaticFieldValue(vtable, target.field)

    -- Type interpretation helper
    if target.monotype == 0x0E or target.typename == "System.String" then
        return mono_string_readString(rawValue) -- String
    elseif target.monotype &gt;= 0x04 and target.monotype &lt;= 0x0B then
        return rawValue -- Integers/Bytes
    elseif target.monotype == 0x02 then
        return rawValue ~= 0 -- Boolean
    else
        return rawValue -- Pointer or unknown type
    end
end

local result = getMonoStaticField_API('','CPartyProfile','m_Instance')

writePointer("tbl_data+88", result)

if syntaxcheck then return end

function get_address_from_aob(ArrayOfBytes, perm)
  local AoB
  if (perm == nil) then
     AoB = AOBScanRegion(ArrayOfBytes)
  else
      AoB = AOBScanRegion(ArrayOfBytes, perm)
  end

  if (AoB) then
     if (AoB.getCount() &gt; 1) then
        print("Warning: array of bytes not unique!")
     end

     local address = AoB[0]
     address = tonumber("0x"..address)

     AoB.Destroy()
     AoB = nil

     return address
  else
      print("No array of bytes found")
      error("No array of bytes found")
  end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function AOBScanRegion(AOB, permission)
    local ms = createMemScan();
    local flist = createFoundList(ms)

    if (permission == nil) then
       ms.firstScan(soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded, AOB, "", "300000000", "400000000", "+W-X*C", fsmAligned, "", true, false, false, false)
    else
        ms.firstScan(soExactValue, vtByteArray, rtRounded, AOB, "", "300000000", "400000000", permission, fsmAligned, "", true, false, false, false)
    end

    ms.waitTillDone()
    flist.initialize()

    return flist
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function getOffset(address)
         if (address == nil) then
            print("getOffset received a nil value")
            error("getOffset received a nil value")
         else
             return getAddress(address) + swapEndian(readInteger(address))
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function calculateOffset(base_address,new_address)
         if (base_address == nil) or (new_address == nil) then
            print("calculateOffset received a nil value")
            error("calculateOffset received a nil value")
         else
             return new_address - base_address
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function toHex(s)
         if (s == nil) then
            print("toHex received a nil value")
            error("toHex received a nil value")
         else
             return string.upper(string.format('%x', s))
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function swapEndian(n)
         if (n == nil) then
            print("swapEndian received a nil value")
            error("swapEndian received a nil value")
         else
             local b1 = n % 256
             n = (n - b1) / 256
             local b2 = n % 256
             n = (n - b2) / 256
             local b3 = n % 256
             n = (n - b3) / 256
             local b4 = n % 256
             n = (n - b4) / 256

             return b1 * 0x1000000 + b2 * 0x10000 + b3 * 0x100 + b4 * 0x1
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function swapEndianFloat(n)
    local bytes = {string.byte(string.pack('f', n), 1, 4)}
    local swapped = string.char(bytes[4], bytes[3], bytes[2], bytes[1])
    return string.unpack('f', swapped)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function writeStringWithTerminator(address, str)
         local terminator = address + #str
         writeString(address, str)
         writeBytes(terminator, 0x0)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function remove_decimal(val)
         return math.floor(val)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function swapEndianWord(n)
    local b1 = n % 256
    n = (n - b1) / 256
    local b2 = n % 256
    n = (n - b2) / 256
    return b1 * 0x100 + b2
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function bitwise_not_16bit(x)
    return (~x) &amp; 0xFFFF
end
