function iterate_character_data()
    current_character_data = current_character_data + enemy_data_struct_size
    current_character = swapEndian(readInteger(current_character_data))

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Character: "..character_names[current_character]..", ID: "..current_character)
    end

    character_struct = {
    offsets = {
            model = current_character_data + 0xC,
            attachment = current_character_data + 0x10,
            preload = current_character_data + 0x14,
            animation = current_character_data + 0x18,
            mdf_btl_face = current_character_data + 0x20,
            slash_effect = current_character_data + 0x24,
            ldf = current_character_data + 0x28,
            ga = current_character_data + 0x2C,
            chromatus_model = current_character_data + 0x68,
            chromatus_voice = current_character_data + 0x1DC},

        voice_data = current_character_data + 0x1D4, --offset
        voice_size = current_character_data + 0x1D8}
end

{$asm}
[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
debug = false
local auto_disable = false
local clear_console = false

if (clear_console == true) then
   --clear lua engine window
   GetLuaEngine().MenuItem5.doClick()
   if (debug == true) then
      print(os.date ("%c"))
      print("Cleared Lua Engine.")
   end
end

if (debug == true) then
   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE START")
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local character_script_enemy_data = get_address_from_aob("00 00 00 08 00 00 02 33")
if (character_script_enemy_data == nil) or (getAddress(character_script_enemy_data) == 0) then
    print("character_script_enemy_data is not valid")
    error("character_script_enemy_data is not valid")
end

local character_script_arte_list_data = get_address_from_aob("00 00 00 08 00 00 02 2B 00 00 00 01")
if (character_script_arte_list_data == nil) or (getAddress(character_script_arte_list_data) == 0) then
    print("character_script_arte_list_data is not valid")
    error("character_script_arte_list_data is not valid")
end

--variables
character_names = {"Jude","Milla","Alvin","Elize","Rowen","Leia","Gaius","Muzét","Ludger"}
--enemy data
enemy_data_base = character_script_enemy_data+0x8
enemy_data_struct_size = 0x1E8 --offset between entries
enemy_data_entries = 0x232 --amount of characters in enemy data
new_enemy_data_base = enemy_data_base + 0x7A2D0 --where to put new data
--voices
voice_size_to_generate = 10 --amount of voice slots to generate
voice_offset = voice_size_to_generate * 0xC --skip voices math for stream

--required for script to work
current_character_data = enemy_data_base --used to keep track of current character data
stream = new_enemy_data_base --current cursor
string_offset = 0x20 --size between strings
old_offsets = {} --array to put old offsets in
old_offsets_index = 1
current_character = 0
player_character_size = #character_names
local generate_script = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("111793")

--arte list data
arte_data_base = character_script_arte_list_data+0x8
arte_size_to_generate = 130 --amount of arte slots to generate
new_arte_data_base = arte_data_base + 0xA4900 --where to put new data
arte_list_data_struct_size = 0x18 --0x14 in X1, 0x18 in X2
arte_list_data_new_unk_data = new_arte_data_base + 0x14 * arte_size_to_generate * player_character_size
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--enemy data
if (debug == true) then
   print("Enemy data START")
end

for i = 1, player_character_size, 1 do --loop for every character (i = entry)
--for i = 1, 1, 1 do --debug loop
    if (i &gt; enemy_data_entries) then --failsafe
       break
    end

    iterate_character_data()

    --store old strings
    for key, value in pairs(character_struct["offsets"]) do
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Currently processing "..key)
           print("Writing old string ("
           ..readString(getOffset(value))..") from 0x"
           ..toHex(value).." to 0x"
           ..toHex(stream))
        end

        --write data to new place first
        --skip if offset is 0
        if not (readInteger(value) == 0) then
           writeStringWithTerminator(stream, readString(getOffset(value)))
        end

        --write old offsets to array
        old_offsets[old_offsets_index] = readInteger(value)
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Stored old offset (0x"..toHex(swapEndian(old_offsets[old_offsets_index]))..") from 0x"..toHex(value))
        end

        --write new offsets
        writeInteger(value,swapEndian(calculateOffset(value, stream)))
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Wrote new offset (0x"..toHex(calculateOffset(value, stream))..") to 0x"..toHex(value))
        end

        stream = stream + string_offset
        old_offsets_index = old_offsets_index + 1
    end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --do voice
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Voice START")
       print("Currently processing: voice")
       print("Voice size: "..swapEndian(readInteger(character_struct["voice_size"])))
    end

    --write old offset to array
    old_offsets[old_offsets_index] = readInteger(character_struct["voice_data"])
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Stored old offset (0x"..toHex(swapEndian(old_offsets[old_offsets_index]))..") from 0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_data"]))
    end
    old_offsets_index = old_offsets_index + 1

    local voice_stream_base = stream
    for current_voice = 0, (voice_size_to_generate - 1), 1 do
        if (current_voice &gt; 10) then --failsafe
           break
        end

        local current_conditions = getOffset(character_struct["voice_data"]) + 0xC * current_voice --the voice conditions
        local new_voice_address = voice_stream_base + voice_offset + string_offset * current_voice --the new voice string address
        local new_voice_string_offset = calculateOffset(stream + 0x8, new_voice_address) --calculate the offset to the new address
        local current_voice_string = getOffset(getOffset(character_struct["voice_data"]) + 0x8 + 0xC * current_voice) --the string itself

        if (current_voice &lt; swapEndian(readInteger(character_struct["voice_size"]))) then
            if (debug == true) then
               print("Voice: "..(current_voice + 1))
            end

            --write old condition data to new voice struct
            writeQword(stream, readQword(current_conditions))
            if (debug == true) then
               print("Wrote old condition data (0x"..toHex(swapEndian(readQword(current_conditions)))
               ..") from 0x"..toHex(current_conditions)
               .." to 0x"..toHex(stream))
            end

            --write old voice to new voice struct
            writeStringWithTerminator(new_voice_address, readString(current_voice_string))
            if (debug == true) then
               print("Wrote old voice ("..readString(current_voice_string)
               ..") from 0x"..toHex(current_voice_string)
               .." to 0x"..toHex(new_voice_address))
            end
        else
            if (debug == true) then
               print("Placeholder voice: "..(current_voice + 1))
            end
        end

        --write new voice offset to new voice struct
        writeInteger(stream+0x8, swapEndian(new_voice_string_offset))
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Wrote new voice offset (0x"..toHex(new_voice_string_offset)..") to 0x"..toHex(stream+0x8))
        end

        stream = stream + 0xC
    end

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Voice END")
    end

    --write new offset to new voice struct
    writeInteger(character_struct["voice_data"], swapEndian(calculateOffset(character_struct["voice_data"], voice_stream_base)))
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Wrote new offset (0x"
       ..toHex(calculateOffset(character_struct["voice_data"], voice_stream_base))..") to 0x"..toHex(character_struct["voice_data"]))
    end

    stream = stream + string_offset * voice_size_to_generate

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Enemy data END")
    end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    --arte data
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Arte data START")
    end

    local arte_pool_offset = arte_data_base + 0x8 + arte_list_data_struct_size * (current_character - 1)
    local arte_pool_size = swapEndian(readInteger(arte_data_base + 0xC + arte_list_data_struct_size * (current_character - 1)))

    old_offsets[old_offsets_index] = readInteger(arte_pool_offset)
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Stored old offset (0x"..toHex(swapEndian(old_offsets[old_offsets_index]))..") from 0x"..toHex(arte_pool_offset))
    end

    local arte_data_bytes = readBytes(getOffset(arte_pool_offset), 0x14 * arte_pool_size, true)

    writeInteger(arte_pool_offset, swapEndian(calculateOffset(arte_pool_offset, new_arte_data_base)))
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Wrote new arte pool offset (0x"..toHex(calculateOffset(arte_pool_offset, new_arte_data_base))..") to 0x"..toHex(arte_pool_offset))
    end

    writeBytes(getOffset(arte_pool_offset), arte_data_bytes)
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Wrote "..arte_pool_size.." old artes to 0x"..toHex(getOffset(arte_pool_offset)))
    end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    --null arte use chance offset data
    for j = 0, (arte_size_to_generate - 1), 1 do --j = entry in arte list data
        local arte_unk_data_offset = getOffset(arte_pool_offset) + 0xC + 0x14 * j --address of value with offset to unk data
        local arte_unk_data_new_offset = calculateOffset(arte_unk_data_offset, arte_list_data_new_unk_data) --calculate offset to new address

        writeInteger(arte_unk_data_offset, swapEndian(arte_unk_data_new_offset))
        if (debug == true) then
           print("Wrote new arte use chance offset (0x"..toHex(arte_unk_data_new_offset)..") to 0x"..toHex(arte_unk_data_offset))
        end
    end

    new_arte_data_base = new_arte_data_base + 0x14 * arte_size_to_generate
    old_offsets_index = old_offsets_index + 1

    if (debug == true) then
       print("Arte data END")
    end

    if (debug == true) then
       print(character_names[current_character].." END")
    end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--add chance to artes
local chance = 10
local arte_list_base = getOffset(arte_data_base + 0x8)
local arte_use_chance_address = getOffset(arte_list_base + 0xC)
local arte_use_chance_size = swapEndian(readInteger(arte_list_base + 0x10))
for j = 0, arte_use_chance_size - 1, 1 do
    if (debug == true) then
       print("Wrote new chance ("..chance..") to 0x"..toHex(arte_use_chance_address))
    end

    writeInteger(arte_use_chance_address, swapEndian(chance))
    arte_use_chance_address = arte_use_chance_address + 0x4
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--activate script if empty
if (memrec.Count &lt; player_character_size) then
   generate_script.Active = true
end

   createTimer(1000, function() memrec.Active = false end)
end

   print("\""..memrec.Description.."\" ENABLE END")
end

                  <VariableType>Auto Assembler Script</VariableType>
                  <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

autoAssemble([[
aobscanregion(arteEdit, 300000000, 400000000, 00 00 00 00 00 03 83 EC 00 00 00 0F FF FF FF FF) // should be unique
registersymbol(arteEdit)
]])

local currArte

function mainloop()
         if not (getAddressSafe("arteEdit") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("arteEdit") == 0) then
            local arteOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67462")
            local addEffectOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67484")
            local linkedArteOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67486")
            local nameOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67488")
            local altNameOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67489")
            local descOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67490")

            if not (readInteger("arteNum") == currArte) then
               --print("full: "..tonumber(getAddress(linkedArteOffset.Address)) + tonumber(linkedArteOffset.Value)..", addr: "..tonumber(getAddress(linkedArteOffset.Address))..", val: "..tonumber(linkedArteOffset.Value))
               --print(swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(arteOffset.Address))))

               writeQword("arteNum+0x8", tonumber(getAddress(arteOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(arteOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("arteNum+0x10", tonumber(getAddress(addEffectOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(addEffectOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("arteNum+0x18", tonumber(getAddress(linkedArteOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(linkedArteOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("arteNum+0x20", tonumber(getAddress(nameOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(nameOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("arteNum+0x28", tonumber(getAddress(altNameOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(altNameOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("arteNum+0x30", tonumber(getAddress(descOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(descOffset.Address))))

               currArte = readInteger("arteNum")
            end

            local addEffectAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67485")
            local addEffectAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(addEffectAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local addEffAddrOffset = addEffectOffset.Count*0x4*0x2

            if not (addEffectOffset.Count == addEffectAmount) then
               --remove
               if (addEffectOffset.Count &gt; addEffectAmount) then
                  for i = addEffectOffset.Count, addEffectAmount+1, -1 do
                      addEffectOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (addEffectOffset.Count &lt; addEffectAmount) then
                      for i = addEffectOffset.Count, addEffectAmount-1 do
                          if (i &gt; 10) then
                             break --inf loop
                          end
                          local addEffrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          addEffrec.Type = 13
                          addEffrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          addEffrec.setAddress("arteNum+10")
                          addEffrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          addEffrec.setOffset(0, addEffAddrOffset)
                          addEffrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Additional Effects"
                          addEffrec.DropDownLinked = true
                          addEffrec.setDescription("Additional Effect "..(i+1))
                          addEffrec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                          addEffrec.DontSave = true
                          addEffrec.appendToEntry(addEffectOffset)

                          addEffAddrOffset = addEffAddrOffset + 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("arteNum+10")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, addEffAddrOffset)
                          newrec.setDescription("Parameter")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(addEffrec)

                          addEffAddrOffset = addEffAddrOffset + 0x4
                      end
               end
            end

            local linkArteAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("67487")
            local linkArteAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(linkArteAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local linkArteOffset = linkedArteOffset.Count*0x4*0x2

            if not (linkedArteOffset.Count == linkArteAmount) then
               --remove
               if (linkedArteOffset.Count &gt; linkArteAmount) then
                  for i = linkedArteOffset.Count, linkArteAmount+1, -1 do
                      linkedArteOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (linkedArteOffset.Count &lt; linkArteAmount) then
                      for i = linkedArteOffset.Count, linkArteAmount-1 do
                          if (i &gt; 10) then
                             break --inf loop
                          end
                          linkArteOffset = linkArteOffset + 0x4

                          local linkedArteRec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          linkedArteRec.Type = 13
                          linkedArteRec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          linkedArteRec.setAddress("arteNum+18")
                          linkedArteRec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          linkedArteRec.setOffset(0, linkArteOffset)
                          linkedArteRec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "Arte List"
                          linkedArteRec.DropDownLinked = true
                          linkedArteRec.setDescription("Linked with this Arte "..(i+1))
                          linkedArteRec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                          linkedArteRec.DontSave = true
                          linkedArteRec.appendToEntry(linkedArteOffset)

                          linkArteOffset = linkArteOffset - 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("arteNum+18")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, linkArteOffset)
                          newrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "Arte List"
                          newrec.DropDownLinked = true
                          newrec.setDescription("Linked to this Linked Arte")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(linkedArteRec)

                          linkArteOffset = linkArteOffset + 0x8
                      end
               end
            end
         end
end

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end
{$asm}
//aobscanregion(arteEdit, 300000000, 400000000, 00 00 00 00 00 03 83 EC 00 00 00 0F FF FF FF FF) // should be unique
//registersymbol(arteEdit)
//globalAlloc(arteNum,4)
alloc(arteNum,30)
registersymbol(arteNum)
[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (timer) then
   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end
{$asm}
unregistersymbol(arteEdit)
unregistersymbol(arteNum)
dealloc(arteNum)

                  <AssemblerScript>[ENABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end

autoAssemble([[
aobscanregion(attackStatusEdit, 300000000, 400000000, 00 00 00 08 00 00 0B E5) // should be unique
registersymbol(attackStatusEdit)
]])

local currAttack

function mainloop()
         if not (getAddressSafe("attackStatusEdit") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("attackStatusEdit") == 0) then
            local statusEffectOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("89184")

            if not (readInteger("attackStatusNum") == currAttack) then
               writeQword("attackStatusNum+8", tonumber(getAddress(statusEffectOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(statusEffectOffset.Address))))

               currAttack = readInteger("attackStatusNum")
            end

            local statusEffectAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("89185")
            local statusEffectAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(statusEffectAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local offset = statusEffectOffset.Count*0x4*0x3

            if not (statusEffectOffset.Count == statusEffectAmount) then
               --remove
               if (statusEffectOffset.Count &gt; statusEffectAmount) then
                  for i = statusEffectOffset.Count, statusEffectAmount+1, -1 do
                      statusEffectOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (statusEffectOffset.Count &lt; statusEffectAmount) then
                      for i = statusEffectOffset.Count, statusEffectAmount-1 do
                          if (i &gt; 10) then
                             break --inf loop
                          end
                          local statusEffrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          statusEffrec.Type = 13
                          statusEffrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          statusEffrec.setAddress("attackStatusNum+8")
                          statusEffrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          statusEffrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          statusEffrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Status Effects"
                          statusEffrec.DropDownLinked = true
                          statusEffrec.setDescription("Status Effect "..(i+1))
                          statusEffrec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                          statusEffrec.DontSave = true
                          statusEffrec.appendToEntry(statusEffectOffset)

                          offset = offset + 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("attackStatusNum+8")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          newrec.setDescription("Chance")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(statusEffrec)

                          offset = offset + 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("attackStatusNum+8")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          newrec.setDescription("Parameter")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(statusEffrec)

                          offset = offset + 0x4
                      end
               end
            end
         end
end

if not timer then
   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

alloc(attackStatusNum,10)

[DISABLE]
{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
if (timer) then
   timer.Enabled = false
   timer.Destroy()
   timer = nil
end

unregistersymbol(attackStatusEdit)
unregistersymbol(attackStatusNum)
dealloc(attackStatusNum)

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
--BTLAS+8 = first AttackStatus
--+98 = ignore first, skip to next one
--68 = Hit allies flag
--69 = Hit self flag
  local address = getAddress("BTLAS+8+98+68")

  for i = 0, 3043 do
      --Friendly Fire check
      if (readInteger("BTLASOptions") == 1) then
         writeByte(address,1)
      end
      --Self hit check
      if (readInteger("BTLASOptions+8") == 1) then
         address = address + 1
         writeByte(address,1)
         address = address - 1
      end
      address = address + 0x98
      i = i + 1
  end

{$asm}
[DISABLE]

if syntaxcheck then return end

autoAssemble([[
aobscanregion(enmData, 300000000, 400000000, 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 09 00 00 00 0F 00 00 00 13 00 00 00 1C 00 00 00 1D 00 00 00 23 00 00 00 26 ? ? ? ? 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) // should be unique
registersymbol(enmData)
]])

local currEnemy

function mainloop()
         if not (getAddressSafe("enmData") == nil) and not (getAddressSafe("enmData") == 0) then
            local btlUnitOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90456")
            local modelOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90457")
            local attachmentOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90458")
            local preOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90459")
            local animationOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90460")
            local mdfResOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90461")
            local mdfBtlFaceOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90462")
            local slashEffOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90463")
            local ldfOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90464")
            local gaOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90465")
            local aiOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90466")
            local iconOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90467")
            local guiFctOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90468")
            local unkOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90483")
            local chromaMdlOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90489")
            local commonLinkArtesOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90502")
            local linkedMysticAnimOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90504")
            local runSpeedOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90506")
            local backWalkSpeedOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90508")
            local backstepSpeedOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90510")
            local forwardStepLengthOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90512")
            local forwardStepSpeedOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90514")
            local backstepLengthOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90516")
            local backstepHeightOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90518")
            local backstepUnkOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90520")
            local weaknessOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90540")
            local droppedItemOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90547")
            local habitatBonusOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90552")
            local habitatOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90582")
            local modelEnmBookOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90583")
            local weaponMdlEnmBookOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90584")
            local voiceDataOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90589")
            local chromaVoiceOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90591")
            local nameOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90592")
            local descOffset = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90593")

            if not (readInteger("enmDataEdit") == currEnemy) then
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x8", tonumber(getAddress(btlUnitOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(btlUnitOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x10", tonumber(getAddress(modelOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(modelOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x18", tonumber(getAddress(attachmentOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(attachmentOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x20", tonumber(getAddress(preOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(preOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x28", tonumber(getAddress(animationOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(animationOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x30", tonumber(getAddress(mdfResOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(mdfResOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x38", tonumber(getAddress(mdfBtlFaceOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(mdfBtlFaceOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x40", tonumber(getAddress(slashEffOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(slashEffOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x48", tonumber(getAddress(ldfOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(ldfOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x50", tonumber(getAddress(gaOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(gaOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x58", tonumber(getAddress(aiOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(aiOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x60", tonumber(getAddress(iconOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(iconOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x68", tonumber(getAddress(guiFctOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(guiFctOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x70", tonumber(getAddress(unkOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(unkOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x78", tonumber(getAddress(chromaMdlOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(chromaMdlOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x80", tonumber(getAddress(commonLinkArtesOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(commonLinkArtesOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x88", tonumber(getAddress(linkedMysticAnimOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(linkedMysticAnimOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x90", tonumber(getAddress(runSpeedOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(runSpeedOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x98", tonumber(getAddress(backWalkSpeedOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(backWalkSpeedOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xA0", tonumber(getAddress(backstepSpeedOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(backstepSpeedOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xA8", tonumber(getAddress(forwardStepLengthOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(forwardStepLengthOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xB0", tonumber(getAddress(forwardStepSpeedOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(forwardStepSpeedOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xB8", tonumber(getAddress(backstepLengthOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(backstepLengthOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xC0", tonumber(getAddress(backstepHeightOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(backstepHeightOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xC8", tonumber(getAddress(backstepUnkOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(backstepUnkOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xD0", tonumber(getAddress(weaknessOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(weaknessOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xD8", tonumber(getAddress(droppedItemOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(droppedItemOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xE0", tonumber(getAddress(habitatBonusOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(habitatBonusOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xE8", tonumber(getAddress(habitatOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(habitatOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xF0", tonumber(getAddress(modelEnmBookOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(modelEnmBookOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0xF8", tonumber(getAddress(weaponMdlEnmBookOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(weaponMdlEnmBookOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x100", tonumber(getAddress(voiceDataOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(voiceDataOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x108", tonumber(getAddress(chromaVoiceOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(chromaVoiceOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x110", tonumber(getAddress(nameOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(nameOffset.Address))))
               writeQword("enmDataEdit+0x118", tonumber(getAddress(descOffset.Address)) + swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(descOffset.Address))))

               currEnemy = readInteger("enmDataEdit")
            end

            local commonLinkArtesAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90503")
            local linkedMysticAnimAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90505")
            local runSpeedAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90507")
            local backWalkSpeedAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90509")
            local backstepSpeedAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90511")
            local forwardStepLengthAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90513")
            local forwardStepSpeedAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90515")
            local backstepLengthAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90517")
            local backstepHeightAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90519")
            local backstepUnkAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90521")
            local weaknessAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("91807")

            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(commonLinkArtesOffset, commonLinkArtesAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0x80")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(linkedMysticAnimOffset, linkedMysticAnimAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0x88")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(runSpeedOffset, runSpeedAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0x90")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(backWalkSpeedOffset, backWalkSpeedAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0x98")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(backstepSpeedOffset, backstepSpeedAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xA0")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(forwardStepLengthOffset, forwardStepLengthAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xA8")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(forwardStepSpeedOffset, forwardStepSpeedAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xB0")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(backstepLengthOffset, backstepLengthAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xB8")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(backstepHeightOffset, backstepHeightAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xC0")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(backstepUnkOffset, backstepUnkAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xC8")
            autoUpdateRecordGeneric(weaknessOffset, weaknessAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xD0")
            --autoUpdateRecordGeneric(droppedItemOffset, droppedItemAmountMemRec, "enmDataEdit+0xD8")

            local droppedItemAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90548")
            local droppedItemAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(droppedItemAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local offset = droppedItemOffset.Count*0x4

            --dropped items
            if not (droppedItemOffset.Count == droppedItemAmount) then
               --remove
               if (droppedItemOffset.Count &gt; droppedItemAmount) then
                  for i = droppedItemOffset.Count, droppedItemAmount+1, -1 do
                      droppedItemOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (droppedItemOffset.Count &lt; droppedItemAmount) then
                      for i = droppedItemOffset.Count, droppedItemAmount-1 do
                          if (i &gt; 10) then
                             break --inf loop
                          end
                          local droppedItemrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          droppedItemrec.Type = 8
                          droppedItemrec.Aob.Size = 4
                          droppedItemrec.ShowAsHex = true
                          droppedItemrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+D8")
                          droppedItemrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Items"
                          droppedItemrec.DropDownLinked = true
                          droppedItemrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          droppedItemrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          droppedItemrec.setDescription("Dropped Item "..(i+1))
                          droppedItemrec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                          droppedItemrec.DontSave = true
                          droppedItemrec.appendToEntry(droppedItemOffset)

                          offset = offset + 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+D8")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          newrec.setDescription("Chance")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(droppedItemrec)

                          offset = offset + 0x4
                      end
               end
            end


            local habitatBonusAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90553")
            local habitatBonusAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(habitatBonusAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local offset = habitatBonusOffset.Count*0x4

            --habitat bonus
            if not (habitatBonusOffset.Count == habitatBonusAmount) then
               --remove
               if (habitatBonusOffset.Count &gt; habitatBonusAmount) then
                  for i = habitatBonusOffset.Count, habitatBonusAmount+1, -1 do
                      habitatBonusOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (habitatBonusOffset.Count &lt; habitatBonusAmount) then
                      for i = habitatBonusOffset.Count, habitatBonusAmount-1 do
                          if (i &gt; 10) then
                             break --inf loop
                          end
                          local habitatBonusrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          habitatBonusrec.Type = 13
                          habitatBonusrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          habitatBonusrec.setDescription("Required Kills "..(i+1))
                          habitatBonusrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+E0")
                          habitatBonusrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          habitatBonusrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          habitatBonusrec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                          habitatBonusrec.DontSave = true
                          habitatBonusrec.appendToEntry(habitatBonusOffset)

                          offset = offset + 0x4

                          local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+E0")
                          newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                          newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                          newrec.setDescription("SP Gained")
                          newrec.appendToEntry(habitatBonusrec)

                          offset = offset + 0x4
                      end
               end
            end

            --voice data
            local voiceAmountMemRec = getAddressList().getMemoryRecordByID("90590")
            local voiceAmount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(voiceAmountMemRec.Address)))
            local offset = voiceDataOffset.Count*0xC

            if not (voiceDataOffset.Count == voiceAmount) then
               --remove
               if (voiceDataOffset.Count &gt; voiceAmount) then
                  for i = voiceDataOffset.Count, voiceAmount+1, -1 do
                      voiceDataOffset.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (voiceDataOffset.Count &lt; voiceAmount) then
                   for i = voiceDataOffset.Count, voiceAmount-1 do
                      if (i &gt; 100) then
                         break --inf loop
                      end
                      local header = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      header.IsGroupHeader = true
                      header.setDescription("Voice "..(i+1))
                      header.DontSave = true
                      header.Options = "[moHideChildren,moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                      header.appendToEntry(voiceDataOffset)

                      local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      newrec.Type = 8
                      newrec.Aob.Size = 4
                      newrec.ShowAsHex = true
                      newrec.setDescription("Start condition")
                      newrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+100")
                      newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                      newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                      newrec.appendToEntry(header)

                      offset = offset + 0x4

                      local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      newrec.Type = 8
                      newrec.Aob.Size = 4
                      newrec.ShowAsHex = true
                      newrec.setDescription("End condition")
                      newrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+100")
                      newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                      newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                      newrec.appendToEntry(header)

                      offset = offset + 0x4

                      local voiceOffsetHeader = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      voiceOffsetHeader.Type = 13
                      voiceOffsetHeader.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                      voiceOffsetHeader.ShowAsHex = true
                      voiceOffsetHeader.setDescription("Voice offset")
                      voiceOffsetHeader.setAddress("enmDataEdit+100")
                      voiceOffsetHeader.setOffsetCount("1")
                      voiceOffsetHeader.setOffset(0, offset)
                      voiceOffsetHeader.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"
                      voiceOffsetHeader.appendToEntry(header)

                      local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()
                      local value = swapEndian(readInteger(readPointer(voiceOffsetHeader.Address)+offset))

                      newrec.Type = 6
                      newrec.String.Size = 60
                      newrec.setDescription("Voice")
                      newrec.setAddress("enmDataEdit+100")
                      newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                      newrec.setOffset(0, offset+value)
                      newrec.appendToEntry(voiceOffsetHeader)

                      offset = offset + 0x4
                   end
               end
            end
         end
end

function autoUpdateRecordGeneric(offsetMemRec, amountMemRec, memRecAddr)
            --print(offsetMemRec.Description)
            --print(amountMemRec.Description)
            local amount = swapEndian(readInteger(getAddress(amountMemRec.Address)))
            local offset = offsetMemRec.Count*0x4
            local commonLinkedChara = (offsetMemRec.Count%9)+1
            local commonLinkedCounter = math.floor(offsetMemRec.Count/9)+1

            --print("chara: "..commonLinkedChara..", counter: "..commonLinkedCounter)

            if not (offsetMemRec.Count == amount) then
               --remove
               if (offsetMemRec.Count &gt; amount) then
                  for i = offsetMemRec.Count, amount+1, -1 do
                      offsetMemRec.Child[i-1].destroy()
                  end
               --add
               elseif (offsetMemRec.Count &lt; amount) then
                   for i = offsetMemRec.Count, amount-1 do
                      if (i &gt; 100) then
                         break --inf loop
                      end
                      local newrec = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                      if (offsetMemRec.ID == 90547) then --dropped items
                         newrec.Type = 8
                         newrec.Aob.Size = 4
                         newrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "dropdown: Items"
                         newrec.DropDownLinked = true
                         newrec.setDescription("Dropped Item "..(i+1))
                         newrec.ShowAsHex = true
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90506) then --run speed
                             newrec.setDescription("Run speed (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90508) then --back walk speed
                             newrec.setDescription("Back walk speed (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90510) then --backstep speed
                             newrec.setDescription("Backstep speed (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90512) then --forward step length
                             newrec.setDescription("Forward step length (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90514) then --forward step speed
                             newrec.setDescription("Forward step speed (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90516) then --backstep length
                             newrec.setDescription("Backstep length (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90518) then --backstep height
                             newrec.setDescription("Backstep height (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90520) then --backstep ???
                             newrec.setDescription("Backstep ??? (weapon "..(i+1)..")")
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90540) then --weakness
                             if (i == 0) then
                                newrec.setDescription("Fire")
                             elseif (i == 1) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Water")
                             elseif (i == 2) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Wind")
                             elseif (i == 3) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Earth")
                             elseif (i == 4) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Light")
                             elseif (i == 5) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Darkness")
                             elseif (i == 6) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Slash")
                             elseif (i == 7) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Blunt")
                             elseif (i == 8) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Shot")
                             else
                                  newrec.setDescription("Unknown (should never appear)")
                             end
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "Float Big Endian"
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90502) then --common linked artes
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                             newrec.DropDownLinkedMemrec = "Arte List"
                             newrec.DropDownLinked = true

                             if (commonLinkedChara &gt;= 10) then
                                commonLinkedCounter = commonLinkedCounter + 1
                                commonLinkedChara = 1
                             end
                             if (commonLinkedChara == 1) then
                                newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Jude "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 2) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Milla "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 3) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Alvin "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 4) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Elize "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 5) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Rowen "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 6) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Leia "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 7) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Gaius "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 8) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Muzét "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 9) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Common Linked Arte with Ludger "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             else
                                 newrec.setDescription("Unknown (should never happen)")
                             end

                             commonLinkedChara = commonLinkedChara + 1
                      elseif (offsetMemRec.ID == 90504) then --linked mystic arte animation
                             --this probably should be moved out of here as it needs to be updated per character
                             newrec.ShowAsHex = true
                             newrec.Type = 13
                             newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                             newrec.Options = "[moAllowManualCollapseAndExpand,moManualExpandCollapse]"

                             if (commonLinkedChara &gt;= 10) then
                                commonLinkedCounter = commonLinkedCounter + 1
                                commonLinkedChara = 1
                             end
                             if (commonLinkedChara == 1) then
                                newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Jude "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 2) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Milla "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 3) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Alvin "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 4) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Elize "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 5) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Rowen "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 6) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Leia "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 7) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Gaius "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 8) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Muzét "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             elseif (commonLinkedChara == 9) then
                                    newrec.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte with Ludger "..(commonLinkedCounter))
                             else
                                 newrec.setDescription("Unknown (should never happen)")
                             end

                             commonLinkedChara = commonLinkedChara + 1

                             local linkedMysticArteAnimChild = getAddressList().createMemoryRecord()

                             linkedMysticArteAnimChild.Type = 6
                             linkedMysticArteAnimChild.String.Size = 60
                             linkedMysticArteAnimChild.setDescription("Linked Mystic Arte Animation")

                             local baseAddrValue = swapEndian(readInteger(readPointer(memRecAddr)+offset))
                             baseAddrValue = string.format("%x", baseAddrValue)

                             linkedMysticArteAnimChild.setAddress("["..memRecAddr.."]+"..string.format("%x", offset).."+"..baseAddrValue)
                             linkedMysticArteAnimChild.appendToEntry(newrec)
                      else
                          newrec.Type = 13
                          newrec.CustomTypeName = "4 Byte Big Endian"
                          newrec.setDescription("No set name")
                      end
                      newrec.setAddress(memRecAddr)
                      newrec.setOffsetCount("1")
                      newrec.setOffset(0, offset)
                      newrec.DontSave = true
                      newrec.appendToEntry(offsetMemRec)

                      offset = offset + 0x4
                   end
               end
            end

end

   timer = createTimer(nil)
   timer.OnTimer = function(timer)
                   mainloop()
                   end
   timer.Interval = 1000
   timer.Enabled = true
else
   timer.Enabled = true
end

{$lua}
if syntaxcheck then return end
local float = 999999

function swapEndiannessFloat(f)
    local bytes = {string.byte(string.pack("f", f), 1, -1)}
    return string.unpack("f", string.char(bytes[4], bytes[3], bytes[2], bytes[1]))
end

autoAssemble([[
aobscanregion(enmDataIdle, 300000000, 400000000, 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 09 00 00 00 0F 00 00 00 13 00 00 00 1C 00 00 00 1D 00 00 00 23 00 00 00 26 ? ? ? ? 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00) // should be unique

registersymbol(enmDataIdle)
]])

local address = getAddress("enmDataIdle-154")

for i=1,563,1 do
    writeFloat(address+0x174, swapEndiannessFloat(float))

    address = address + 0x1E8
end

{$asm}
[DISABLE]
unregistersymbol(enmDataIdle)

function iterate_character_data()
         current_character_data = current_character_data + enemy_data_struct_size
         current_character = swapEndian(readInteger(current_character_data))

         if (debug == true) then
            print("Character: "..character_names[current_character]..", ID: "..current_character)
         end

         character_struct = {
         player_id = current_character_data + 0x4, --4 bytes

         --offsets
         model = current_character_data + 0xC,
         attachment = current_character_data + 0x10,
         preload = current_character_data + 0x14,
         animation = current_character_data + 0x18,
         mdf_btl_face = current_character_data + 0x20,
         slash_effect = current_character_data + 0x24,
         ldf = current_character_data + 0x28,
         ga = current_character_data + 0x2C,

         --flags
         weapon_swap_enabled = current_character_data + 0x58,
         chromatus_enabled = current_character_data + 0x64,

         --offsets
         chromatus_model = current_character_data + 0x68,
         --common_linked_artes = current_character_data + 0x84,
         --common_linked_mystic_arte_animations = current_character_data + 0x8C,
         run_speed = current_character_data + 0x94,
         back_walk_speed = current_character_data + 0x9C,
         back_step_speed = current_character_data + 0xA4,
         forward_step_length = current_character_data + 0xAC,
         forward_step_speed = current_character_data + 0xB4,
         back_step_length = current_character_data + 0xBC,
         back_step_height = current_character_data + 0xC4,
         back_step_unk = current_character_data + 0xCC,

         --floats
         turn_speed = current_character_data + 0xD4,
         jump_height = current_character_data + 0xD8,
         jump_height2 = current_character_data + 0xDC,

         voice_struct = current_character_data + 0x1D4, --ofset
         voice_size = current_character_data + 0x1D8, --4 bytes

         chromatus_voice = current_character_data + 0x1DC --offset
}
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function create_headers()
         base_character_memrec = al.createMemoryRecord()
         base_character_memrec.IsGroupHeader = true
         base_character_memrec.Parent = script_header
         base_character_memrec.Description = (character_names[current_character].." -&gt; &lt;char&gt;")
         base_character_memrec.DontSave = true
         base_character_memrec.Options = "[moHideChildren, moDeactivateChildrenAsWell]"

         if (debug == true) then
            print("Created new header")
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function create_script(enable_code, disable_code)
         local script = "[ENABLE]\r\n{$lua}\r\nif syntaxcheck then return end\r\n"..enable_code.."\r\n{$asm}\r\n[DISABLE]\r\n{$lua}\r\nif syntaxcheck then return end\r\n"..disable_code.."\r\n{$asm}"
         return script
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function firstToUpper(str)
    return (str:gsub("^%l", string.upper))
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function array_of_bytes_to_int(str)
         str = string.gsub(str, "%s+", "")
         return tonumber(str, 16)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function string_to_integer(str)
      local byteArray = {}
      local index = 1

      -- Split the string by spaces
      for byte in str:gmatch("%S+") do
          byteArray[index] = tonumber(byte, 16)  -- Convert each byte from hexadecimal
          index = index + 1
      end

      local intArray = {}

      -- Convert every 4 bytes into a 4-byte integer
      for i = 1, #byteArray, 4 do
          local int = byteArray[i] * 2^24 + byteArray[i + 1] * 2^16 + byteArray[i + 2] * 2^8 + byteArray[i + 3]
          table.insert(intArray, int)
      end

      return intArray
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function get_arte_address_and_bit(arteID, character)
         local address = character_stats_base + 0xCC + 0x48 + 0x3 + 0x6FE0 * remove_decimal(character - 1)
         local bit = 0
         local counter = 0
         --print("Received arte ID: "..arteID..", character: "..character)
         while (counter &lt; arteID + 1) do
               while (bit &lt; 8) do
                     if (counter == arteID) then
                        --write bit
                        --writeInteger(address,readInteger(address) &amp; (~(((1&lt;&lt;1)-1) &lt;&lt; bit)) | ((value or 0 &amp; ((1&lt;&lt;1)-1)) &lt;&lt; bit))
                        --print(toHex(address)..", bit "..bit)
                        return address, bit
                     end
                     bit = bit + 1
                     counter = counter + 1
               end
               bit = 0

               if (address % 4 == 0) then
                  address = address + 0x7
               else
                   address = address - 0x1
               end
         end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function clean_arte_list(character)
         local address = character_stats_base + 0xCC + 0x48 + 0x6FE0 * remove_decimal(character - 1)
         local enabled_artes_bytes_to_null = 512
         local arte_list_bytes_to_null = 96

         --clean enabled artes
         for i = 1, enabled_artes_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end

         local base_address = character_stats_base + 0xCC  + 0x454C + 0x6FE0 * remove_decimal(character - 1)
         address = base_address --arte list 1
         --clean arte list
         for i = 1, arte_list_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end

         address = base_address + 0x34C --arte list 2
         for i = 1, arte_list_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end

         address = base_address + 0x34C + 0x68 --arte list 3
         for i = 1, arte_list_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end

         address = base_address + 0x34C + 0x68*2 --arte list 3
         for i = 1, arte_list_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end

         --[[
         address = base_address + 0x34C + 0x68*3 --chromatus arte list
         for i = 1, arte_list_bytes_to_null / 8 do
             writeQword(address, 0x0)
             address = address + 0x8
         end]]
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function get_weapon_swap_flag(character)
         return character_stats_base + 0x4954 + 0x6FE0 * remove_decimal(character - 1)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function get_chromatus_arte_list_address(character)
         return character_stats_base + 0xCC + 0x28 + 0x4870 + 0x6FE0 * remove_decimal(character - 1) + 0x68 * 3
end

function generic_string_handler(disable_for_script)
         --handle multiple dropdown values
         for l = 1, current_data_header.DropDownCount - 1, 1 do --loop for every dropdown option (l = dropdown entry)
             local sub_record = al.createMemoryRecord()
             sub_record.Type = vtAutoAssembler
             sub_record.Parent = memory_record
             sub_record.DontSave = true
             sub_record.Description = current_data_header.DropDownDescription[l]

             local code = current_data_header.DropDownValue[l]
             enable_code = "writeStringWithTerminator(0x"..toHex(getOffset(address))..", \""..code.."\")"

             sub_record.Script = create_script(enable_code, disable_for_script)
         end
end
